brlabs nas ni/ /slar yang blo ldan sngags 'di yis/ /thams cad bdag nyid can du bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātpa ko haṃ/de ltar byin brlabs bdag nyid ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /mtshan ma drug dang yang dag ldan/ /dam tshig sems dpa' bsam par bya/ /snying ga'i dbus gnas phra mo ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /ting rkya'adzin sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ /hūṃ yig de yi snying gar dgod/ /de ltar sems dpa' gsum bdag nyid/ /rnal 'byor chen por bdag bskyed nas//cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /phyag rgya bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /rme sha can ni bdag nyid che'i/ /bu mo atpal mthing ka yi/ /'dab ltar sngo sangs mig yangs ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan brnyed nas/ /bsgrub pa po la gus mnyes gshin/ /legs par babeebs pa blangs nas su/ /oṃ yig mgo bor bsam par bya/ /aḥyig ngag gi lam la dgod/ /hūṃ yig snying gar bsam bya zhing / /lte bar swā dang rkang gnyis hā/ /srun dang mā ma ki dang ni/ /de bzhin du ni gos dkar mo/ /sgol ma yang ni sngags pa yi/ /sa la sogs pa rnam par dgod/ /lha mo gzugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ /de nyid la ni rnam bsam zhing / /sa snying la sogs de rnams dang / /snyoms par 'jug par bsgom par bya/ /lag g.yas rdo rje ro langs ma/ /g.yon par gzhan kyis mi thub ma/ /de yi khar ni khro gnyer ma/ /gsang bar ral pa gcig ma'o/ /gzhan yang dpung pa g.yas na yum/ /sna tshogs rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /g.yon du sna tshogs rin chen ma/ /phyag rgya rab tu bsgom par bya/ /pus mo g.yas la gnas par yang / /sna tshogs pad ma de bzhin gshegs/ /sna tshogs las ma 46—788

g.yon pa ①la/ /spyi bor nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ /rkang pa gnyis kyi mtha' ru ni/ /sa 'dzin lha mo bzhag byas te/ /de ltar 'dus byas rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje padma yang dag brtsam/ /sngags pas hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa bsam—/ /de bzhin de rtse dbus ma la/ /oṃ ni rnam par bsam par bya/ /de bzhin ṣāyig las byung ba'i/ /pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ni/ /'od zer lnga yis khyab bsams la/ /de 'og bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa adma ko haṃ/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nga rgyal legs 'chang zhing / /hūṃ gi glu yis kyang ni bskyod par bya/ /rang gi byang chub sems nyid byung ba'i tshe/ /'di ltar phaṭa kyi gsang sngags des brjod bya/ /phyung ba'i mthar yang sngags pa yis/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /byang chub sems kyis mchod bya zhing / /sngags 'di gsal bar brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū tsadza badzra swa bhā wa adma ko haṃ/ rab rngu sngags yi ge las byung ba//rdo rje gsum gyis byin brlabs rang / /padma'i dbus su bskyed nas ni/ /slar yang zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur/ /badzra dṛka sngags las byung ba'i/ /mi bskyod rdo rje can bsam pa/ /mgon po ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang / /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /mthing shun bzang po'i mdog ltar snang / /sngo gnag dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su sdogs/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje 'khor lo pad ma ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag tu bsam bya zhing / /dril bu yid bzhin nor bu dang / /ral gri de yi g.yon du bsam—/ /'di ni thugs ka las byung nas/ /phyogs bcu rnams su gzigs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul kun mdzad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab 46—789

bskor ste/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i gzhir gnas pa'i/ /sems can ma lus legs sbyangs nas/ /beer byon rdo rje mgon po yi/ /spyan snga ru ni 'dug pa ①gyur/ /sngags pas de ni bdag nyid kyi/ /snying gar rjes su zhugs par bsgom/ /snga ma'i gzugs ni yongs gyur na①/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i gnas la bzhugs/ /ind+ra ni la'i 'od 'bar ba/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus na zhugs/ /dpa' bo rang gi phyag rgyas 'khyud/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /drag po zhi dang 'dod chags che/ /zhal gsum gyis ni rnam mdzes pa'o/ /zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spro bar bya/ /dzi na dzika sngags las rdzogs pa'i/ /gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad dbyung / /ston ka'i zla zer ltar snang zhing / /thor tshugs cod pan dag gis brgyan/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug zhi ba'i gzugs can dang / /'khor lo rdo rje pad ma dkar/ /g.yas pa rnams su rnam par bsam/ /dril bu yid bzhin nor ral gri/ /'di yi g.yon du rnam par bsgom/ /de bzhin thugs ka las byung ste/ /gti mug spyod gnas skye dgu rnams/ /yang dag sbyangs te beer byon nas—/ /shar phyogs kyi ni 'khor lor bzhugs/ /ratna j-ika sngags las skyed pa'i—/ /rin chen tog ni mkhas pas dbyung / /zhi ba thor tshugs cod pan 'chang / /mi bskyod pas ni dbu brgyan snebyas/ /ser dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje dang //'khor lo de yi g.yas su bsgom/ /dril bu pad ma ser po dang / /ral gri g.yon du bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin thugs ka las phyung ste/ /nga rgyal gnas la gnas pa rnams/ /yang dag sbyangs nas lho yi char/ /rin po che yi dbus 46—790

su bzhugs/ /a ro lika sngags las skyes pa'i/ /mtha' yas rdo rje can dbyung ste—/ /zhi ba padma rā ga'i 'od/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /mgon po ral pa'i thor tshugs 'chang / /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /sgeg pa'i nyams dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i/ /padma'i sdong bu 'dzin mdzad cing / /padma thugs ka'i phyogs gnas pa/ /g.yas pa yis ni 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas gnyis kyi/ /rin chen ral gri g.yon gnyis kyis①/ /sngon bzhin 'dod chags can sbyangs nas/ /rgyab kyi padma la bzhugs pa'o/ /pra dzñā dhrika sngags las sprul pa'i/ /sngags pas don yod rdo rje can/ /mgon po sku mdog ljang gu dbyung / /thor tshugs cod pan dag gis brgyan/ /ljang dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /'khor lo g.yas su bsgom par bya/ /phyag g.yon rnams na dril bu dang / /pad ljang nor bu de bzhin du/ /log pa'i ngag can sems can rnams/ /rnam par sbyangs nas sbar byon te/ /de bzhin byang gi phyogs su ni—/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dag la bzhugs/ /zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin chags/ /yid bzhin nor bu dam tshig ste/ /rigs ni lnga po 'di rnams nyid/ /'dod dang thar pa rab bsgrub pa'o/ /mo ha ra ⑤ti'i sngags las skyes/ /lha mo spyan ni dbyung bar bya/ /dkar zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /snang mdzad kyis ni spyi bor mtshan/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo rdo rje de bzhin du/ /atpal dkar po g.yas rnams su/ /dril bu de bzhin rin chen dang / /ral gri g.yon du bsgom par 46—791

bya—/ /de bzhin thugs ka nas phyung ste/ /phyogs bcu rnams su gzigs nas niske/ /gdon dang nad gdung 'jig rten rnams/ /thugs rje chen pos zhi mdzad ste/ /slar byon zla ba'i dbus nyid du/ /shar gyi mtshams su bzhugs pa'o—/ /dre ṣa ra ti'i sngags las byung / /lha mo ma ma ki dbyung ste/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ltar sngo/ /bzhin bzang shin tu yid du 'ong / /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba ste/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbu rgyan byas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo de bzhin du/ / ud pal hu sngo dmar g.yas rnams na/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri phyag /g.yon na bsnams pa phyung nas ni/ /bgegs chen 'jigs pas gzir ba rnams/ /thugs rje chen pos bsrungs 3 mdzad de/ /beer ni byon par mdzad nas su/ /bden bral du ni bzhugs pa'o/ /rā ga ra ti'i sngags las byung / /gos dkar mo ni dbyung bya ste/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /nor bu pad ma rā ga'i 'od/ /'od dpag med bcas ral pa'i tshogs/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /g.yon pa dril bur bcas pa yi/ /ud pal sdong bu 'dzin mdzad pa/ /thugs kar gnas pa'i ud pa la//dmar po g.yas kyis 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje 'khor lo g.yas dag na/ /nor bu ral gri g.yon dag na/ /bsnams pa rnam par phyung nas ni/ /nad chen rnam par zhi mdzad de/ /slar byon pad ma'i dbus nyid du/ /rlung gi mtshams su bzhugs pa'o/ /badzra ra ti'i sngags las byung / /yid 'ong sgol ma dbyung byas te/ /ljang dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /dur ba'i lo ma'i 'od dang mnyam/ /don yod pas ni gtsug tor byas/ /phyag drug par ni rnam par bsgom/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /ud pal sngon po g.yas 46—792

rnams su/ /dril bu rin chen ral gri ni/ /baspyol zhugs can gyis g.yon du bsam—/ /de bzhin sems can kun dbang mdzad/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la ni/ /phyung 'di slar yang byon nas su/ /zhi ba'i gnas su zhugs ①pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis par rnal 'byor pas/ /gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa dbyung / /me yi mtshams su dgod bya ba/ /lha mo yid 'ong gzugs rdo rje/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dkar ba ste/ /dbu rgyan rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /gnyis kyis me long 'dzin pa ste/ /lhag ma gti mug dga' dang mtshungs/ /bden bral du dgod lha mo ni/ /sgra yi rdo rje phyag drug ma/ /zhal gsum sku mdog ser mo ste/ /dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan yin/ /phyag gnyis pi wang gis 'byel zhing / /lhag ma mā ma ki dang mtshungs/ /rlung gi gnas dgod lha mo ni/ /dri yi rdo rje phyag drug ma/ /zhal gsum sku mdog dmar mo ste/ /'od dpag med dang thor tshugs 'chang / /phyag gnyis kyang ni dung gis 'byel/ /lhag ma gos dkar mo dang mtshungs/ /dbang ldan du dgod lha mo ni/ /ro yi rdo rje phyag drug ma/ /zhal gsum sku mdog ljang gu ste/ /dbu rgyan la ni snga ①sgra can/ /phyag gnyis na ni ro yi snod/ /lhag ma sgol ma'i rnam pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs mkhyud ste/ /'khor lo'i dbus na rnam bzhugs pa'i/ /reg bya rdo rje bsam bya ste / /zhal sogs bdag po lta bu'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi ni/ /snam bur brtul zhugs can gyis dbyung / /mo ④ddhā sa bon las rdzogs pa/ /byams pa sa yi snying po dag /oṃ gyi sa bon dag las byung / /phyag na rdo rje mkha' snying po/ /lho yi phyogs kyi snam bu la/ /sngags pas go rims ji bzhin du/ /oṃ dang hūṃ las yang dag byung / /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /46—793

'di dag nub tu dbyung bar bya/ /byang phyogs su yang dbyung ba ni/ /oṃ dang saṃ gi sa bon skyes/ /sgrib sel kun tu bzang por bcas/ /'di rnams dbu rgyan rang gi mgon/ /sku mdog la sogs de dang mtshungs/ /phyag dang mtshon cha dag kyang slar/ /rang gi bdag po rnams dang mtshungs/ /byams pa 'ba' zhig g.yas pa na/ /klu shing me tog rnam par bsnams/ /'di rnams sems can rnams kyis ni/ /skye mched rnams ni rnam sbyangs nas/ /lha yi spyan sogs rtsol ba po/ /slar byon gdan rnams la bzhugs pa'o/ /ya mārnya kṛta sngags las gyur/ /sngags pa gshin rje mthar byed dbyung / /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /me 'phro 'thibs po kun nas 'khrigs/ /dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo ni/ /phyag g.yas rnams na bsnams de bzhin/ /thugs kar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon rnams na/ /dbang po la sogs tshogs kyang bcas/ /mi bzad bgegs rnams skrag mdzad cing / /padma nyi ma mnyam gnas nas/ /shar kyi phyogs su bzhugs pa'o/ /pra dzñārnya kṛta sngags las byung / /rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan can/ /sku mdog dkar zhing sbrul kyis brgyan/ /gzhan gyis mi thub sngags pas dbyung / /gsus khyim che zhing spyan gsum pa/ /dkar dang gnag dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /mche ba gcigs shing rnam par gnyer/ /me 'phro 'thibs po kun nas 'khrigs/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams na bsnams shing / /snying gar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon rnams na/ /mi bzad bgegs ni skrag par mdzad/ /g.yon rkyang ba yi gom stabs kyis/ /pad ma nyi ma mnan nas ni/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su de bzhugs so/ /pad manta kṛta 46—794

sngags las ①byung / /rta mgrin sngags pas ⑤dbyung bar bya/ /spyan gsum padma rā ①ga'i 'od/ /dmar dang gnag dang dkar ba'i zhal/ /zhal rtsub gsus khyim che ba dang / /'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ /dpa' bo g.yon rkyang ba yis gnas/ /me 'bar tshogs ni rnam par 'khrug /pad ma ral gri gtun shing ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams na bsnams shing / /snyems pa dang bcas dril bu dang / /dgra sta zhags pa g.yon rnams na/ /pad ma nyi ma la gnas te/ /phyogs bcu dag tu gzigs nas ni/ /klu rnams skrag par mdzad nas su/ /chu bdag phyogs su bzhugs pa'o/ /baspyinta kṛta sngags las byung / /rnga sgra yi ni cod pan can/ /atpal sngon po'i 'dab ltar ljang / /bdud rtsi thabs sbyor dbyung bar bya/ /sngo dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /zhal gdangs pa yi rnam par 'gyur/ /gsus khyim che zhing spyan gsum pa/ /dmar po 'bar bas rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo dang / /gtun shing yang ni g.yas rnams na/ /de bzhin sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /dril bu dgra sta g.yon na bsnams/ /bgegs rnams skrag par mdzad nas su/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gom pa'i stabs/ /pad ma nyi mar mnyam btsugs nas/ /lus ngan phyogs su bzhugs pa'o/ /rang sngags yi ge las byung ba/ /mi g.yo ba yang dbyung bar bya/ /spyan gsum ind+ra ni ④la'i mdog /dbu brgyan rnam par snang mdzad dpal/ /mche ba rnam par gcigs pa'i zhal/ /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /mi bzad ha ha zhes bzhad sgra/ /gsus ⑤khyim che zhing stobs po che/ /ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams na bsnams shing / /sdigs mdzub dang ni dgra sta dang / /zhags pa g.yon gyi 46—795

phyag rnams na/ /bgegs dang rims sogs bcom nas ni/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gom pa'i stabs/ /pad ma nyi mar mnyam btsugs nas/ /me lha'i phyogs su de bzhugs so/ /rang sngags yi ge las sdogs pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyi 'dod rgyal 'byung nye/ /dpa' bo ind+ra nī la'i 'od/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dbu brgyan ③can/ /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /gsus khyim che zhing 'jigs su rung / /phyag gnyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi/ /phyag rgya dag ni 'chang bar mdzad/ /rdo rje ral gri g.yas dag gis/ /g.yon pa zhags pa lcags kyu'o/ /bgegs 'jigs byed pa bden bral du/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi nyi mar bzhugs/ /rang sngags yi ge las byung ba/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dbyug sngon dbyung / /spyan gsum sprin sngon lta bu ste/ /'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /sngo dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /gsus khyim che zhing 'jigs pa bskyed/ /dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams na bsnams shing / /snying gar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /pad ma dgra sta g.yon rnams na/ /yams dang 'tshe ba'i 'jigs bsal nas/ /g.yon brkyang gom stabs gnas pa yis/ /padma nyi mar mnyam btsugs te/ /rlung lha'i phyogs su bzhugs pa'o/ /rang sngags yi ge las byung ba/ /rnga sgra yi ni dbu rgyan can/ /stobs po che ni sngags pas dbyung / /utpal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra'i 'od/ /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /spyan gsum 'jigs pa'i sgra dang ldan/ /yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan/ /gsus khyim che zhing 'jigs su rung / /dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo ni/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams na bsnams shing / /snying gar sdigs 'dzub zuzhags pa dang / /padma 46—796

dgra sta g.yon rnams na/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs 'jigs pa 'joms/ /g.yon brkyang goms pa'i stabs kyis te/ /pad ma nyi mar mnyam btsugs nas/ /dbang ldan phyogs su bzhugs pa'o/ /rang sngags yi ge las byung ba'i/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dbyung / /mkha' ltar sngo sangs drag po ni/ /mi bskyod pa yi dbu rgyan byas/ /gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /gtso bo spyan gsum gsus pa 'phyang / /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyi/ /spyi bor gtsug tor 'dzin mdzad cing / /rdo rje pad ma g.yas dag gis/ /sdigs 'dzub 1ral gri g.yon dag gis/ /'tshe ba thams cad rnam 'jig cing / /g.yon brkyang goms stabs snyams 1pa yis/ /pad ma nyi mar mnyam gnas nas/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su de bzhugs so/ /rang sngags yi ge las rdzogs pa/ /gnod mdzes rgyal po sngags pas dbyung / /spyan gsum nam mkha' bzang bo'i 'od//gnag dang dkar dang dmar ba'i zhal/ /gsus khyim che zhing gcigs pa'i zhal//mi bskyod pas ni dbu brgyan byas/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen ni/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams na 'dzin cing / /snying gar sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /pad ma ral gri g.yon rnams na/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba'i dug /kā la ku ṭa la sogs kun/ /bcom nas bgegs kyi bdag po ni/ /thams cad kun tu zhi mdzad nas/ /ma lus bka' ni rdzogs byas te/ /g.yon brkyang gom stabs gnas pa yis/ /pad ma nyi mar mnyam gnas te/ /sa yi 'og lcetu de bzhugs so//lha ni sum cu gnyis rang bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad phyung nas ni/ /'khor lo'i dbus su gnas gyur nas/ /de nas phra mo'i rnal 'byor brtsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nyungs kar bsams/ /nyungs ④/kar rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /ye shes 46—797

gnas ni nyams dga' ba/ /gsang ba'i ye shes brtags pa bsgom/ /rin chen chen po kha dog lnga/ /nyungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshad tsam/ /sna yi rtse mor nan tan du/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni rtag tu bsgom/ /rin chen brtan par gyur na spro//brtan par ma gyur yong mi spro/ /sangs rgyas 'bar ba mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rab mchog sprin rnams spro bar bya/ /slong mo za zhing mi bzlas te/ /bslangs la dga' bar yang mi bya/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing / /sngags kyi yan lag dbyer med bzlas/ /brjod nas rdo rje spro bya zhing / /sdogs nas rab tu bsdu bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /don dam pa yi bzlas par gsungs/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa yang / /rnam gnyis ci 'dod byas nas su/ /slar yang sngags pas bdag nyid ni/ /de bzhin nyid la gzhug par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gnas lha mo/ /gzhi yis bdag po ma mthong nas / /tshigs su bcad pa 'di bzhi yis/ /bde ba chen po sad par byed/ /sems can khams ni gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la skyabs su gsol/ /mgon pos gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab gnyen mchog chen bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can mang por phan/ /sangs rgyas rnams don byang chub mchog don phan pa rjes bstan pa/ /mgon pos gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /chags pas 'dod chags dam tshig bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol—/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs rtse ①ba 'jig rten dag gis dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon pos gal te 46—798

de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /rab dga'i spyod pas kun tu bzang po bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /khyod ni rdo rje'i 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid rjes su thugs brtse ba/ /mgon pos gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na—/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de ltar yang dag yon tan ni/ /brjod pas bslang ba'i mgon po la/ /mi bskyod la sogs ngo bo yi/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams bstod par mdzad/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal chos rnams ni/ /ston mdzad rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab//rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /gsang ba gsungs shig khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje can/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa bsnyes①/ /rdo rje gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje sdogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kyis bstod de nas 'khor lo mnyes mdzad ste—/ /gsang ba mchog ni ji lta ji bzhin rab gsal byas/ /rang gi lus kyi 'khor lo la ni 'khor lo gzhug /mgon po bde ba chen po gcig pu bzhugs par gyur/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi byed rnal 'byor pas/ /hūṃ yig snying por 'jig rten rab tu bsgom/ /de byung 'gro ba rdo rje sems dpar blta/ /langs 46—799

nas de'i blos ji bzhin dpyad par bya/ /sngags pa ting 'dzin la dmigs pas/ /gang tshe lus ni skams gyur na/ /lus ngag yid ni tshim byed pa'i/ /sbyor ba 'di ni bsgom par bya/ /mtho gang tsam gyis spags par ni/ /mgo bor dkyil 'khor brtag par bya/ /oṃ yig dbus su gnas bsam nas/ /bdud rtsi lnga po dbab par bya/ /rdo rje sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur / /lus dang ngag sems bder gnas par/ /'gyur bar 'di ni je tshom tshomed/ /de ltar slob dpon sngags pa yi/ /sbyang zhing rtogs bya de bzhin du / /gog ma snying ga legs sbyangs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams tshim par bya/ /hūṃ yig gis ni legs sbyangs la/ /yi ge āḥyis rtogs par bya/ /oṃ gyes ma nan pas 'bar bar bya/ /'di ni kha zas sbyar ba'o/ /dang po mgrin par dung bsams te/ /der ni hri las byung ba yi/ /pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsgom/ /lte ba'i steng du yi ge hūṃ/ /hūṃ yig las skyes rdo rje che/ /rtse mo lnga pa rnam par bsgom/ /rtse mo dbus ma'i rtse mor oṃ/ /rnam bsam sgog ma sbyang ba'o/ /sprin gyes sgra ni snying gar bsgom/ /rtse gsum me ni de las spro/ /der ni bza' ba sbyin bsreg bya/ /'di yang nang gi sbyin bsreg yin/ /rlung gis me ni 'bar bar byed/ /des kyang chu ni 'tshed par byed/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dang ni gnas/ /gang du kun tu rgyu ba yi/ /bsreg bya bza' btung gang cung zad/ /de dag thams cad chu yis ni/ /bza' btung kha yi pad ma yis/ /snying ga'i pad mar yang dag gzhug /lte ba'i pad mar phyin rjes la/ /kha sbyar byed pa'i sbyor ba las/ /gsang lam pad ma las thon nas/ /thal ba'i mthar ni rnam par bstan/ /rgas pa med cing nad kyang med/ /dug 46—800

la sogs pas mi 'chi zhing / /'di ni dus min 'chi mi 'gyur/ /'tshe ba thams cad rnam 'jig pa'o/ /rdo rjo phreng bas ①dpal mchog srubs shing gis/ /'dus pa chu gter zab mo bsrubs pa las/ /bsgrub pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi gang thob des/ /'jig rten mtha' dag 'chi med nyer thob shog /bsdus pa'i rim bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po dpal klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsarya shradha ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba ban de rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /slad kyi rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po re beent+ra'i zhal snga nas/ chag lo tsa ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis ma gha dha'i dpe ltar legs par bcos shing gtan la phab pa'o// //shu lo ka sum brgya dang sum cu bzhugs so// //46—801
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2591)46wa 803

༄ga /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim pa lnga pa zhes bya ba/①༄ / /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim pa lnga pa zhes bya ba bzhugs sosde/ /༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ hri sa ma dzā ghu hā u pa dhe sha pachub ma na ma/bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag rim pa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ bla mabaskyed phyag dang ni yi dam lha/ /ji ltar chu lachu bzhag dang mar lamarabazhin du/ /gnyis med bdenapaye shes la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang 'dus kyi/ /rdzogs rims don bsdus rim bzhin bshad/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi 'di/ /phyi don drug tu shes par bya/ /dang po phyima'idon rgyud gzhi'i ①gnas lugs bstan/ /gnyis pa 'khor bar 'khrul lugs bstan/ /gsum pa rnamadag sbyang gzhi'i gnas thabs spyod bsdus nas bstan/ /bzhi pa nyams su blang thabs lam byi rim lnga bstan/ /lnga pa 'bras bu'i sku gsum thobatshul le'u dang po dang gcig rgyab nas bstan/ /drug pa brod pa skyed pa phan yon bstan pa'o/ /46byed804

dang po rang bzhin lhun grub de gzhi'i gnas lugs ni/ /lam gsum gyi mthar gzhi yis 'bras bu byed pa yin/ /sems can sangs rgyas mnyam ngo bo nyid la tha dad med pa med mnyam—/ /chosathams cad gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa/ /bden pa gnyis med del 'khor dang myang 'das med 'od gsal ba ngo bo nyid kyi sku de/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa de/ /gdod nas stong pa 'gro 'ong med par thams cad rnam dag ngo bo nyid rang la gnas pa yin/ /gzhi dang lamaskyemed bud dha'i rang bzhin rgyu yin te/ /lam ni thabs zhes bya ba yin/ /de bzhin dri ma gzhom du med pas mi 'phrogs 'bras bu 'dusam byas yin/ /thog ma tha ma med dus gsum mnyam nyid du zhib/ /rnam par 'od gsal chos dbyings mi 'gyur mtshan ma med//mi 'jig skye/ ba med 'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgribs de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid ces so/ /gang yin/ /rgyu yis skyo'agag med pas 'bras bu rgyas gdab po mtharachos sku/ /rgyu nyid 'bras bu 'od gsal ba nyid dag ste/ /skye med dgag med sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid rtog med dbyer med sku gsum ngo bo rang bzhin gcig tu lhun gyis grub/ /dge sdog thams cad nye bar zhi bas te rang bzhin gyis mtshan ma mi dmigs pa sems kyis de ma bskyed/ /ma skyes pa'i ngo bo 'od gsal sku nyid/ /dngos po kun la 'gro kun snying po yongs la khyab par gnas/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'pho 'gyur mtha' las 'das pa med/ /ba/3)sa nga la lugs 'byung lugs bldog ①gnyis so①/ /pa lnga/'ab tha/ba/sa brtagacad nga/ :she/ /chos kun rgyudaphyi ma nas gnyis su med pa la/ /dngos po rlung sems gnyis su gzung 'dzin sdebartags pa yin/ /don dam mi 'gyur gangazag dang chos kyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /kun rdzob kyi brten rjo'abrel 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba rlung dang sems/ /de las rang bzhin stong pas ma 46byed805

rig 'khor bar 'khrul/ /'khor ba thog ma gser med g.ya'i tshul du med pa nas/ /gzung 'dzin rlung sems rang bzhin dgemi dge lasabasags 'khor 'grobalngar/ /'khrul pa'i lasawos rdo rje rab tu gsungs/ /de la sems nyid ngo bo de/ /don dam dmigs rlungasems med chos nyid stong / /kun rdzob snangab tsam sems nyid gsal stong pa'amarig tsam/ /rlung sems thogam med pa nas lhan cig skyes par 'byung / /bemapo byu/nga gi ngo bo dang po 'khor ba nas tha ma pa gcig tshun chod yod pas gsalal phra/ /rlung gi tshogs drug bems po'i rang bzhin rnam shes g.yo/ /rlung sems btags med gcig la gcig ltos rten 'brel tshul/ /rten 'brel rlung la zhon pas rlung sems gnyis kyis 'khor 'das bskyed / /'khor ba'i spangabyayin rlung sems stong zhing ma 'khrul bas ma rig 'khrul/ /de las kun rdzob milam sgyu ma lta bur las sgrib byung / /rlung sems 'dus ma byas kyi rang bzhin mi shigs ① thig le ste/ /snang stong ngo bo dag par gnas/ /rnal 'byor pas lam du lus ngag sems dben pa gsum dang sgyu mar sbyor/ /'od gsal gnyisamed mthong dang zung 'jug bsgom/ /dugalnga'i rlung sems dri ma zad pa na/ /mya ngan 'das pas thig le skye ba dag /thig le rlung sems dag pa skye ba ma rtogs rnam shes rlung / /bskyod pas gzung 'dzin ⑤ma rig phyi yul shar/ /gzung yul tshogasadrug rnam pa dkar dmar sna tshogs zhen/ /nang du shes bya tshogs drug nang du bdag tu 'dzin par skyes/ /gzung 'dzin bdag dang bdag gir gnyis la gcig ltos pas/ /bag chags lasadang las nyon 'khor ba rgyas/ /'dus byas thams cad mi pa'i chos mi bden bzhin du kun rdzob snang tha snyad du / /phyi'i rlung gis snod kyi 'jig rten kyang / /'byung bzhi la sogs sna tshogs snang / /nang gi rlungagisabacud kyi sems can kyang / /'gro drug skye rga na 'chir snang / /sgod bcud thams cad rlung gis skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa rtena'abal tsam dang / /46byed806

srid pa bar mar longs sku'i tshul du ngo bo nyid kyis rdzogs gnas pa dang / /de las skye ba len pa yang / /mngal skyes sgong skyes drod rdzus skyes/ /de la ①ma las skyes pa yang //bar do'i shes pa rlung dang bcas/ /phama'ipho mo'i 'du 'phro sa bon gnyis/ /bar do'i rnam shes rlung gi ma'imangal du 'phangs/ /skyed pa'i tshe ②nam mkha' las rlung me chu sa 'chags ④zer dang po rlung la byang sems rtenachu ba chags pa zer / /mngal du nar nar gor gor 'khrang 'gyur dang lnga po lte ba snying ka mgrin pa spyi bo thig le mi 'asdo/ra rtsa rnams chags/ /de la gnas skabs lnga rgyu tshogs dupasayan lag tha/sa ngag rgyas/ /zla bcu skye/ rga na 'chi 'chi ba'i tshe sa chu me rlung nam mkhar thim la khraga' / /gsum pa sbyang gzhi'i gnas lugs ni/ /rgyudaphyi ma nas tha mal lus kyi chos la ni—/ /'dod 'dun rjoganod sems gnyid mugs rgod 'gyod ze tshom dri ma lnga rnams gnas pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa'i lam dus na/ /dri ma ye shes dum bur khyiguraganas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni/ /chos sku gzugs sku gnyis chos nyid ye shes thugs rjer gnasarnam pa thams cad mkhyen zer/ /dang po skye buganas 'khor ba nas/ /tha ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar/ /lus dang ngag sems chosathams cad spros dang bral/ /'od gsal zung 'jug rang bzhin rangala'atshang bar gnas/ /de las reshigakun rdzob lus 'di la/ /rtsa rnams brten nas gnas pa brten bya rten byed kyis stong bzhin du sgyu ma mi lam 'am ngo bo dag par gnas yin/ /rtsa yi nang du thig le dkar dmar brten/ /thig le rnams la rlung sems skye med de brten/ /gsal rlung gis ⑦sems bskyod pas gzung 'dzin skye 'gag medarig kun rdzob ngo bo stong / /lusalasems kyi chos nyid bsam stongapa nyid du med/ /'khrul yang kun rdzob snod bcud thams cad rten 'brel dang rang bzhin dag par gnas/ /46byed807

sems can rang byung stong par gnas nam mkha'i khams la gnas/ /ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas gzod nas spros pa zhi bar gnas pas kun rdzob tsam du 'i na sgo / /rang bzhin skyeb med par gnas pas kun rdzob dri/ ma'i lus ngag sems dug lnga'i snang ba/ /rgyulnga dang lam rim lnga ye shes lnga sku lnga'i rang bzhin du ni 'bras bu lnga rgyud phyi ma nas①/ /sbyang gzhi'i rang bzhin lus ngag sems nyams pa nyid snang kyang yang dgos pas lngar gnas te/ /du ma bsdus pa'i lus 'di la/ /rtsa ba'i rlung lngadang yan lag rlung lnga/ /de la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni chos kyi dbyings ye shes/ /srog 'dzin chu rlung snying khar ma shi bar du gnas de bzhin rlung gi rlung 'grin par gyen rgyu dang / /bya grubame rlung me dang mnyam nyid sa rlung mnyam gnas lte bar zas dwang snyigs 'byed thurasel 'doms nas snyigs ma phyir 'dor dang / /namamakha'i rlung khyab byed rlung lus 'gro 'dug nyal ba skad 'don kun lu mnyam nyid yeshes tshig kun la'o/ /spyodabasdus nas yan lag rlung gi dbye ba yang / /mig gzugs dang rna sgrab sna dridang lce romyong/ /de bzhin lus kyi reg dang lnga'o/ /rlung ni bcu po de ①rnams kyis/ /las rnams thams cad byed pa yin skyergas sogs 'khor ba myang 'das thams cad rlung gis byed pa yin no/ /rlung bcu bsdu na 'gro gnas pa 'ong gsum 'bru gsum/ /a thung zhigaral med mi shigs thig le mi 'gyur chos nyid yin yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba khos baspyod pa yin/ /rlung sems 'dus pa'i ngagadabeen a thung de/ /ngagango bo smra brjod bral spros bral nam mkha' ltar bar gnas/ /ngoborang la ye nas rang chas ①gnas/ /de ni ngag dben ngag ma dag par bcings grol med par sbyang gzhi yin/ /tha mal dbang po'i snang ba gsal ba rab 'bring rnam pa gsum/ /de las rtog pa sems byung brgyad cur rjogazung 'dzin skyes/ /lus ngag yid la chags gnas pa/ /gnad ngo bo bde gsal mi rtog dbang po gnyis sbyor dus su 'dus ma byas yin/ /ma shes thabs 46byed808

'khrul rtog sdug bsngal yin/ /'khrulayang sems nyid ye nas dri med stong / /de ni sems rnam dag dbeen sbyang gzhi yin/ /spyir na 'khor ba'i chos rnams kun/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /khyad par 'gro ba mi'i lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rten 'byel stongapasnying po med pa'i lus—/ /khyad par rang bzhin ye nas dag cing 'dus ma byas ye shes re snang tsam sgyu ma dngos rmi lam bar ro/lnga/ yi/sa/ /so sor btags ①min 'dus ma byas 'gog pa dang so sor btags ④pa'i 'dus ma byas 'gog pa dang /nam mkha' 'dus ma byas dang chos nyid de bzhin nyid do/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /rang bzhin med bzhin sna cho1gas 'dus pa chos kun rdzob kyi skye mched do/ /ces so/ /yid khams chos khams yid kyi rnam shes kyi khamasasnang / /de ni sgyu lus sbyang gzhi rnamadag yin/ /snang ba lugs 'jug rgyal dus rtoga'agag dang / /pho mo'i 'khrig mngal gnas dus rlung 'pho'i g.yasagayon dbu ma la dus/ /khyad par bsgomadus 'chi ba'i dus nyid du/ /snang gsum rang bzhin rtog pa rnams/ /stong dang sachumerlung shin tu stong pa dang //gsum pa stong pa chen por 'du/ /phung khams skye mched rlung rnams thim/ /'od gsal chos nyid lugs bzlog gnyis snang gis stong par gnas/ /kun la bcings grol med gnas pas ngo bsgoms na ma shes/ /de ni 'od gsal rnamadag sbyang gzhi yin/ /chos rnams thams cad gnyis su med/ /bar do'i rlung gis sems bskyod pa—/ /grib ma ye shes kyi sku dang 'dra'o/ /gzha' tshon lta bu'i lusasku/ /snang ①stong bden pa gnyis su med/ /de ni bcings grol med ye nas sems can kun la gnas/ /46byed809

zung du 'jug gnyis med pa'i sbyang gzhi rnamadagayin/ /de la sbyong byed bstan pa ni/ /bzhi pa lam gyi rim pa yis/ /'khrul ba skyon thams cad spangs pa lam du bzlog pa ni/ /buta'idus gsum dag gi lam du 'byung //smin grol gnyis su shes par bya/ /de la skyes phyi rol pa nyan rang logs pa min shis 'jigs pa kun/ /rang rgyud le'u bzhi pa brgyad pa bcu bzhi pa bzhin dbang gis smin par byas/ /de nas bsrung ba'i dam tshig le'udagu pa sogs la/ /bya ba ma yin sku'idam tshig mi dge bsdam / /gsung gi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yang bza'/ /srog gcod pa dang ma byin lenathugs kyi gnyis med ye shes bsgom/ /mi tshangs spyod sgyumabardzunadang brdzun du smra'o sems can gyi don du 'gro na bzhi dkar bya mi 'gro na bsdam pa gces so/ /gnyis pa grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /de la re shig rdzogs rims la/ /spyi don gsum du bstan par bya/ /dang po gang zag dbye ba bstan/ /gnyis pa rgyud ①don mdo ru bstan/ /gsum pa rim lnga rgyas par bshad/ /gang zag tha ma 'bring gnyis ni/ /dper na skas kyi rim pa ltar/ /ngagagis dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas/ /bskyed pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa la sogs ④pa rim nas zung 'jug par / /jeg chenadu pa rims kyis sbyangs nas su/ /mthar gyis skad cig zung 'jug mi slo ba pa'i chos sgu thob/ /gcig char lam donagrub ①lta bu ni chos sku thob/ /sngon sbyangs cho gas rdzogs mi rtog mtshan ma rang grol blochen shesarab stong pa'i gyis/ /skad cig la 'bad chemed skye med rtogs/ /yod med mtha'aganyis smra bsam spros pa med dbeenapa gsum / /lus sgyu ma lta bur sgrib pa nyon mongs spangs/ /gang zag bdag med chos kyi bdag 46byed810

meda'od gsal stong nyid rtogs/ /gnyis med dbyings ye shes ting 'dzin dri ma dugalnga phra rags zad/ /chos sku gsum thob nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rim lnga mdor bstan brgyud nas ni/ /rdo rje bzlas pa ye shes che/ /yid 'ong sngags rnams kun bsdus pa'o/ /sems la dmigs pa bdag med pa'o//chos rnams sgyu ma lta bus te/ /thams cad rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gnyis med gnyis su med min zhing / /de skad gsungs pas rim lnga ni/ /rlung bzung 'gro 'ong gnas gsum po/ /'bru gsum tha thung thig ler bsgom/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med dmigs pa zhi/ /mtha' bral snyug ma lhan cig skyes/ /ngag gi brjod bral skye med bsgom/ /sems ni bde gsal stong pas zhi/ /rlung dang sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ /phyi nang bsdus la stong par bsgom/ /'od gsal stong pa chos sku las/ /zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bur langs/ /thams cad zung 'jug sgyu ma ro gcig las/ /snying rje stong pas 'gro don byas/ /thams cad stong par spyod pa byas/ /dri med chos dbyengs mthar phyin pas/ /mya ngan 'das pa tshe 'dir thob/ /chos can ngag dben lta bu yi/ /gcig gi khongs su'ang rim lnga ldan/ /da ni rim lnga rgyas bshad pa'o/ /de la ngag dbeen spyi don lnga/ /dang po ngo bo dbye ba tsam/ /gnyis pa beems po'i rlung la sbyangs/ /gsum pa rlung sems bsgom pa bstan/ /bzhi pa gsal ba'i rlung la bsgom/ /lnga pa 'bras bu bstan pa yin/ /dang po kun rdzob khams gsum rlung / /'gro 'ong gnas 46—811

gsum yig 'bru gsum/ /a thung skye med stong par bsgom/ /don gyi ngo bo dmigs su med/ /brjod dang dmigs par bshad pa dang / /brdar gyur dang ni don dam mo/ /ngag gi sgra yang rlung sems sbyangs/ /rlung la ngo bo dbye ba dang / /nges pa'i khyad par las dang ni/ /rgyu tshul g.yas g.yon dril ba dang / /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i grangs/ /sbyang thebs gsum du shes par bya/ /gnyis pa bems po'i rlung la sbyangs/ /dngos med rten 'byel las byung ba'i—/ /dbugs ni nang du rngubs gyur pa/ /oṃ dang rnam snang skye med gnas//khog pa'i rlung la sems nyid gzung / /rlung de kho ①na gnas pa ni/ /a thung skye med snang mtha' yas/ /rlung ni phyir 'gro hūṃ du bsam/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i mi bskyod spro/ /rlung ni 'byung 'jug gnas gsum mo②/ /rang bzhin lhun grub bzlas pa yin/ /sngags la rnam shes bsdus bsgom pas/ /sems nyid mi rtog bzlas pa yin/ /rtags su rlung rgyu'i grangs shes shing / /me dang rlung dang sa chu'i rlung / /nang nas rgyu ba'i kha dog shes/ /gsum pa rtsa rlung bsgom thabs ni/ /myur dang rnam sdud dal bas sbyangs//myur bas rlung sems phyir spros pas/ /khru gang tsam nas rlung rngubs ④pa/ /'og rlung 'then la steng rlung gnan/ /de ltar rlung sngags byang chub sems/ /mi rtog pa la rab sbyar bas/ /nang du stong nyid ye shes 'phel/ /pho rlung gdul la mo rlung sbyang bu/ /ma ning rlung la sta stangs bya/ /46—812

bzhi pa gsal ba'i rlung la ni/ /mig gi lam nas rgyu ba'i rlung / /hūṃ sems phyi rol rgyu rnams kun/ /mi bskyod sgyu ma'i rnam shes kun/ /gzung bas rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /nang du log pas oṃ sems bsdus/ /sgyu ma'i rnam snang 'dzin med bsgom/ /sems nyid gnas pa skye med a/ /sgyu ma'i snang mtha' gzung 'dzin stong / /de bzhin sna dang lce lus bsgre/ /lus ngag bya bral zhi gnas ni/ /bstan pa je che je che gnas/ /de ltar nyin zhag phrugs gcig la/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung / /nyin mtshan 'gro 'ong gnas gsum 'gag /de ltar yan lag rlung lnga yang / /thig le mi shigs stong par gnas—/ /dmigs med chos nyid rtag tu bsgom/ /de yi 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ /ngag dben rlung sems sbyangs pa yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi yang 'grub/ /ye shes rgyud la skye bar byed/ /mi rtog pa yi chos nyid do/ /dmigs pa med pa'i a thung de/ /bde ba lhan cig g.yos pa spangs/ /gdod nas zhi zhing dri med stong / /chos rnams de lta bur shes pas/ /smra bar byed pa'i brjod dang bral/ /'gro 'ong gnas med rlung sems stong / /rjes shes bde gsal rgya yis gdab/ /sgra rnams brag cha lta bur shes/ /lus ngag dregs pa las sgrib spong / /zhi gnas nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /snod bcud thams cad sgyu mar 'char/ /rang bzhin rtog pa rnam rtog 'gyur/ /thams cad snang stong gnyis med sbyangs/ /de ni ngag dbeen slab bya yin/ /46—813

gnyis pa sems dbeen bslab bya la/ /spyi don rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /dang po sems dben rnam rtog bstan/ /gnyis pa sgrub thabs gsum gyi lam/ /gsum pa dag pa che 'bring bstan/ /bzhi pa zhar 'byung grol lam mo/ /de la sems kyi rnam pa de/ /ngo bo spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan ma med/ /kun rdzob snang tsam gsal rig tsam/ /de la rten nas snang gsum 'byung / /dper na gnyid log sad pa ltar/ /yid kyi rnam shes de nyid ni/ /gsal dang shin tu gsal ba dang / /gsal ba bya ba rdzogs dang gsum / /snang ba gsum po de nyid las/ /dpe ni nyi zla mtshams gsum yin//snang ba gsum po de rnams las/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa brgya bcur 'byung / /nyin mtshan mtshams gsum rtog pa yis/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par byed/ /de nyid thabs kyis bzang rtog ni/ /snang ba gsum dang stong pa gsum/ /chos dbyings stong par sbyar la bsgom/ /ji srid rlung ni mi rgyu na/ /snang gsum rtogs pas mi g.yo bas/ /gnyis pa sgrub thabs gsum la bslabs/ /rtog pa chung bas mu tra la/ /dngos su rten la sems dbeen sbyangs/ /bdag dang mu tra sgyu mar bsgom/ /mkha' gsang byin brlabs snyoms zhugs pas/ /lus rtsa stong phrag bdun cu nas//rtsa nang thig le byang sems rnams/ /'dus nas spyi bor rtsa dbus zhugs/ /yul lnga dbang po lnga la 'dus/ /dbang po lnga yang stong par thim sems snang stong ①par lugs zhugs pas/ /de dus rtog pa 'di tsho 'gag /chags bral dang ni bar bar nyid/ /de bzhin du ni chen po dag /yid la 'gro 46—814

zhing 'ong ba dang / /mya ngan la sogs gsum de bzhin/ /zhi dang rnam rtog 'jigs pa dang / /'jigs pa bar dang shin tu 'jigs/ /sred dang sred pa bar ma dang / /shin tu sred dang nyer len dang / /mi dge bkres dang skom ①pa dang / /tshor dang tshor ba bar ma dang / /shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang / /rig pa po dang rig 'dzin bzhi/ /so sor rtog dang ngo tsha shes/ /snying rje dang ni rtse ba gsum/ /dogs dang bsags pa nyid dang ni/ /phrag dog ces ni bya bar grags/ /rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum gang / /lus can rnams kyis rang rig te/ /kun rdzob tha mal sems 'byung rnams/ /gnyis pa stong nyid skad cig 'gag /dge bde mi rtog stong nyid thim/ /nyams shes zla ba lta bur snang //de bzhin ting 'dzin snyoms zhugs pas/ /byang sems snying khar babs tsam na/ /mched pa shin tu stong par zhugs/ /rang bzhin rtog pa 'di rnams 'gag /'dod chags chags dang de bzhin dgag /dga' ba bar dang shin tu dga'/ /rang dang rab tu mgu ba dang / /ngo mtshar de bzhin rgod pa dang / /tshim dang de bzhin mkhyud pa dang / /'o byed de bzhin 'jibs pa dang / /brtan dang btsod dang nga rgyal dang / /byang dang 'grogs dang stobs dag dang / /spro dang dka' la sbyor ba dang / /de bzhin rkang sbyor bar ma dang / /shin tu dka' la sbyor ba dang / /rnam par sgeg dang zhes / pya'adras nyid/ /dge dang tshig gsal bden pa dang / /mi bden pa dang de bzhin nges/ /nye bar mi len sbyin pa po/ /bkul dang de bzhin dpa' bo dang / /ngo tsha med dang rgyu dang sdug /mi bsrun blupa dang gya gyu nyid/ /rang bzhin bzhi bcu tham pa yis//skad cig gnyis pa mchog dga' bde/ /shin tu stong nyid gsal snang rgyas/ /46—815

nyams snang nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /snang stong dbyer med sbyor ba yis/ /byang sems stong nyid rdo rjer 'dus/ /thob pa stong nyid chen por skye/ /rtog pa 'di rnams chos dbyings zim/ /chags pa bar ma'i skad cig dang / /brjed ngas pa dang 'khrul pa dang / /mi smrar gyur dang skyo ba dang / /le lo de bzhin the tsom bdun/ /ma rig bdun po 'di rnams ni/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /skad cig gsum la khyad dga' bde/ /stong chen mun pa lta bu'i nyams/ /bzhi pa nye bar zhi ba ni/ /rtog pa thams cad kyis stong ngo / /gzung rtog yul dang yul zhen spangs/ /'dzin rtog sems kyi chags sdang spangs//byang sems rtog pas dbeen pa'o/ /stong pa gsum gyis brgyas btabs ①pas/ /sems dang sems 'byung dmigs su med/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal thim gyur pas / /bzhi pa dga' bral lhan cig skyes/ /thams cad stong pas ye shes dag /byang sems bzung bzlog dgram gnas bskyal/ /rjes shes gzugs sogs rab 'bring rnams/ /bde stong nang du mnyam par gzhag /phyag rgya'i bsam gtan 'byongs pa dang / /'dra 'bags lan cig myong la sbyangs/ /sngar bzhin ye shes dmigs la bsgom/ /snang ba mched thob lugs zhugs te/ /rtog pa sum cu bzhi bcu bdun/ /skad cig bzhi dang dga' bde bzhi/ /stong pa bzhi yis rnam dag pa/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pas mtshon bsgom/ /gnyis med gnyis su med par gnas/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu las/ /rjes shes sgyu ma'i tshogs drug po/ /bde stong yul du mnyam par gzhag /dper ⑤na mkha' la sprin byung yang / /de nyid du ni thim pa ltar/ /de bzhin rnam rtog stong par thim/ /de nyid shes na ye shes can/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma rnam par 46—816

spangasarka/ /de ltar sgrubs ①pa gsum po la/ /sems ni de ltar bsgom pa las/ /gsum pa sems nyid dag par 'gyur/ /rab ni tshe 'dir zung 'jug rtogs/ /dbang dang ngo sprod bla mas byas/ /stong pa gsum dang rnam dag pas/ /'od gsal bar ni de bshad do/ /thams cad stong par de brjod do/ /ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pa/ /ye shes dag nas de nyid dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa bla med pa/ /gnyis med mchog tu zhi ba ste/ /yod dang de bzhin med pa dang / /tshig dang yid kyi spyod yul min/ /de bas 'od gsal dag pa las/ /ye shes gsum ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'char duzhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen par de nas 'gyur/ /'bring ni bar dor zung 'jug rtogs/ /'chi kar sgyu lus bsgom pa de/ /mtshams med lnga yis las can dang / /mi gang bsod nams dman pa yang / /yid sbyin nor dang 'dra bar gzhag /bla ma'i drin gyis thob 'gyur te①/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /chags min chags dang bral ba min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /ye shes gsum bral de nyid gang / /thams cad stong par gsungs pa yin/ /dbang po tha ma skye ba'i rgyud/ /ngag dbeen sems dben bsgom pa de/ /bar dor sgyu lus ting 'dzin sbyangs/ /skye ba brgyud nas zung 'jug rtogs/ /de ni rims kyis sa zhes bya// //46—817

bzhi pa grol lam sems dbeen ni/ /sku ni drang po ma yin zhing / /mi drang ba yang ma yin zhing / /lta stangs ldan pas rlung bcings bya/ /sems ni bde gsal stong pa nyid/ /sgyu ma'i lus kyi snying kha ru/ /'khor lo stong pa nyid du bsdu/ /thams cad stong pa rmad po che/ /dngas zhing gsal ba'i ye shes che/ /lnga pa phan yon spyod pa ni/ /mngon shes lnga dang 'gro don byed/ /'dod yon lnga la ci bder spyod/ /srid pa'i gzeb las grol bar 'gyur/ /ye shes me chen nyon mongs sreg /gsum pa sgyu lus bslabs pa ni/ /sa mtshams rnam pa lngar zhes bya/ /dang po rang bzhin sgyu mar bstan/ /gnyis pa sgyu lus dpe la sbyar/ /gsum pa dpe don sbyar la bsgom/ /bzhi pa de nyid bsgom par bya/ /lnga pa zhar la rmi lam sbyangs/ /de la rang bzhin sgyu lus ni/ /rlung gi sbyor ba med par ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bzung du med/ /rlung sems gnyis po rgyu gyur pas/ /las dang skye ba kun tu 'byung / /rlung dang sems kyi rnam 'phrul las/ /rnam shes lus grub sgyu ma'i gzugs/ /'gro ba thams cad sgyu ma yin/ /phyi nang thams cad sgyu ma yin / /srid gsum sgyu ma snying po med/ /de ni rang bzhin sgyu lus so/ /gnyis pa dpe yi sgyu lus ni/ /me long g.ya' dag gsal ba la/ /yi dam gzugs brnyan 'char du gzhug /bstod dmad rtog pa de la med/ /snang la rang bzhin rnged par 'dug /gsal la rtog pa med par 'dug /kha dog sna tshogs gzha' tshon 'dra/ /gnas dang longs spyod thams cad kun/ /46—818

dri za'i grong khyer lta bur bsgom/ /nam ①shes rlung dang bcas pa ni/ /chu yi chu bur lta bu yin/ /mi rtag 'gyur ba glog lta bu/ /g.yo zhing mi bsten ②smig rgyu 'dra/ /du mar snang bas mig 'phrul 'dra/ /rang las gzhan snang brag cha 'dra—/ /med bzhin snang bas mig 'phrul 'dra/ /kun la khyab pas chu zla 'dra//rgyu rkyen bcas pas sgyu ma 'dra/ /sems dang bcas pas rmi lam 'dra/ /gsum pa dpe don bcas la bsgom/ /sgyu ma'i dpe ni de rnams dang / /rnal 'byor dbang pos gang dmigs pa/ /de de sgyu ma bzhin du bsgom/ /snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang / /phung khams skye mched sgyu ma dang / /sems dang chos nyid sgyu ma dang / /dbyer med gnyis gcig stong par bsgom/ /bzhi pa sgyu ma'i de nyid ni/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma la/ /dgag sgrub med par mnyam gnas pa/ /sgyu ma'i snang ba gsum po dang / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin rtogs ④pa rnams/ /khams gsum phyi nang snod bcud kun/ /ci snang sgyu ma'i lus la bsdus/ /sgyu ma'i lus yang stong par bsgom/ /rnam par dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /bsam du med pa'i ngang la gzhag /sgyu mas sgyu mar zlos sems med/ /sgyu ma tsam tu ting 'dzin la/ /zhen par gyur na de yang spangs/ /sgyu ma 'od gsal me yis sbyangs/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol te/ /bden brdzun dag pas don dam yin/ /chos rnams kun la gnas pa med/ /'od gsal thams cad stong pa'o/ /chos rnams ngo bo med pa la/ /yang dag rtogs na stong nyid grol/ /dngos dag kun las rnam par grol/ /46—819

gzugs sgra la sogs sgyu mar spyod/ /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin brtag pa na/ /ngan song mi 'gro sdug bsngal zhig /nyon mongs rags pa cha bris ①nas/ /'od gsal bden pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /sgyu lus nyin par sbyang ⑤thabs so/ /da ni mtshan mo'i sgyu lus sbyangs/ /mtshan mo'i rmi lam sgyu lus bzung / /de la 'dun pa drag po bya/ /rmi lam na ni chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa sgyu mar bsgom/ /de la spro bsdu du ma bya/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rmi lam na/ /snang yang de nyid stong par bsgom/ /log rtog sgyu mar snang ba de/ /ye shes sgyu mar snang bar byas/ /nyams nga bag tsha med pa'i sems/ /rmi lam sgyu ma ltar zhi zhing / /de nyid ye shes slebs pa yin/ /'khrul snang byung na yang yang sbyangs / /dmigs med stong pa'i rgya yis gdab/ /rmi lam snang ba lugs zhugs nas/ /rmi lam dus na 'od gsal rtogs/ /de nyid bar do 'byongs pa yin—/ /gnyid logs sad par gyur pa des/ /sngar kyi rmi lam zin pa dang / /sad pa'i 'khrul snang khyad med bsgom/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing / /'od gsal stong par rang bzhin gnas/ /khams gsum 'khor 'das mkha' bzhin ste/ /sgyu lus nyin mtshan gnyis la sbyangs/ /'chi kar sgyu lus 'od gsal bsgom/ /des ni bar dor sgyu mar dran/ /rmi lam ji bzhin ye shes lus/ /bar dor ①'od gsal chos nyid rtogs/ /mkha' spyod gnas su zung 'jug sbyangs/ /mya ngan 'das pa de yis thob/ /bzhi pa 'od gsal bsgom thabs la/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya'o/ /46—820

dang po mchod dang gsol ba gdab/ /gnyis pa phyi nang byang chub bstan/ /gsum pa bla mas ngo sprod bya/ /bzhi pa nyams blang rgyas par/ /lnga pa gnyid kyi 'od gsal ba'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon drin can la/ /phyi nas gsang ba'i 'dod yon lnga/ /ci 'byor pas ni mchod byas la/ /tshogs kyi dal tu snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /mu tra phul nas gsang dbang zhu/ /bla mas sgyu lus ngo sprad pas/ /yang na ①nam gyi tho ras dus/ /mchod dang gsol btab gzhung bzhin byas/ /gnyis pa phyi nang byang chub ni/ /bla mas 'di skad bshad cing bstan/ /dper na mtshan mo zla ba de/ /sems nyid snang ba'i dpe yin no/ /nyi ma ches gsal mched pa'i dpe/ /nyi zla med pa mtshams kyi smag /mi gsal mun pa thob pa'i dpe/ /nam nangs nyi ma shar ba ltar/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'od gsal dpe/ /de bzhin nang gi byang chub la/ /sgoms pas snang gsum lugs zhugs pas/ /rang bzhin brgyad cu stong par thim/ /rang bzhin dag na 'od gsal mchog /thams cad ma skyes zag pa med/ /zad 'phel yod med tha snyad bral/ /dge dang sdig pa'i gzugs med pas/ /ngo bo nyid dag gos pa med—/ /thams cad stong par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de nyid nyams su len pa la/ /gsum pa bla mas ngo sprod bya/ /dbang ni gsum pa'i dus 'di ru/ /ye shes gnyis med don la blta/ /spros pa mtha' bral stong pa nyid/ /grol lam zung 'jug rba rlabs mnan/ /chags lam mu tra gtad nas su/ /de nas snyoms 'jug bsam gtan la/ /sgod bcud phung 46—821

khams skye mched bsdus/ /sku gsung thugs dang thig ler bsdu/ /dga' ba bzhi dang stong nyid bzhi/ /dpe don 'od gsal skad cig thong ①/ /lugs bzlog rjes shes sgyu mar langs/ /bla mas gdams pa sbyin pa ni/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing / /phung po khams dang skye mched ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med dang mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gzod nas ma skyes pas/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma'i drin thob bsgom bya ba/ /gsal dag 'phra ba mchog tu zhi/ /rang bzhin sangs rgyas myang 'das khams/ /gnyis med rtog bral rtag tu bde/ /rang bzhin de bzhin nyid la ni/ /rtag par rnal 'byor pas bsgom bya/ /bzhi pa nyams blang rgyas par bshad/ /de la nad sel gsum yod de/ /ril 'dzin rjes gzhig rnam gnyis dang / /gsum pa rgyu dag ldang ba'o/ /de la ril por 'dzin pa ni/ /dper na me longs ④has btab bzhin/ /bdag dang phyi nang sgod bcud ①kun/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam snang du/ /rang bzhin med par wal 'tsher bsgom/ /de yang spros med hūṃ du bsdus/ /de yang thig le na bsdar ④bsdus/ /na da rtog med stong par bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang la mnyam gnas pa/ /snang ba mched par lugs zhugs pas/ /rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum thim—/ /mnyam nyid stong pa'i zhi gnas so/ /nyams myong zla ba lta bur 'char//sa rlung chu la thim pa yis/ /nyams su smig rgyu lta bu la/ /'od zer lnga yi tshogs 'byung ngo / /de las snang ba thob pa dang / /chu rlung me la thim pa yis/ /snang ba du ba ltar snang ngo / /de nas phyi nas khams gsum po/ /mtha' yas 46—822

sgyu mar bsdus la bsgom/ /de yang skye med a la bsdus/ /shin tu stong pa dmigs med pas/ /mched pa thob par zhugs zhugs te/ /rang bzhin rtog pa bzhi bcu thim/ /mchog tu bde chen dmigs su med/ /mched pa nyi ma lta bu'i nyams/ /me rlung rlung la thim pa yis/ /srin bu me khyer ltar snang ngo / /nam mkha'i glog ltar dmar khyug 'od/ /yang ni khams gsum snod bcud rnams//mi bskyod sgyu mar bsdus la bsgom/ /de yang rtog med hūṃ la bsdus/ /hūṃ yang thig le stong chen bsgom/ /thob pa lugs su zhugs pa yis/ /rang bzhin rtog pa bdun thim nas/ /shes pa mi gsal mun pa bzhin/ /rlung ni rnam shes la thim pas/ /snang ba mar me lta bur dmar/ /thob pa yang na skad cig dran rdzogs la/ /lus ngag yid gsum stong par bsgom/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /blo btags rags phra'i rtog pa rnams—/ /'od gsal stong pa chos kyi sku/ /gsal dag mchog zhi rnal 'byor yul—/ /smra bsam brjod bral skye ba med/ /bsgom bya bsgom byed gnyis su med—/ /dper na sprin med nam mkha' bzhin/ /'od gsal rang bzhin dri ma med/ /zag med zil gyis mi gnon pa/ /thams cad yod med phyogs las 'das—/ /stong nyid brjod las 'das pa las/ /yi ge med par yi ge bstan//de nyid rgyu dang zung du 'gyur/ /dbang po rab kyis de bzhin bsgom/ /rjes gzhig dbang po 'bring gis bsgom/ /dpe ni chu yi padma bzhin/ /rims kyi sa khams stong pa gsum/ /'od gsal stong par lugs su gzhugs/ /de nas bdag nyid sku gsung thugs/ /sems dpa' gsum rtseg ①bsgom la bsdu//rtog pa sum cu bzhi bcu bdun/ /rims bzhin stong ②dang shin tu stong / /46—823

stong chen bzhi pa thams cad stong / /zla nyi mun dang sa chu me/ /rlung dang rnam shes thim pa'i rtags/ /'od gsal la sogs gong dang 'dra/ /rjes su gzhag pa'i bsam gtan yin/ /mnyam gzhag 'od gsal rtogs pa yis/ /lugs bzlog sgyu ma dag pa'i sku//zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bur bzhengs/ /dbang po yul snang gang byung yang / /sgyu mar snang yang bzung 'dzin med/ /rlung sems dag pas zhing rnams sbyangs/ /snang stong gnyis med ro gcig bsgom/ /ye shes sgyu 'dra dag pa yis/ /rang sems skye med rnam dag pas/ /ta tha'i zhal mthong chos nyan dang / /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sbyin pa gtong / /sems can don tu 'phrin las bzhi/ /dag pa'i chu rlung nyis brgya dang / /nyer lnga'i bar du 'od gsal bsgom/ /sems can nad gdon zhi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin sa me rlung gi rlung / /ser dmar ljang ba dbang rgyas drag /sems can don tu thogs med 'grub/ /'dod yon thams cad stong pas spyod/ /sems can don nyid ma gtogs pa'i/ /khams gsum gnas su skye mi len/ /las nyon sgrib pa rnams spangs te/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug gnyis med thob par 'gyur/ /lnga pa dbang po tha ma yis/ /zhar 'byung gnyid kyis bsam gtan sbyangs//nyin mtshan gnyis la 'od gsal sbyangs/ /'gro ba gang zhig gnyid log pa/ /nang ⑫gsum ngang gis lugs su 'jug /shes pa gnyid du 'gro 'dus su/ /phung khams skye mched dbang sogs rnams/ /shes pa gnyis po de ni thob par legs 'dus nas/ /stong chen gyur la 'gro ba gang zhig gnyid log pa/ /46—824

gnyid du 'gro khar 'di bzhin bsgom/ /sems kyi phyi rol mtshan ma med/ /phung khams skye mched snying gar bsdu/ /mi rtog stong la lhan tser gzhag /phyi nang rtog pas rnam par dben/ /blo ni stong par dmigs med gzhag /gnyid dang stong nyid bsres la nyal/ /gnyid de stong nyid 'od gsal 'gyur/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /bzung 'dzin med pa'i ting 'dzin nyid/ /thob chen phra mos rmi lam snang / /rmi lam rab tu 'od gsal bsgom/ /thob pa gnyid kyi ngang nyid las/ /rmi lam lugs zhugs 'od gsal rtogs/ /rang rig 'od gsal de bzhin nyid/ /gnas med gsal la 'od gsal ba/ /rang bzhin rnam dag rtog med sku/ /'dzin med de bzhin sa le mkhyen/ /gnyid kyi 'od gsal zung 'jug yin/ /ma zhen rnal 'byor rgyun mar sbyangs/ /nam mkha' lta bur skye 'gag med/ /nyin dang mtshan du yang yang bsgom/ /lung ston pa dang 'od gsal mthong /gnyid kyi 'od gsal rtogs pa na/ /rnal 'byer pa de 'chi ba'i tshe/ /snang gsum rang bzhin lugs su 'jug /phung khams skye mched rlung rnams 'du/ /de tshe 'od gsal bsgom par bya'o/ /zhen rtog stong par btsan thabs bcad/ /shi ba stong pa'i 'od gsal rtogs/ /zung 'jug myang 'das des thob po /lnga pa zung 'jug bsgom pa'i lam/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya/ /dang po lta ba zung du 'jug /gnyis pa bsgom pa lam du 'jug /gsum pa 'byel pa zung du 'jug /bzhi pa spyod pa zung du 'jug /lnga pa 'bras bu zung du 'jug /dang po lta ba zung 'jug ni/ /gaṅga'i ①klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /sangs 46—825

rgyas rnams kyis 'di nyid dag /thugs chud yod med phyogs spangs pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid 'grub/ /lta ba thams cad rab spangs pa'o/ /blta ①bya lta byed gnyis su med/ /dngos po 'di rnams ma skyes pas/ /chos dang chos min rnam rtog med/ /chos med chos nyid med pas te/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa/ /chos rnam ④thams cad dngos med cing / /chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam par spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog don dam la/ /byang chub med cing bsgom pa med/ /gnyis med ye shes chos nyid la/ /mtshan mar slob pa zad pa yin/ /chos nyid nam mkha' sma ①bsam med/ /rang bzhin dag pas chos nyid la/ /gnyis med blo ni dbyer mi phyed/ /chos kyi dbyings ni gnas med pa/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' gnas/ /dmigs pa'i mtshan ma bsgom mi byed/ /stong dang nyon mongs stong pas 'joms/ /stong pa yod med mngon zhen na/ /dri ma chen por de nyid 'gyur/ /stong dang mi stong bsam du med—/ /ngo bo gnyis med ye shes nyid/ /spangs thob rnam dag sangs rgyas med—/ /rtag chad skye 'gag mtha' dang bral/ /skye med nam mkha' khas len bral—/ /ste pa zung 'jug bstan pa ni/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog pa gnyis po rnam spangs pa/ /gang du dngos po gcig gyur pa/ /zung du 'jug ces de la bshad/ /kun nyon mongs dang rnam par byang / /don dam nyid du shes nas ni/ /gang gi gcig tu shes gyur pa/ /de ni zung du 'jug par shes/ /dngos po rnams bcas kun rtog dang / /dngos po med par rtog 46—826

pa dag /rnal 'byor pas ni gcig spyad bya/ /de ni zung 'jug shes pa'o/ /bzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa zhes/ /rnam gnyis blo ni yod min gyi/ /gang du mi phyed blo yod pa/ /de ni zung 'jug ces byar bshad/ /rtag dang chad pa'i blo dag ni/ /gang gis spangs nas rab gnas pa'i/ /zung du 'jug pa'i rims 'di yi/ /de nyid shes te mkhas pa yin/ /lhag bcas lhag med rtog med zung / /bdag med rtog gnyis rnam grol zung / /ngag sems sgyu ma 'od gsal ba/ /zung 'jug gnyis med bsam gtan gnas/ /thams cad mnyam gyur zung 'jug pas/ /gnyen po bsgoms pas rtog pa dag /kun rdzob don dam 'dres gyur zung / /de bzhin nyid dang ldan gyur zung / /ma skyes pa'i chos rnams la/ /ngo bo med de bsgom pa med/ /ngo bo nyid ni zhi ba la/ /gnyen po mi rtog mi dmigs pa/ /nam mkha'i lam la mnyam gnas pa/ /zung 'jug bsgom pa'i bsgom zhes brjod/ /mnyam nyid rnam dag zad pa med/ /dngos dang dngos med rnams spangs pa'i/ /dmigs pa med cing rab tu zhi/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong gis/ /thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid la/ /bsgom bya sgom ①byed dmigs su med/ /chos nyid ye shes chung 'bring che/ /khams gsum dri rtog che 'bring 'joms/ /ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pas/ /sa bcu la ni gnas par 'gyur/ /lhan skyes dri ma rims bzhin spong / /gsum pa 'byel pa'i zung 'jug ni/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med zung / /chos nyid spros med ma skyes las/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug zung / /thams cad rnal 'byor stong par gnas/ /gnyid log pa dang rnam 'brel zung //46—827

mnyam par gzhag dang ma gzhag med/ /dngos dang dngos med rnal 'byor zung //dran dang mi dran las grol bas/ /chags dang chags med las grol zhing / /mchog tu bde chen lus dang ldan/ /bya dang mi byed rnal 'byor pas/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis med gcig gyur zung / /dag dang ma dag lta med de/ /gzugs can gnyis spangs nas/ /gang zhig zhi rtog rnal 'byor dbang / /de ni zung 'jug thob pa'o/ /de ltar gang gnas rnal 'byor pas/ /zung 'jug rim la gnas pa ste/ /rang bzhin dag pas dag par gnas/ /thams cad 'byel zhing stong pas khyab/ /thams cad rig yang chos nyid dag /bzhi pa spyod pa'i zung 'jug ni/ /zung 'jug go 'phangs la gnas pa'i//slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che/ /spyod pa de dang gnyis su med/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngags pas seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /'di la mi bya ci yang med/ /'di la mi bza' yod ma yin/ /smra bar mi bya ci yang med/ /rtag tu mi bsam gang yang med/ /mnyam par ma gzhag sbyor ba yis/ /rtag pa nyid du mnyam par 'jog /yul dbang stong par kun tu spyod/ /chos nyid gnyis med 'ba' zhig nas/ /chos sam chos ma yin yang rung / /thams cad nam mkha' lta bur mtshungs/ /dkar po'i chos rnams khong du chud/ /mu mtha' med pa'i nying 'dzin rgyas/ /nyon mongs ma yin ma rig phra/ /slob pa'i zung 'jug mthar spangs pas/ /lnga pa 'bras bu'i zung 'jug ni/ /skad cig chos dbyings de nyid mthong //46—828

rlung sems lugs 'byung lugs bzlog zad/ /snang ba gsum pa rnam dag pa/ /rtog dang nyon sgrib chos dbyings grol/ /skye 'gag chos nyid yang dag dag /spros med rang bzhin ro gcig zhi/ /ye shes dag pas 'od gsal dag /sku dang gsung thugs mkha' mnyam dag /nyon mongs las rnams grol ba yi/ /spangs thob rtag chad skye 'gag med/ /yod med gnyis ka gnyis med min/ /'khor 'das gnyis med dmigs spros shing / /mya ngan 'das med myang 'das zhes—/ /nam mkha' lta bur bcings las grol/ /sna tshogs 'dzin ces brjod pa yin/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba sngon sangs rgyas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor pha rol son//bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas/ /de nyid gnyis med ye shes te/ /chos nyid smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /'di la bsam du ci yang med/ /thams cad stong pa'i chos nyid la/ /bstan par bya ba cung zad med/ /lam gyi chos rnams zad pas te/ /sbar zhing gang la'ang mi slob bo/ /blang dor med cing sangs rgyas med/ /chos kyi sku zhes ming du brjod//thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /da ni 'bras bu'i thob tshul bstan/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa de/ /chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes 'di/ /gnyis med rnam dag ye shes sku/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /dag pa gnyis med ye shes sku/ /sku ni mi 'gyur ma skyes pa/ /gsung dang thugs kyang mtshan ma med/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos skur bzhugs/ /de'i rnam 'phrul gzugs sku gnyis/ /chos 46—829

nyid 'grib pa med par dag /nam mkha' lta bur 'pho 'gyur med/ /chos sku skye med sku de ni/ /gnyis med ye shes ston pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas rnams la chos sku de/ /nam mkha' khyab par gnas pa yin/ /chos nyid rnam par dag pa la/ /bzhengs dang bzhugs pa mi mnga' yang / /chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la—/ /longs sku sprin gzha' lta bu de/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru snang / /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang ba de/ /thugs rje chen po dri med dang / /sngon gyi 0na lam stobs dag gis/ /gdul bya byang chub sems dpa' la/ /longs sku gzha' tshon lta bu de/ /stong gsum khyab par gnas gnas ①su/ /'og min chos kyi pho brang du/ /rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa des/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni—/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i chos gsungs so/ /longs sku de yi phrin ④las las/ /dang po bskyed rims bsgom pa yis/ /'bras bu longs sku mtshan rnams rgyas/ /dang po sdogs rims bstan pa las/ /'bras bu ye shes chos sku thob/ /drug pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ /srid pa tha ma dbang po rab/ /zung 'jug skye med rtogs pa na/ /kun spyod spyad pas shes sgrib spangs/ /mi slob zung 'jug rtogs gyur nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgya'o/ /dper na sbrul gyi shun brjes ltar/ /skye ba gcig la mchog 'grub yin/ /tshe 'dir mnyam par gzhag pa la/ /ngag dben sems dbeen sgyu lus bsgom/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i dus nyid du/ /'od gsal mthong la ma goms na/ /rnal 'byor pa de g.yengs pas khyen/ /sgom dang spyod pa ma khom pas/ /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus 46—830

nyid du/ /snang gsum lugs su 'jug pa dang / /phung po khams dang skye mched sogs/ /rnam shes rlung dang bcas pa thim/ /phyi dbugs chad de nang dbugs gnas/ /sngar gyi sgom pa'i 'od gsal dang / /shi ba stong pa'i 'od gsal gnyis/ /chu la chu bzhin gnyis med 'dres/ /bar dor 'od gsal skye med rtogs/ /bar dor sgyu ma dag pa langs/ /gzha' tshon lta bu'i ye shes sku/ /zung du 'jug pa de langs nas/ /bar do'i yul lnga stong par bsgoms/ /'dzam bu gling ni phrag brgya ru/ /sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /gdul bya gang mos bsam pa la/ /de dang 'thun pa'i chos ston no/ /sku gsum don dam ro gcig yin/ /kun rdzob tsam du sangs rgyas de/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du//ji ltar mkhyen pa'i ye shes la/ /gang gi rlung gi sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor/ /phrin ①las sprul sku sgyu 'dra las/ /ji snyed pa yi ye shes kyis/ /kun la khyab cing sprul pa 'gyed/ /gdul bya dag pa gzhan snang la/ /'khor dang myang 'das mkhyen bzhin du/ /de yi chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /dper na 'dam gyi padma bzhin/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos so/ /dper na yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /'bad pa med par 'gro ba 'dren—/ /ye shes sprul sku longs sku rnams/ /chos kyi sku la brten dunas su/ /chos sku gang la'ang mi gnas so/ /mthar thug pa la brjod du med/ /bar dor zung 'jug mi slob thob/ /bar dor rdzogs par sangs rgya'o/ /tshe 'dir sgyu lus rtogs pa na/ /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus nyid du/ /snang gsum ngag gis lugs su 'jug /'chi ba shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'dun pa drag pos rjes dran bya/ /phung khams skye mched yul dbang 'dus/ /snang gsum 'od 46—831

gsal rtogs na rab/ /'od gsal rtogs par ma gyur na/ /tshe 'dir sgyu lus bsgom pa de/ /bar dor sgyu lus ngos zin te/ /bar dor sgyu lus 'od gsal sbyangs—/ /gal te skye ba len na yang / /rang dbang yod pas lus len no/ /'gro ba'i don byed chos sgrub lus/ /de lta bu ru lus blangs la/ /'gro don byas la mchog sgrubs ①pas/ /mngon par byang chub thob 'gyur ro/ /skye ba brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /de ltar rab kyis tshe 'dir thob/ /'bring ni bar dor 'grub pa las/ /tha ma skye ba brgyud nas thob/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag kha che'i paṇḍi ta na ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ dpal na ro pa chen po dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis/ dpal pu la hā ri me tog brtsegs pa'i dgon par gus shing legs par bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o// //āo phag shi dzee/ rgya rgya rgya/ spya/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag phyin ci ma log pa 'di ni arya bra bha pesgo pas dpal dge sding gi gtsug lag khang du bris so// //46—832

༄ga /rjal 'byir yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba/①༄na rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣaḍaṅga yo ga nā ma/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sor bsdud de bzhin bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol dang ni 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces pa mdor bstan tshig dang ni/ /rgyas par bshad pa'i tshig dka' stsal/ /dbang po bcu yi don rnams ni/ /rang gis ②'jug gnas thams cad las/ /so so so sor 'dod pa bsdud/ /so sor bsdud ces smra ba'o/ 1 /'dod pa lnga po mdor bsdu na—/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rab sbyor phyir/ /rtog pa bsam gtan brjod bya ste/ /bsam gtan de ni rnam lngar 'gyur/ /rtog pa dang ni dpyod pa dang / /dga' dang bde ba de bzhin du/ /sems kyi rtse gcig nyid dang ni/ /'di 46byed835

lngas bsam gtan bsdus pa'o/ /gsang ba gsum la rtogs pa dang / /rnam par dpyod pa de 'dra thob/ /dga' ba 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /bde bas bsdus pa bzhi pa'o/ /shes dang shes byar byung ba spang / /rang sems lnga par shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung bzhi pa①/ /nam mkha' kun la rab tu gnas/ 2 /ye shes lnga las byung ba'i dbugs④/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /gong bu'i gzugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /padma sna rtser rtog par bya/ /rin chen chen po kha dog lnga/ /srog rtsol zhes ni bya bar dran/ /rang sngags snying khar bsam nas ni/ /srog ni thig ler son par bzhag 3 /rang nyid dbang po rin chen la/ /'gag pa bzung bya 'dzin par dran/ 4 /'gog pa rdo rjer song sems la/ /mtshan ma'i snang ba skye bar 'gyur/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga de ni/ /byang chub rdo rjes gsungs pa yin/ /dang po mig rgyu'i rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba'i rnam pa'o/ /gsum pa mkha' snang rnam pa dang / /bzhi pa sgon ma ltar 'bar ba/ /lnga pa nam mkha' sprin med pa/ /lta bur snang ba dam pa'o—/ /brtan gyur rdo rje'i lam nas ni/ /nam mkha'i khams su spo ①bar bya/ /gang zhig sgom pa rjes dran pas/ /de yi rnam pa spro bar bya/ /rjes dran zhes byar shes bya'o/ 5 /de las so sor snang ba skyed/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pas/ /dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pa/ /gong bu'i sbyor bas bsdus nas ni/ /dbus su gzugs brnyan sgom par bya/ /yud kyi ye shes rdzogs 'gyur ba/ /ting 'dzin zhes byar 'du shes so/ 6 /rgyas par bshad pa la so sor bstan par bya ba'i phyir du/ dbang po 46—836

bcu'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ dbang po rnams dang / dbang po'i don rnams la/ dbang po bcu po de rnams kyi rang gi yul dang yul can gyi 'jug pa ji lta bar rang nyid kyis bzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin gyis rab tu 'jug pa'o/ /de la gnas pa ni rang gi 'jug pa la gnas pa'o/ /thams cad la dman pa dang 'bring dang mchog gi dbye bas so so so sor 'dod pa bsdud pa ni/ 'dod par byed pa dang mngon par chags par byed pa zhes pa'o/ /'dod pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa la de rnams kyi dbang po rnams kyis so/ /gang so so so sor slar nas slar du bsdud par byed pa de ni so sor bsdud pa zhes bya ba'o/ /yan lag dang po'i so sor bstan pa'o/ /gang so sor bsdud pa rnam par spyad pa'i ched du yan lag gnyis pa gsungs te/ 'dod pa lnga zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /'dod pa lnga ni gzugs la sogs pa rnams dbang po rnams kyi yul du gyur pas bsdus pa las te/ dbang po rnams dang ngo bo gcig pa nyid las so/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni mig la sogs pa'o//de rnams kyis yang dag par sbyor ba ni bskul ba la ste/ sangs rgyas lngar rab tu sbyor ba las so/ /de bas na gzugs la sogs pa rnams kyang sangs rgyas lnga'o/ /zhes pa de ltar rnam pa gang gis yongs su dag pas rtog pa de ni bsam gtan no/ /de yang rtog pa la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnam pa lngar 'gyur te/ rtog pa dang ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni de'i dbye ba brjod pa'o/ /gsang ba gsum la zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/ dbang po dang yul dang rnam par shes pa rnams ni gsang ba gsum mo/ /dbang po lnga dang / dbang po'i shes pa rnams dang / de'i yul 46—837

ba rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid yin no/ /zhes gang yongs su shes pa de ni rtog pa'o/ /de nyid la gang rnam par spyod pa ni gnas pa la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /de ltar rnam par spyad nas/ de kho na nyid la rab tu 'jug pa la mngon par phyogs pas yid bde ba nyid kyi mtshan nyid can gang yin pa de ni dga' ①ba 'dra ba'o/ /de kho na nyid la mngon par zhugs pas lus shin tu sbyangs pa la sogs pa'i bde ba thob pa gang yin pa de ni bde ba bsdus pa'o/ /'di ltar goms pa rab kyi mthar thug par son pas shes pa ste/ mig la sogs pa drug gi 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa dang / shes bya ni gzugs la sogs pa nas chos kyi khams kyi mthar thug par ro/ /byung ba ni shes dang shes byar ro byung ba'o/ /de spang ba ni rang gi sems so/ /sems kyi gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i stong pa nyid yongs su shes pa'i mtshan nyid can ni/ sems rtse gcig pas na rang gi sems shes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i sems kyis rnam pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung zhi ba ste/ snang ba tsam dang thams cad stong pa gcig tu nges pa skye bar 'gyur ro zhes pa ni dbye ba lnga ste yan lag gnyis pa'o/ /ye shes lnga las shes bya ba la sogs pa la/ me long la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi 'og gi dbugs te/ de nyid 'jug pa la sogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ rang gi rdo rje'i bu kha nas byung nas padma'i sna'i rtse mor gong bu'i gzugs kyis te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi jig le'i gzugs kyis bsam par bya'o/ /de nyid steng du 'jug pa'i dbugs kha dog lnga pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid can te/ de nyid ni rin chen chen po'o/ /srog ni 'tsho ba'o/ /46—838

rtsol bar bya ba ni ring du spro bar bya ba gang yin pa'o/ /de ni srog rtsol zhes bya bar dran pa ste shes par byas pa las/ de nyid 'jug pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi thig les nyin dang mtshan du goms pa las byung ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rang sngags snying khar ni/ rang gi snying ga'i ①padma dkar po la bsams nas/ srog ni thig ler son par bzhag ces bya ba mi shigs pa gtogs par dgod par bya ba ste—/ yan lag gsum pa'o/ /rang nyid dbang po zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ rang nyid ni gzugs la sogs pa la/ rang nyid ni gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams so/ /dbang po ni mig la sogs pa'o/ /de la rang nyid dbang por 'gag pa ste thim pa'o /de'i rjes su yul dang dbang po'i gzhir gyur pa'i rin po che ste/ sems kyi rin po che la srog snertsol dang lhan cig pas 'gag pa ste nub par gyur pa'i gzung bya gang yin pa de ni 'dzin pa'o/ /de gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba ste/de dag ni 'dzin par bshad pa'o zhes pa yan lag bzhi pa'o/ /'gog pa rdo rjer son sems la/ mtshan ma yongs 'dzin skye bar 'gyur zhes bya ba la 'gog pa'i rdo rje ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /de las skye bar 'gyur na ni sems mtshan ma yongs 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshan ma yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ mtshan mar snang ba'o/ /skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ bskyed par 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /mtshan ma rnam pa lnga de ni/ /byang chub rdo rjes gsungs pa yin/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sa chu la thim par 'gyur ba las mtshan ma dang po smig rgyu'i rnam par snang bar 'gyur 46—839

ba'o—/ /de bzhin du chu me la thim par 'gyur ba las/ gnyis pa du ba'i rnam pa lta bu'o/ /me rlung la thim par 'gyur ba las gsum pa mkha' snang gi rnam pa snang ba'o/ /khams phra mo kun du snang ba gsum du son pa las/ bzhi pa sgon me lta bur snang ba'i tshogs kyi ngo bo nyid do/ /rang bzhin kun tu snang ba la thim par gyur pa las ni/ lnga pa nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu'i snang ba dkar po nyid kyi 'od gsal ba tsam du 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma lnga po de dag gis ni mya ngan las 'das pa rab tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /ji skad du las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa las gsungs pa/ dang por sa ni chu la thim/ /chu yang me la zim par 'gyur/ /me ni rlung la thim 'gyur zhing / /rlung yang rnam par shes la 'jug /rnam shes bzung bar song ba nyid/ /de nas 'od gsal 'jug par 'gyur—/ /zhes so/ /brtan gyur zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ brtan gyur ni rnam par dag par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje'i lam nas 'da' bar mi bya ba'i mtshan ma lnga'i rim pas 'od gsal du rab tu 'jug pas sems ni nam mkha'i khams su spro bar bya zhing / chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin kyis khyab ①par bya'o/ /'di ltar bdag nyid 'od gsal du song bar bsgom par bya ba ste mngon sum du byas la/gang sngon rjes su dran par byas nas smig rgyu la sogs pa'i rnam pas yang dag pa'i mtha' thob pa de'i rnam pa yis so/ /de nyid kyi rim pas spro bar bya ste bskyed par bya'o bar ma chad du smras pa de dag ni yan lag lnga las rjes su dran pa zhes bya bar rtogs shing shes par bya'o zhes yan lag lnga pa'o/ /de las so sor snang ba skye zhes te/ 'dir rjes su dran pa'i yan lag las 46—840

so sor snang ba skye bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /dngos po thams cad ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba'o/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms ①'jug pa ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sbyor bas gnas pa'o/ /gong bu'i sbyor ba ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin gyis gcig tu byas nas bstan pa dang g.yo ba de'i dbus su zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gzugs brnyan rnam par bsgom par shes par bya'o/ /rim pa 'di'i yud kyis te skad cig mas ye shes rdzogs par byed pa ni/ ye shes kyi sku rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /de ni nying nge 'dzin zhes bya ba yan lag drug par brjod par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba/slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chos rje'i bkas bskul ba las/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ba na ratna'i zhabs dang / stag tshang lo tsā ba 'jam dpal ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// //shubhasmastu sarba dza ga tai/ 'di'i rgyud pa ni sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang /'phags pa klu sgrub/ nā ga bo dhiḥ/ tsand+ra kinti/ ārya de ba/ shākya rakṣi taḥ/ ratna mitraḥ—/ dharma bha draḥgu ṇa ma tiḥ/ mdzi shrī dzñā naḥ/ a mo gha shrīḥ/ spru ra ma tiḥ/ pi dza ya tītīḥ/ ba ra pradzñā dharma bhadraḥ/ shrī bhadāḥ dharma pā laḥ/ shākya dhwa dzaḥ ba gi shwa ra kistoḥ/ ratna kirnyiḥ/ ma hā sba bir shī ban ratnaḥ/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/shrī ba na ratna/ gnam gang rin po che/ des bdag dharma burnyi la'o// //sdo rje 'chang dbang slob dpon klu sgrub dang / /klu yi byang chub dang ni 'phags pa lha/ /zla ba grags pa shākyas 'tsho ba dang / /rin chen bshes gnyen chos kyi bzang po dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs/ /46byed841

don yod dpal dang dpa' bo'i blo gros can/ /rnam rgyal grags pa chog shes chos bzang dang / /dpal bzang po dang chos kyi skyong ba'i zhabs/ /shākya rgyal mtshan ngag gi dbang phyug grags/ /rin chen grags dang paṇa chen rin po che/ /dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rgyal po ste/ /gsang 'dus sbyor drug rgyud la phyag 'tshal 61ske/ / //bsdur mchan/835 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stogo/836 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ge ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dbyugs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉spro/ du〈〈pe 〉〉ste/838 ①〈〈pe 〉stanaku'/839 ①〈〈pe 〉skaba'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉srogs/84༷ ①〈〈pe 〉skamad/841 ①〈〈pe 〉ṅkapar/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2593)46wa 842

rnam par bshad pa/①to de kho na nyid rin po che snang ba'i rnam bshad bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tad twa rad na ā lo ka bya khya na/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid rin po che snang ba'i rnam par bshad pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsung gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpe med ces bya ba la sogs pa la/ gang gis phyag na pad ma bsnams pa de ni/ phyag na pad ma ste bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ste/ de rgyal gyur cig ces bya bar sbyar ro/ /khyad par ci lta bu zhig dang ldan pa ce na/ dpe med ces bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ dpe med pa dang shin tu bdagadon gyi rgya nom pa nyid dang / 'daramaka ya che ba nyid dang /gzhan gyi don tu ba pa ka ya 'khor ba'i mtha'i bar du gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi chos dang ldan pa ste/ gzhan dag la med pa'i phyir ro/ /gang gi rang bzhin bde ba nyid kyi ngo bo dpe dang bral bar gyur pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /gzhan yang 46byed843

khyad par ji lta bu zhig dang ldan zhe na/ dpal ste bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ de'i gnas ni gang gi gzhir gyur pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /chos kyi sku'i ngo bo nyid kyis kun tu 'gro ba nyid yin pa'i phyir so sor nges pa'i gnas med pas na gnas med pa'o/ /yang khyad par ci lta bu zhig dang ldan ce na/ dpe med te gzugs mchog tu gyur pa dang na tshod dang /sgeg pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin dang / snying rje chen po la sogs pa dang ldan pa nyid kyis na dpe las 'das pa'o/ /gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa nas sgol ma'i mthar thug pa lha mo bcu'i ngo bo rig ma'i 'khor rmis bskor ba gang la yod pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /rang snang ba'i ngo bo rig pa ste shes rab dang lhan cig 'jug pa'i phyir rig pa dang bcas pa'o/ /srid pa gsum ni srid pa gsum na gnas pa'i skye bo'o/ /gang la phan pa ni ma 'ongs pa'i phan pa ste/ sangs rgyas nyid la sogs pa dang / de la bde ba ni bde ba ste/ 'khor lo bsgyur ①ba nyid la sogs pa'o/ /de thob pa ni rnyed pa ste/ mngon sum du byas pa'o/ /de dag gi rgyu mdzad pa gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos nyid kyi mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid brnyes pas rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir 'gyur ba med pa yin te/de lta bu'i khyad par can gyi bcom ldan 'das rgyal bar gyur cig ces pa'o/ /dus ji srid du ce na/ ci srid re bar snang ba zhes bya ba smos te/ kapare ba'i ngo bo'i sgra ni phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i akaparang gi ngo bo'am/ yang na re ba ste sems can thams cad srid pa'i longs spyod la sred pa'o/ /re ba snang ba ni gsal ba ste/ rab tu 'jug pa/ rab tu skye ba'i bar du'o/ /de srid bcom 46—844

ldan 'das rgyal bar gyur pa ste/ khyab tariha ra 'jug dang lha chen po dang /tshangs pa la sogs pa thams cad las khyad par du 'phags par gyur pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de la dpe med bde ba'i ngo bo zhes bya ba 'dis ni rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /dpal kyi gnas gyur ces bya ba 'dis ni/de'i thabs yin te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dag ni dpal kyi sgras mngon par brjod pa'i phyir ro/ /srid pa gsum la phan pa dang bde ba thob mdzad ces bya ba 'dis ni gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bstan to/ /dpe med lha mo bcu'i ngo bo'i rig ma dag dang rig par bcas zhes bya ba 'dis ni de'i thabs yin te/ de lta bu'i lha mo bcu dang dam pa'i sku mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i rnam pas stong na/ gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa thams cad du mdzad pa'i mthu mi mnga' ba'i phyir ro—/ /dpal ldan sngags kyi gzhung lugs zhes bya ba'i sgras/ rnal 'byor rgyud spyir brjod par byed pa yin du zin kyang / shugs kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa yongs su gzung bar bya ste/ gzhan dag la don bzhi pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /lhag ma ni go sla'o/ /slob dpon du ma'i man ngag gis yongs su dkrugs pa'i rnam par 'khrugs pa rnam par bkab pa ste bdun gyi dbye bas zhes bya ba ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi slob dpon du gtogs pa'i man ngag gi tshogs yang dag par bsdus pas so/ /gsal bar rtogs par bya ba'i phyir—/ zhes bya ba ni bde bar gsal bar khong du chud par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /de nyid zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ mu stegs can gang la kun nas 'khrul pa ste/ rnam par 'khrul pa'i blo shes rab kyi bye brag yod pa de 46—845

la de skad ces bya'o/ /mu stegs can de dag thams cad bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i leng tog gis blo yi dmig khebs par gyur pas/ de kho na nyid ni 'di'am—/ bsgrub par bya ba ni 'di'o zhes de kho na nyid dang bsgrub par bya ba de'i rang gi ngo bo gang yin pa rig cing khong du chud pa la de dag 'khrul pa'o/ /lhag ma ni go sla'o/ /gal te de kho na nyid dang bsgrub par bya ba dag la ni blang bar bya ba nyid du ngo bo nyid gcig pa ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir de kho na nyid dang bsgrub par bya ba dbye ba bstan ce na/ de ni bden pa ma yin te/ de kho na nyid blang bar bya ba nyid yin yang bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang btang snyoms la sogs pa so sor snang ba'i tshogs ma lus pa la khyab par byed pa yin la/ bsgrub par bya ba yang mngon par 'dod pa ma yin pa las bzlog par 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid kyis 'bras bu blang bar bya ba nyid yin yang srog chags thams cad kyis gdon mi za bar bsgrub bya ba ma yin pa las bzlog pa bsgrub par bya ba nyid du mngon par 'dod pa'i phyir nyes pa med do/ /de la rig byed kyi mthar smra ba'i mngon par 'dod pa'i sgrub par bya ba ni/ dga' ba'i ngo bo zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid ni rtag tu bde ba'i rang bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rang rig pa ni gsal ba'i ngo bo nyid kyis bdag nyid rab tu snang ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba ni/ mi rtag pa nyid kyis bskyod par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /zhi ba ni nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pas stong pa nyid du yongs su brtags pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa de lta bu bsgrub par bya ba la 'dun pa ni 'dod pa'o/ /gang nyan thos dang bcas pa'i 'jug pa'i rang rgyal ba ni bse ru lta bu ste/ gcig pu rgyu ba dang / tshogs kyi spyod pa'i rang sangs 46—846
