mthong na/ /gal te 'khrul gyur ma yin na/ /lo gsum 'das nas 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /lusasnying ga rkang pa bkrus ma thag /bskams na zla ba gcig na 'chi//rang gi bzhin mi sdug par snang dri nga ba/ /snasadrimizhim pa byung na nyin zhag gsum na 'chi/ /nyi ma tsha ba'idus su bar chu yis ni/ /kha'i nang ni bkang nas kyang / /nyin re phusanam mkha' la kha bru gtor ni 'debs pa na/ /rims kyis de dbus gnas pa yi/ /lha'idabang po'i gzhu ni khadogasna tshogs paramathong na/ /skyes bu rtag tu tshe ring yin//zla drug na'achibs tshe yod de mi mthong / /de ltar mtshan ma sna tshogs nyid bshadado/ /mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su ni/ /nyi ma tsha ba la nyi ma phyed na nam mkha' la ltas ①pas 'di mthong mu tig phreng ④ba chad 'dra ba'i/ /mu tig rdog mas brgyan pa ni/ /nyi ma gsal ba'i tshe na mthong / /mthon ka'i nor bu'i mdog 'dra la/ /skra shad 'dzings pa lta bur ni/ /mthong ba'i phyogs nas 'phos nas ni/ /phyogs gzhan du ni 'gro ba dang / /klu ni du ma sgrulamangapo gcer ba dang / /rtag tu mthong bar gyur pa yin/ /de ma mthong na zla drug gis/ /'chi ba ru ni nges par bsgrags/ /zla ba shar ba'i snga dro'am yang na phyi dro 'am/ /zla zer dag la yun ring du/ /dpung pa brkyang ba'i rkang lag thang sha bcad la grib ma la/ /yunaring du blta ste rims kyis mkha' la mig bteg la blta/ /der yang namamakha' la grib ma mi gzugs ni/ /grib ma skya bo mthong 'gyur la/ /de'i mgo bo ma mthong na/ /lo gcig gi ni nang du 'chi/ /lag pa g.yon pa ma mthong na/ /bu dang chung ma brlag par 'gyur/ /lag g.yas ma mthong ba yis kyang / /pha dang spun zla tshogs chen 'chi/ /dpyid dka'i nyin ①— lnga lag gnyis pus mo'i steng bzhag pa/ /byas nas spyi bor thal sbyar ba la nyi ma la blta/ /de nyid rjodabus na chu shing gi/ /ྈlcags 'bras bu lta bu'i grib ma 46—1061

mthong / /gang tshe de las 'dab ma gcig /yongs su kha bye snang gyur pa/ /nges par tshes ni de nyid kyi/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni rlungasna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i dus nyi ma'i lam 'gro las/ /rja ba mashaṃ dang mirge la ni/ /rghaṃ dang bye ba de bzhin 'od/ /gsum po 'di dag labartag par bya/ /mdor rgyas rna ba shin tu dam ltebalhebapor dgag /zab cing 'ur 'ur sgra grags pa/ /nyin zhargo rghaṃ 'am babye 'am ni/ /brtse lnga nyin zhag snye shu 'am/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga nyid kyi ni—/ /bar du thos par ma gyur na/ /marde' lnga'i brda' dang bye mtsho bzhi ste phyogs bzhi/rdul mun pa snying stobs gsum yon taṣpe rdul mun pa snying stobs gsum/ mirge gnyis/ zlalong gcigagi brda' go rim bzhin du 'chi/ /'di rnams kyi yang bar rnams su/ /zhag drug tu ma thos na la sogs pa bla ma'i zhal nas zhag lnga nas bcu'i bar la bzhi la sogs pa lhag par zhag bcu drug po 'di la 'chi bltas mi brtag ste dor bar bya zer bas so/ /de yang zhag lnga ma thos na 'chi bltas yin gyi drug la sogs pa ma thos na nad khams la sogs pa yin no①/ /de nas lhag nas bcu ma thos na 'chi ltas sneso/ /des 'dre'o lho ba ni de rnams 'dor lugs de ltar 'dod pa la de rnams kyi bar yang nad khams ma yin te 'chi ltas bskyed pa dang dbri ba'i sgo nas brtsi'o/ /nyin zhag bcu drugag lnga nas bcu'i bar du bzhi bcu nas bco lnga la bzhi bco lnga nas nyi shu la bzhi nyi shu nas nyer lnga'i bar la bzhi ste bcu drug dor bar kabya/ /dor ba de galo nyid zla bgasum la bya kyi ni bzhi cha yi / /khago rims bzhin du zhagare re bskyed pas dazi zer bas lo lngar zla ba gsum ma tshang bas so//zhag gcig tu ma thos na lo drug na 'chi ba la sogs par yang shes par bya'o/ /spyi bo'i steng nas byung ba yi/ /du ba'i 'phreng zhag bdun ni/ /gang gis mthong bar ma gyur te/ /lo gsum nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur①/ /rang mig dag gi phyogs bzhir ni/ /sor mos bsnan na byi la yi/ /mig dang 'dra ba dmaradakyil dkyil snang ba ni/ /yud kyis 46byed1062

rim pas mthong bar 'gyur/ /ma btsir bar yang de mthong na/ /zhag brgyad na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'di dag spyir ni shes bya ste/ /khyad par 'di yang brjod par bya/ /mig g.yon pa byeba'i steng nas gtsir bas 'og dang de bzhirde 'og nas btsang bas steng / /sna'i ngos nas btsir bas rna ba rna ba'i ngos nas gtsir bas sna dang nye ba ni/ /sna ba ma mthong mdor bsdu na/ /drurgo gsurmi ①gnyipre gcirge zla bas 'chi/ /nyi ma 'ang zera'am gal te zla ba yi/ /mig g.yas pa'i 'tshir lugs g.yon pa dang 'dra de ma byung na rim gyur de tshe snga ma bzhin/ /phyogs bcu'ibarda' marde' yon tarde mirge gi ni/ /nyin de rnams zhag rnams su 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang gi rang bzhin gshis bzang gshis ngan du song ba 'am ngan pa bzang por 'gyur ba las/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sna'i rtse mo sngar mthong ba las phyis ma mthong na/ /zla ba lnga na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rna ba gnyis ni don med par 'on gyur na/ /zla ba bzhi ni 'das nas 'chi/ /dbang po bde b.raganas pa'i 'phrodalas lus sa la 'gyel na/ /zla ba gsum na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /smin ma' mas bar du la la mi 'ong snangal la sprid pa yong ba'i dus su 'od shin tu mun nag la bltas na 'od yod pa de ma mthong na/ /zla ba gnyis na gshin rjes mthong / /'khrig pa'i 'bras bu rligapa chung ngu song ba zad gyur na/ /zla gcig 'das nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi mig la gzugs bsnyan khruganyis/ /ma mthong zla ba byed na 'chi/ /na tsha med par lce ni bskyod par mi nus na/ /zhag bcu nas ①'chi bar 'gyur/ /lte ba mdog 'gyur na tsha med pa la lte ba skrangs dun zhag lnga nas/ /'chi bdag dang ni phrad par 'gyur//rtsibs logs gnyis nas na tsha lhangs lhangs pa pyagrangs snyam na/ /zhag gsum na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /khams bde ba'i dus su lus glo bur du kun rengs par gyur na ni/ /46—1063

zhag cig na ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /phra bar gnas pa'i ri mo gnyeramagasum/ /'phral du med gyur zhag ni gsum na 'chi/ /der gnas pa'i lce'u chung grebani/ /mu zi ma btang yang skam pa reg pa mi tshor bskams par ni/ /nyin zhag lnga'i bar gyur te/ /nyin zhag lnga bcu dag na 'chi/ /ro ni skyur ba ches pa kha ches pa tsha ba mngar ba lan tshwa la sogs dang / /kha dog las ni sngo ser dmar ljang gnag sogs su/ /khu ba gci ni 'gyur ba las/ /zla ba drug na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /cig car rgyun ni gcin kha lnga po ru/ /g.yon nas 'khor zhing dri nga bar/ /gang gi gcin ni byung gyur pa/ /de ni zla ba drug na 'chi/ /zla ba yar ngo mar ngo la/ /gal te khu ba byang sems bton la blta' nag por gyur/ /'on te slar gso ma byas na/ /zla drug nang du 'chi bar 'gyur / /nag po'i cha ni yongs spangs te/ /bluthabasadakar po'i cha nas blangs nas su/ /lus las byung ba'i drod tsam bsros la sgyu lus snum byugs pa'i nang du blugs te sna khu/nga g.yon nas rlung rgyu'i tshe/ /bcug nas grogs kyi g.yas nas rlung phu bas phul slar gsor 'gyur ba yin / /rang gi lus ni bstan ①gyur kyang / /gal te grib ma yo na por byung na ni//zla ba bzhi na 'chi 'gyur zhes/ /lung la mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /grib ma lho phyogs 'gro bar ni mi srid pa las/ /gal te gzhan gyis ma mthong bar bdag nyid kyis mthong na/ /bdag ni de nyid 'chi'o ②zhes/ /de ltar mi rtag pa nyid du brtags mthong / /don med pa dang blu ba dang / /log pa la sogs par bshad pas/ /rmi lam thams cad bden min yang / /de la ma dad rigs ma yin sngags pas yid ches par bya/ /yi dam lha la gsol ba btab pa'i rmi lam dag tu lha mthong dang / /yang na rang bzhin rno ba rmi lam bden mthong rmis/ /rmi lam yid ches byas nas su/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma blta bar bya/ /rgya skyegs kyi shing dang ko pi da ra shingaming dang dmarapo/ /46byed1064

ka ra bee ra'i me tog dmar po rgyasapa'i shing la 'dzegs na/ /rmilam mthar gnyid sad khar mis pa ni gang zhig 'dzeg /nas phyir ma log pa'i 'phro las ngan de ni zla ba drug na 'chi/ /mi ni gang zhig rmi lam mthar/ /sad khar mis pa la rtags yod lha khang gi ni mchod sdong ngam/ /bye ma'am thal phung la 'dzeg pa/ /de ni snga ma bzhin zlabadrug du 'chi/ /bong bu grwa ba la ni zhon nas su/ /lho phyogs su ni rab song nas/ /slar yang ldog pa misan thubapar ma gyur parasad na/ /de'i srogs kyang de bzhin no zabadrug/ /gang yang spre'u la zhon nas/ /lho phyogs su ni 'gro byed cing / /der slar ma log par gnas bzhin du sad na ni/ /de ni snga ma zlabadrug bzhin du 'chi/ /shing rings srogs shing mchod rten nam/ /grog ma'ikhar phyag dar nganaparakhrod phung la/ /mi ni gang zhigaspungs pa la 'dzeg gyur pa/ /de ni zla drug las mi 'tsho/ /bu mo khadoganag mo gos nag po gyon pa rab khros nas/ /gang zhig bcing las rtogs byas de na ①bas 'chi ba ni/ /de ni gshinarje'i chung ma dus mtshan yin zhes bya/ /zhag bdun nas ni 'chi byed yin/ /bud med gang zhig gos gnag cing / /mdog gnag mi ni de dang rang gnyis gar bi ra'i phreng ba mgo la gyon nas 'dod spyod la/ /shingaka ra bi ra'i 'phreng ba rnyedaparmis/ /de ni gshin rje'i gnas su 'gro/ /rmi lam du ni mun pa 'am/ /g.yang sa'am de bzhin btson rar 'jug /rmi lam du ni shing las ltung / /de ni 'chi bdag gnas na gnas/ /gnyid log lus dang mgo bo la/ /ljon shing rtsa 'am shing dag ni/ /lngos bu can bzang bas 'bras bu med par mgolaskyes pa rang gis mthong ba mis na/ /zla ba drug las mi 'tsho 'o/ /mi ni gang zhig spre'u yi/ /sa drangasapa'i shing rta gzhon pa la zhon shar phyogs 'gro/ /sad par gyur nas nga yis ni/ /mtshan mo tha ma de ma thag tu 'chiyinazhes bya/ /khyi khā bya rgod ce spyang dang / /srin po yi dwags sha za yis/ /46byed1065

zos pa rmis pa dang bung bu 'amaphag gam rnga mo 'am/ /ma te labaskyon te khyer ba ni/ /de ni nges par lo gcig nas/ /'chi ba ru ni ston pa yin/ /rmi lam deblu ba mtshan ma mthong na ni/ /chos thams cad mi lam lta bu rgyu ma lta bu yod sgyumayang na oṃ bags kyi nam cha brgyad bzlas pas kyang bzlog lta bu'i blos zhi bya/ /mi ni lcags kyi dbyeg pa thogs/ /nag cing gos ni nag po gyon/ /gnyid log pa'i milamadu mdun na mthong / /zla ba gsum na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lus ni dri dmar gyes byugs shing / /'phreng ba rang las dmar pos rnam par brgyan/ /til mar gyis bskus shin tu skrag /skra byegs gos ni dmar po gyon/ /bong bu zhon te mgyogs par ni/ /lho phyogs su ni 'gro 'gyur bar/ /bdag nyid 'di 'drar rmi lam ni/ /mthong na zla ba drug na 'chi/ /dri byugadang phreng ba dmar po 'am/ /yang na gos ni dmar po dag /gang gis rmi lam dag tu rnyed/ /de ni zla ba brgyad na 'chi/ /phyi rol gyi ni 'chi ba yisti/ /mtshan ma rgyud sde las bshad pa 'dor bkod na grangs las 'das pa ni//lo brgyar yang ni kha cig gis/ /smra ba ru ni su yis nus/ /'chi ba ston par byed pa ni/ /phyi rtags ji skad bshad 'di dag /shes par byas la sngags sman nor bu sogs kyi/ /blu ba'i 'bad pa myur du bya/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i 'chi ba blu ba bstan pa las le'u dang po'o// //phyi'i 'chi ltas bshad nas da ni nang gi 'chi ba yi/ /mtshan ltasanyid gsal bar nges pa ra rtogs pas brjod par bya/ /de gang la brten nas skye zhe na/ de ni rlung 'byung las shes bya//rlung de'i rgyus gang nas zhe na/ rlung ni kha dang sna bug gnyis spyodayul/ /'o na phyi'i 'chi ltas kyi chog mod nang gi 'chi ltas ci dgos she na/ ji srid nang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /legs par nges par 46byed1066

brtag par ma byas par/ /phyi'i mtshan nyid tsam gyis ni/ /'chi ba'i nges pa legs mi rnyed ngesapa kho na med/ /'chi ba'i nges pa gnyi ga phyi nang gnyis ga 'dzom na ni/ /nges byas ngesapa kho nar 'chi yongs su gsal ba yin/ /deci'iphyir zhe na/ phyi rol blo ni phyin ci log /nang 'thab mo dang mya ngan la sogs pa la sogs pa'i dogs pa bskyed/ /dgun zla 'bring dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga la min drug 'ong dgun 'bring po'i tshes bcu gsum la min drug 'ong ste zla ba re zla'i rgyal po yin no/ /zla ba bcu gcig rusab/sa sha 14pa/ ①nga skyob/ /gcig nas gcig tu 'pho ba 'bye ba nya mar ngo'i stod sogs thams cad la/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid spyi'i ni/ /nang par thog mar mtho rangs dus su rlung la brten te/ rlung la brten te brtag par bya/ /mi ni rtog byed kyigang zag nyin zhag rereni/ /gang 'chirtags de la nges par rtogs par byed/ /nyin de ltar rtags pas brtags byung na zhag de nas brtsams nas ni/ /dus 'di 'tshams nas 'chi bya ba bshad pa de'i 'das pa na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin gyisatha mal dang ldan pa'i—/ /srog chags kun la sems can thams cad la rtag tu ni/ /sna khung g.yas dang g.yon pa la/ /so sor rten pa'i rlung rgyu ba/ /thabs kyi cha nyi ma shes rab kyi cha zla ba zhes bya ba/ /rlung ni thun phyed zhag gcig la thun bzhi yod pa'i gcig go/ /dag tu rgyu bo de rnams mayin/ /de las bzlog g.yas bzangs ma 'am g.yon zang mar rgyu ba pas 'aḥbye la sogs/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'chiltas rtog pa la brtag par bya/ /tshes gcig nas ni brtsams nas sdo// /de la 'o skol nub mo nyal nas nang par sngar gyis langs pa des 'chi rtags mi zin/ de glo g.yas pa phab nas nyal na sna bug g.yon nas rlung rgyu/ g.yon phab nas nyal na g.yas nas rgyu bas rtsi mi btub de bas na nang par langs la mdo min gcig gdan pa 'am bzlas pa'am dge sbyor ci bye gcig bya'o/ /de nas ba spu mthong nas rlung la brtag pa ni/gong mdor bstan du dgun zla 'bring po la mgo zug pa skad zer yang zla ba'i mgo la dgos pa min du nam yang 'dra'o/ /sna bug g.yon par zla bar rtogs pas dkar por thunaphyed du rgyu ba'i/ /rlung ni nyi ma gsum 46—1067

yin te/ /de nas tshesabazhi lnga drug zhag gsum nyi ma sna bug g.yas nas rlung rgyu yin/ /slar yang zla bar tshes bdun brgyad dgu nyin gsum ste/ /de nas bcu bcu gcig bcu gnyis nyi mar zhag gsum mo/ /yar ngo zla ba nya bcu gsum bcu bzhi bco lnga 'isna bug g.yon pa bar/ /go rims 'dis ni mi'achibar nges pa yin/ /de bzhin mar ngo labacudrug nas brtsams te—/ /bcu drug bcu bdun bco brgyad nyi mar rlung ni rgyu ba yin/ /gcig ①shos marangokyi ni bco lnga'i stongabar/ /nyi ma gsum gsum marangosnga ma bzhin/ /go rims 'di lasagayas nas rgyu dus su g.yon nas rgyu dus su g.yas nas rgyu ba bo/ zlog parab rgyub/ /'thu ba drend dang gnyis par byungan 'chi bar du nges te/ /zla ba drug na 'chi 'gyur bas/ /de phyir chos ni dran par bya/ /zla ba gcig gi go bzlog pas rgyu na/ /lar rkyen drag po 'byung gnyen dang bshes ni rgud par 'gyur/ /zla phyed phyin ci log gyur pas/ /nad ni rang la drag po mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nyin gcig nas bzung nas nyin gsum bzhi dang lngar/ /zhag drug go ni bzlog pa ru/ /rlung ni gal te rgyu gyur na/ /de tshe rtsod dang skyo sogs gzhan dang mtha' dang zhe sdang skye ba 'byung / /rang bzhin yongs su spangs nas sna bug nas rgyu ba yin pa la ni/ /lam gsum rtogs par rlung sna bug gnyis dang kha dang gsum nas drag tu rgyu na/ /beer gso ba ni nus ma yin gso bar dka'/ /nyi ma phyed ni 'das nas 'chi/ /rlung ni 'pho ba med pa ru/ /sna bugalamani gnyi ga nas mnyam poradag las kyang / /zhag bcu'i bar du rgyu gyur na/ /sna bug gang rung gcig tu 'pho ba'i tshe na de rangadu'achi'o/ /nyin zhag mnyam pa'i ston zla 'dzing po dang dpyid zla sne'adzing po skad cig thob/ /sa de'i nang nas nya la gang gi mig ni 'gul 'gyur ba/ /de'i srog ni nyin zhag ni/ /gcig na 'jig 'chipar gdon mi za/ /gong gi thun byed ni rlung rgyu ba'i thib po bshad pa yin 'di thun phyed kyi ni bar dag tu/ /phan tshun du ni lan mang zhig/46byed1068

g.yas su 'pho g.yon du 'pho byed rlung rgyu de las mchod pa dag /gzhan gyi zas nor la sog pa ster thob pa nyid du shes par bya/ /gang phyir zhag gcig la 'pho ba bcu gnyis yod pa'i'apho ba lnga po ni/ /'das pa snanasami rgyu bar kha ru rgyu gyur pa/ /rlung de las ni nor brlag pa'am ciga'ong ngo / /mi dga' ba 'am 'jigs pa 'am/ /sna'i khyang bu g.yon nga/lnga/ zhesapar / /'a sgyu nga/ pa jig zhag gcig la 'pho ba bcu gnyis yang zhag gcig gi 'pho ba gcig ste bcu gsum yod mdor na zhag gcig dang 'pho ba gcig go/ /ni bcu gsum ni/ /'das pa gang gi nyin zhag cig lhag tu sna bug g.yon nas rgyu gyur pa/ /de la nad sogs skye bar 'gyur/ /sna khung gnyi ga nasaye mi rgyu bar yongs spangs te/ /'phobabacu gang tshe khar gsum du ni 'gro 'gyur na—/ /kha nas rgyu na gal te srogardo rje 'dra na'ang 'di/ /nyin zhag de las mtsho ma 2)na—/ /zla ba 'di mgo la dgos kyi zla ba gang lang 'dra ston zla ba chung gi stod song nas nang skya reng shar nas dgun zla ra bar 'phos pa'o/ /dgun chazla las zlog dang mas zlo gnyis yod ra bar 'pho ba yi/ /dus nas brtsams te rlung dag ni/ /nyi mar g.yas pa nas zhag lnga rgyu gyur na/ /lo ni bco brgyad nyid na 'chi/ /ston zla ra ba ①dang tha chung bzung / /dbyar zla tha chung nas caston zla 'bring po 'pho ②ba yi/ /tshesagacig dus nas brtsams te rlung dag ni/ /zhag lnga'i bar du rgyu gyur na/ /lo ni bco lnga nyid nas 'chi/ /dbyar zla 'dzing po nas dbyar zla tha chung 1su 'phos pa'i tshes gcig nas lnga rlung rgyu na yang de bzhin no/ /lo ni bcu gnyis nyid na 'chi/ /'dir dbyar zla 'bring po bzung / /dpyid zla tha chung nas dbyar gazla ra ba'ang de bzhin zhagalngar 'gyur/ /lo dgu nyid na 'chi bar 'gyuraske/ /dpyid zla ra dang tha chung gnyis bzung / /dpyid zla ra ba nas dpyid khazla 'bring po 'pho ba yi/ /dus na brtsams te de la slob dpon rmi dgun zla tha chung la sogs pa ma gsungs pa rnams ni so so'i sde mtshan re re bshad pa dang 'thun par dgongs pa'o/ /gal te ni/ /zhag lnga'i 46byed1069

bar du rlung rgyu na/ /de tshe lo drug nyid na 'chi/ /dgun zla ra ba nas dgun zla tha chung bzung na ni/ /kadagun zla 'bring po 'pho ba yi/ /rlung ni zhag lngar rgyu gyur na/ /lo gsum 'das nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dus la mkhas pas bshad / /gongagi'apho ba thams cad du ni nyin gcig tu g.yas nas rgyu na gnyis su zhag gsum du—/ /zhag bzhi'i bar du rlung rgyu na/ /go rims dag ni ji bzhin du/ /lo'i bzhi cha ste zla ba gsum cha yis de dor byu// /zhag gcig tu rgyu na lo bcu dgu na 'chi gnyis na lo bcu dgur zla ba gcig ma tshang bas 'chi gsum la lo bcu dgur zla ba drug ma tshang bas 'chi bzhi rgyu na lo bcu dgu la zla ba dgu ma tshang bas 'chi zhag lnga rgyu na lo gcig ma tshang bas te la bco brgyad na 'chi ste gong dang 'tshalas 'byor ro/ /zla ba ru ni de bzhin du gong bzhin tu sna bug g.yon pa nas lnga lnga rgyu na/ /rlung rgyu na ni 'chi ma sna bug g.yon nas rgyu na mi 'chi bas gtogs/ /nad snatshogasadang mu ge'i gnod pa dang / /mya ngan drag po ①rgyal 'chad pa sogs 'tshe ba 'byung / /'pho ba'i sgo nas rtags pa spyi'i dus ni legs rtogs pa / /gsal ba 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /khyad par du ni rtogs bya'i phyir/ /rgyu ba gzhan dag gong ma'i rtag thabs gnyis las/ rgyas pa'i bstan par bya/ /mnyam po bdun du nyi ma kasong / /cagal te skye ba'i skar zla ba/ /khadus bdun pa 'dzom pa la 'di rgyas pa zhes bya ste// //dus dang rtags byung na 'chi ba'i nges pa byed pa yin/ /mi ni zla khyim du bcu gnyis khyem gang las zla/sa pa/ /cade dang dgun zla 'bring po lta bu dbyar zla 'bring po lta bu la 'dzoms pas gzhan la bdun gang yin/ /mnyam po bdun zhes bya bar bshad/ /der ni nyi ma mnyam bdun song / /jakhyem nyid du ni zla ba ni/ /skye ba'i skar mar song la sogs pa bdun rdzogs pa gyur pa/ /rgyas pa'i dus zhes bya ba ste/ /dusader ni 'chi ba brtag par bya/ /rlung ni sna bug g.yas na rgyu g.yon nas rgyu ba yin pa la nang du gtogs pa dang //46byed1070

nyi ma'i la ma sna bug g.yas nas ni thams cad du yun ring ba/ /cig shos g.yon nas ye mi rgyu na 'dir ni dus min par/ /rlungagi rgyus la mkhas pas dus ni brtag par bya/ /rlung ni skad cig dus gang la/ /bgrod pa gzhan du g.yon du 'phos pa'i'ajug 'gyur na/ /dus der skad cig rdzogs gyur na/ /'og gi 'chi ltas shes pa dang thebs dang 'dra ste ze tshom med par 'chi'achi 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /rlung ni gal te nyi mar sna bug g.yas nas gto①//rgyas pa mnyam po bdun 'dzom pa'i dus su nyin phyed rgyu/ /de tshe lo ni bcu bzhi nas/ /'chi ba nyid du shes par bya/ /nyin gahūṃg sadang ni nyin mañtshan zhag gcig dang / /nyin zhag gasnyes dang gsum̐m dang bsnyer/ /gal te rgyu na nyi rmi bcu gnyis kyi brda ste lo bcu gnyis na 'chi phyorgesabacu'ibarda/ /ri dzee brgyalo byeg rirges byed bzhi'achi/ /zhag kalnga de bzhin khazhag bcu dang / /gnyin zhag bco lnga'i bar du ni/ /gal te rgyu na go rims bzhin/ /kalo gsum khaganyis dang gagacig gis 'chi/ /de bzhin nyi shu nyi shu lnga/ /gal te g.yasanas rlung ni rgyu gyur na/ /go rims bzhin du zla drug dang / /zla ba gsum gyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gal te snye shu drug babyen barmyed/ /nyije zhag nyi shu rtsa dgu rgyu/ /z-i ba gnyis gabyeg zla byed dang / /jeg bcus rims kyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gal te nyin zhag sum cu kadang / /khasum bcu gcig dang gsum cu gnyis/ /de tshe go rims ji bzhin du/ /nyin kazhag lnga khagasum gnyis gan 'chi/ /nyin zhag sum cu rtsa gsum par/ /gal te nyi mar rlung rgyu na/ /nyin zhag de nyid la 'chi bar/ /mthucheb yang khyab 'jug yin yang the tshom med/ /nyin zhag lnga nas nyi shu lngar/ /bar bar gyi bzhi mtshan bzhi ni nyi na 46—1071

zhag lngar/ /grangs ni bcu drug ma bshad par/ /danisngar gyi dor ba de rnams brjod par bya/ /sngarazhagalnga dgu'i zhag drug rgyu na lo gsum nas/ /nyinazhag nyi shurtsa bzhi dor bas te mtshang bas 'chi so/ /nyin bdun rgyu bas lo gsum nas/ /sngar bshad nyis 'gyur phri bas zhag nyi shu rtsa brgyad ma tshang bas 'chi so/ /zhag brgyad bar rgyu lo gsum las/ /zla gnyis zhag ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /mtshang bas 'chi zhag dgu rgyu na lo gsum las/ /nyin zhag dgu bcu rtsa drug ma tshang bas 'chi bcu gong du byung dor/ /rlung ni nyi ma'i spyod yul zhag bcu pa gong du byung bas mi 'chad du/ /gal te zhag ni bcu gcig rgyu/ /lo gnyis nyin zhag nyi shu bzhis/ /ma tshang ba na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhag ni bcu gnyis rgyunalo gnyis nas/ /snga ma'i zhe brgyad ma tshang bas nyis 'gyur gyis chung bas/ /zhag ni bcu gsum rgyunalo gnyis las/ /zla gnyis zhag ni bcu gnyis dbri/ /zhag ni bcu bzhi rgyunalo gnyis las/ /zla gsum zhag ni drug gis dbri bcolngagong du byung / /nyin zhag bcu drug rgyu na ni/ /lo gcig zhag ni bcu gnyis kyis mtshang bas 'chi/ /rlung ni nyi ma'i spyod yul du/ /nyin zhag bcu bdun rgyu gyur na/ /lo gcig zhag ni nyi shu bzhis/ /ma tshang ba ni 'chi bar bshad—/ /zhag bco brgyad rgyunakyis lo gcig ni/ /zla gcig zhag drug dor bas so/ /bcu dgu rgyu na lo gcig las/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad phri bas so/ /nyi shu gong du byung nyi shu gcig ni zla drug las/ /zhag drug ma tshang ba yis so/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis zla drug las/ /zhag bcu gnyis ni dor bas so/ /nyin zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum rgyu/ /zlab drug la bco brgyad rnam par dor bas ma tshang bas 'chi so/ /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgyu/ /nyin zlab drug zhag nyi shu rtsa bzhis so/ /zhag mi 'chang ba gong du bstan pas so/ /nyin zhag sum cu gsum de bzhin/ /'chi ba'i mtshan nyid 'byung ba yin//46—1072

rlung 'byung dbang las shes bya ba/ /de tsho 'khor lo'i nang du yang ma tshud la 'chi ba yang dus thug pas de yan chad ni yod ma lobazhilasogs pa yin/ /'dir dpe chung dang yang bstun bshad pa/re mig na la la bri dang po nyi ma phyed durgyunabyasaka/ /nyi ma ra bcunas khapa/ yang na nyin mtshan ①dag gis bar rgyug/ /de las zhag gnyis ngadang ni/ zhag cagasum/'on te chazhag bzhi khyab pa'i bar du nyi ma la g.yas pa ni g.yon pa min la rlung ni rngubs la rten te ④gang zhig rgyu gyur pa/ /de las kaganas lo bcu bzhi na 'chi dang nyi mabacu gnyis khaphyogs gabacudang ngabakra shis brgyadadrug cadang bzhi chani lo'adi shes bya/ /lnga/ 'angs bar ma'i re mig lnga la 'di rnams rgyu ba dgod de'i 'phro la rtsa drug la sogs pa dgod 3) 〈spyo byu1 lnga/sa bar bar du bzhi bzhi bor bas thod rgal nyin zhag lnga lngas 'dzeg par 'gyur las ji bzhin 'phel/ /de las re re nyi shu drug nyi shu bdun nyi shu brgyad nyi shu dgu bskyed pa'i bcu ni sum 'gyur byas pa gsum ste sum cu byu/sades zhag po gsum lhag ma ṭa na'i bar re mig bar ma la bri/ /rgyas pa'i re mig phyi ma la bri dus sa/ de la zhag lnga rgyu na 'o/ni gas/ma na 'chi/ bcur rgyu na mig lo gnyis na 'chi/bco lnga rgyu na zla ba/ lo gcig na na 'chi drugag /zhag nyi shu rgyu na zla ba gsum/ nyer lngar rgyu na zla gnyis nyer drug dang / zla ba nyer bdun rgyu na zla gcig tu ru/ nyer brgyad rgyu na lha'itshesazhag bco lnga na 'chi dang / nyer dgu rgyu na dre/gas/ zhag bcu sum cu rgyu na mda' / zhag lnga sum cu rtsa gcig rgyu na ma na tan zhag gsum na/ bzung ①dbus su bri so gnyis rgyu na dang / zla bar 'chi ba sum cu rtsa gsum rgyu na gcig la yin/ 'khor lo rim gsum bris nas ni/ /re mig sum cu rtsa bdun bcas—/ /tshe 'chibadang srog gi rlung rgyunabridag dang / /nyin zhag mtshan ma dpe chung bzhinarim bzhin bri/ /de ltar bdag gis nang gi 'chi ba'i mtshan ma ni/ /ming gzhan 'chi ltas zhes bya 'dir ni bshad pa yin/ /de rnams shes par byas la mod 46—1073

la myuzab du ni/ /bsam gtan phyi'i dus su blu sla ba sngags sogs zer nang gi dus su blu dka' bas bsam gtan zer sogs kyis 'chi ba blu nyid 'bad de bya/ /slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas sbyar ba'i 'chi ba blu ba bstan pa las/ le'u gnyis pa'o// //phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /'chi ltas tshogs ni shes bya la/ /stiphyi dang nang gi bdag nyid la'ang / /blu ba'i bsdu ba shes byas la/ /phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa tha/sa dang ngag gi bzlas pa skyabs 'gro la sogs pa 'bas spyo/sa :shā/ /bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin/ /nor bu sngags sman phyi yis te/ /rnal 'byor nus pas nang yin no/ /'chi bdag blu ba 'bad pa ni/ /dad pa yis ni byed par nus—/ /dad pas nus ④pa de bas dad pa brtan par bya/ /gzhan du dad pa med na lus ngag la sogs pas ci bya ngal ba don med 'gyur/ /dad dang bral na lha'i dbang po brgya byin yis kyang / /lus kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs dang byasakyangarung / /nor gyi phung po tsam yang rnams kyis kyang / /chos ni 'phra mo'ang ①rnyed mi 'gyur/ /dad pa mchog tu phra ba gcig yod na ba'i chos rnyed cing mtho ris thob/ /dka' thub dngasbyin sreg dngaye shes skye ba la/ /yang bzhi dad pa dgos dad pa nidesan mthoris dngathar pa'i gzhiyin/ /'gro ba 'di semasacan thams cad kun dad pa ni/ /gal te nor dngasrog thams cad kyang / /de bzhin dad pa med na min temi'abyung / /de bas 'bras bu cung zad kyang / /dad pa med na thob mi 'gyur/ /'chi bdag blu bar 'dod pa yis/ /dang por dad pas las 'bras shes pa yi dam bla ma la dad la mchog gzhol bya/ /dkar po chos kyis 'chi las skyob byed cing / /'chi ba blu ba yin par bshad do/ /de bas na chosam rjomi dga' zhing bag med pas/ /skad cig tsamakyang ni gnas parami bya/ /'otshangs 46—1074

payin yang dad pas kun nas bslang ba'i chos med na 'chi ba mi blus yangadage ba bcu ma spyad pas ni chos min par / /'chi bdag blu la dbang ma yin/ /dam pa sangasargyas rnams kyi chos ni bden—/ /sbyin pas blu ba dang dka' thub dngabazod pal dga' bsablu/ /gangal mchog tu brtse byams snying rje kun nas slang ba ces yod de/ /chos gzhan mang pos ci mi dgos zhig bya/ /gang zhig rtag tu sems can la/ /snying rjes snyeng ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /ye shes thar pa de yin gyis/ /chos gzhan mang pos ci zhig bya/ /mi srid pa bya ba de la zer tshe①'tshe zer nas byams snying rje chos kyi mchog yin par/ /sngags pha ④rol tu phyin pa thams cad grub pa'i mtha' ni kun las 'dod/ /rtag tu de byamasasnying rje nyid la bslabs na//'chi bdag blubarims kyis thag bsrings yin/ /bya dang nya dang ri dwags sbrul/ /rkun mo brtson dang bcug gsad pa'i phyogs rtogs rnams/ /dernams kyi srog skyabs pa yis 'phral du ni/ /tshe thung ba yang tshe ring 'gyur/ /de las bzlog ④na kun ma nya dang ri dwags sbrul/ /bya sogs srog ni 'dod pa rnams/ /'di dag gsad na 'phral du ni/ /tshe ring ba yang tshe thung 'gyur/ /mi dge bcu ni spangs pa dang / /de bzhin gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / /basbab pa lnga rtsababazhi chang dang lnga dang brgyad bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bsrungs na/ /'chi bdag thag ni bsrings par 'gyur/ /btson rar bcug dang nad chen gdungs/ /de bzhin 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams—/ /skyabs byas de ni nges pa ru/ /tshe ring 'chi bdag blu byed yin/ /dman dang mgon med ngo mtshar duyonatan can bcas/ /tshul khrims ldan la'ang gus par ni/ /'dod pa'i don ni rab ster bas/ /tshe ni nges par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /pha dang ma dang bla ma rgan/ /mdor rgyas shes pas rgan padang sogs rigs kyis nas so lagus shing / /mchod dang bkur ste byin pas kyang / /'chi ba 46—1075

dang ni nye mi 'gyur tebasrungs pa'o/ /rang gi 'dod pa'ilha yidamade la gus/ /dge slongadaka' thub can la'ang gus pa yis/ /rtag tu nang par lha phyag bya/ /byas pas tshe ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten gas dang 'jig pa la/ /so phag la sogs kyis bcos na/ /tshe thung tshe ni ring bar 'gyur/ /dge slong bsod stoms pa dang mtshungs/ /lha khang sku gzugs mchod rten sogs/ /byed dang kun dga' ra ba 'dzugs/ /mchod rten che nasasobargyad lasogs pa lamachodapa dang bkur ste byed kyis/ /rtag tu tshe ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /chos gos bdun pa la byin pa'i bdun pas slong ba la snyed pas/ /rdzas kyis dge 'dun chos ston gsol/ /zhag bdun tshe thung tshe ring 'gyur/ /ba'i ming yin bu mu stegs pa la dad pa chos rgyal mya ngan med dang mtshungasaske/ /bye ma'i gsher ba la mchod rten dngos su byed pa dang / /de bzhin 'jim pa latsha tsha 'debs pa dang / /mchod denas de la rten la sogs byasanas phyag byas pas//tshe ni nges par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'dus pa togachen po'i mdo dang ni/ /a ta na ti ya ka'i lcang lo can gyis zhus pa'i mdo gnas pa mi btags ①mdo/ /mdo phran mang po 'phra mor bcas dang dkonamachog sprin chen dang / /shin tu mdobakra shis pa'itshigs bcad rnams—/ /mdo la dad cing gus gus pas dge slong 'don 'jug pa'am/ /yanganarang nyid kyis ni rab ston na/ /de bzhin tshe ring thob 'gyur zhing / /'chi bdag dru bar 'gyur ba yin/ /beeg pa chen po shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa ston byed dang / /phal chen sdong po brgyan sogs mdo sde rnams/ /rtag tu rtse gcig pas bklags ④na/ /'chi bdag blu bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud sogs ma lus klags pa 'am/ /bsrung ba lnga'i gzungs gral lnga cho gas kyang / /'chi bdag blu bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs sngags bcugapa'i 46byed1076

mchod rten sogs/ /skor ba dag ni byas pa dang / /gzungs ①medakyini bzlas pa byas pas kyang / /'chi bdag gi ni brtson pa blusa'ajoms/ /de'i cho ga sngon 'gro bas/ /gza' 'i gzungs sogs ma mo'i gzungs klags pa dang / /gzungs gang dang gang gi sngags stong du zlos pa dang / /dkon mchog sgron ma sha'i gzungs klags pa dang / /gzungs kyi tshogs las gsungs pa'i/ /gzungs sngags zlos ②la brtson pas ni/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'chi ba dang / /'chibadang nye ba'ang ring du mi'achiganas par byed/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri bdang sbyin sreg dang / /lha sgoms phyag rgya 'ching bar byed pa dang / /gtor ma gtor ma dang dang ni dpa' bo dang dpa' mo tshogs 'khor lo/ /rab sbyin 'chi bdag blu ba yin/ /phyogs bzhi 'phags pa'i dge slongabazhi grwa 'dun la/ /mchod ston mal cha sbyin sogs dang / /bslab pa med kyang chos gos tsam zhig 'chang ba la'ang / /sbyin pa 'chi bdag blu byed 'gyur//de la sogs pa'i bya ba brtson/ /chos dang bsod nams mtshan nyid 'gyur/ /bsod nams kyis ni tshe 'phel zhing / /de 'phel 'chi ba blu ba yin/ /de ltar chos ni cung zad cig /bstan gyis de'i rgyas pa ni/ /rang nyid kyis ni rjes 'phags nasadage ba bya pa'am/ /'chi bdag blu mkhas dgeba'i phyogs byed pa de la babeeb/ /de ltar chos la brtson byas nas/ /grub pa'i sngags dang ratnasman sogs kyis①ni/ /'chi ba blu ba la 'phral du yid ches byed pa yin te/ /debasa'achi bdag rnam par bsal bar bya/ /nor bu sngags dang sman gru ba/ /smanagyi bcud len gyis tshe bsring ba ④stobs kyis rang nyid ni/ /'chi bdag pha rol gnon mthong ste/ /dper na sman gyi rigs 'dzin grub pa tshe nyi zla ltar ring ba ji bzhin no/ /rin chen brtag la sogs pa yod pa'i bstan bcos gang / /rtog la mkhas pas rdo rje 'chang / /che'i bsringab nor 46byed1077

bu sngon po zur gsum pa mtshan mo 'od 'ong ba cig yod/ 'chang ba'ang rung / /de bzhin sna tshogs mutig la sogs pa nor bu 'chang / /sngonapo.ind+ra mbi la'i rin chen sogs/ /nor bu chen po mnashel la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang / /'chang bar byed na gnas khang yid dang mthun par chag chag btab pa la sogs pa byas lus la dri byug la rang gi gnas lngar rin po che btugs btags sha :nge ba kun/ /zlog par 'gyur bar the chos med sum nyi mi bya bar gdams pa/ /gang phyir nor bu'i mthu la ni/ /'chi ba blus pas mi blus snyam pa'i som nyi byed par rigs min te/ /nor bu bsam gyis ①mi khyab pa'i/ /mthu dang ldan par rgyudasdethams cad 'dod/ /dben pa'i gnas su ras ris sogs/ /lugs ma dang po ti sdel sogs pa bkram nas mdun du mchod pa byas nas ni/ /lha gang na gang gi sngags rnams bzlas pa tsam gyes kyang / /'chi ba blu ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dang por gnas khang yid dang mthun par maṇḍal rje btsun thang sku mchod pa rang khrus bya bdun rnam dag byas la bskyed la sngags bzlas des kun 'dre/ 2) ba/ phyag bajo/2) 'ab/ /de nas ro lig zhes bsam pa/ /sngags 'di rig pa'adzin pa'isde snod las gsungs te//sngags 'di pani khams gsum thams cad las rgyalabar byed pas zhes bya/ /sngags 'di spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ /dad pas de'i'adun dunges par ni/ /yi ge'i grangs kyis 'bum bzlas na/ /'chi ba blu bar byed par 'gyur/ /thams cad gong dang 'dra'o dang por rnam par oṃsnang mdzad brjod/ /de 'og tā re lan gnyis brjod—/ /tud ta re gnyis tu re gnyis/ /swā hā'i mtha' can 'chi ba blu/ /sgol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /sngags rerezhing ni yi ge 'bum pa ru/ /sgol ma'i spyan sngar oṃ ta re tutta re tu re sru hā bzlas nas su/ /zho dang sbrang rtsi la mngar bskus—/ /dur ba'i gongadusgyug ma sgyug gu shar dang ni/ /byang du rtse bstan sbyin sreg bya/ /sngon gyi las mthu las byung ba'i/ /'chi ba nges par zlog par byed/ /46—1078

slob dpon la ni yon phul nas/ /oṃ thog de nas ru ru ste/ /de nas spru ru'i tshig rjes la/ /dzwa la tiṣṭha sid snyi dang / /lo tsa ṣpe zhes bya tshig gsum lan gsum/ /sadzā sba sa dha ni swā hā/ sngags a sha ka'i shi'adab mar/ /gtsang mar tsan dan chu yis ni/ /sngags ming dang spel ba 'bum 'am bye ba bris nas kyang / /dag cing dad pa'i cho ga yis/ /mingabyang chu med lo mar bkru ba'am/ /thamaradur ba la sogs pa'imelasbyin sreg byas/ /'chi ba blu ba ma lus pa/ /nges pa kho nar byed pa yin/ /nad kyi tshogs ni ma lus pa/ /zhi bar byed pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur//dkyil 'khor rgyudakyiming chen po'i cho gar bshad/ /'phags pa yi ge brgya zhes bya/ /sngags kyi mthu ni bsam mi khyab/ /sngags kyi nus pa mthu ni rnam pa du ma mthong /bzang spyod bdunadag pa yid ①dam bcas pa yi/ /de'irjes la chogayis ni ta tha brgyas 'bum bzlas na/ /thar pa nges par skyed byed na sangasargyas 'grub na/ /'chi ba blu ba smos ci dgos/ /na ma tre yang ti ka ④āoṃ lhung bzed byin gyis brlab pa dang gcig/ /de nas ta ①thā ga ta rgo/ /sarba tra pra ti ha ta/ /bab ti dharmā ta'i tshig /ba li nā ya tshig gi mthar/ /de nas a sa sa mā/ sa man ta to ā nanda dā/ /bā ba ti 'og sha sa ni/ /ha ra ha ra sma ra sma ra/ ra na bee ga ta ra ga /de nas budha dharma ste/ /sa ra gnyis sa ma ba khā/ /ha sa gnyis dang tra ya gnyis/ /ga ga na ma hā bā ra/ /lakṣa ṣpe de bzhin dzwa la/ /dzwa la na sa ga re'i mthar /swā hā'i tshig ni sbyar bya ba/ /gsang sngags tatha'iyi ge brgyar gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dusagasum gyi thams cad kyi/ /snying po yin par rab tu bshad/ /'phags ma so so 'brang ma'i sngags/ /'bum phrag gcig ni legs bzlas la/ /dur ba'i sbyin sreg bcu chas ni/ /'chi bdag nges par blu ba yin/ /oṃ smras 46—1079

bi ma le dzā ya/ /ba re a mṛ te hūṃ hūṃ/ /phaṭa gnyis de nas swā hā'i/ /tshig ni mthar ru brjod par bya sngags 'di gnyis ka zlos so/ /rnam par snang mdzad chabha ra gnyis—/ /sam bha ra gnyis brjod byas la/ /in tra ya pa la'i sgra/ /bi shodha ni zhes brjod do/ /hūṃ hūṃ ru ru tsa le dang / /swā hā sngags 'di 'chi bdag blu/ /'phags ma so sor 'brang ma yi/ /snying po dngos grub kun stsol yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug spyan snga ru/ /'chi ba las rgyal zhes bya yi/ /gsang sngags yi ge bcu pa ni/ /'bum phrag gcig bzlas de 'og tu/ /me tog dkar po mar btegs dubacug pa pa'i/ /sbyin sreg zhi thabs su spyan ras gzigs spyod la grangs ni 'bum bya'o//sngags mthus de 'og nges par ni/ /'chi bdag blu ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /thog mar oṃ ste de nas oṃ/ /de 'og i sum̐ oṃ rma e.u āoṃza tu dza ya rmazhes bya ba/ /oṃ mrid tu dza ya de nas/ /oṃ ste sngags 'di yi ge bcu/ /bskal pa sogs su 'tsho ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang gsungs pa/ /de yis tshe ni bsrings pa 'grub/ /tshe bsrings pakhonas 'chi ba slu ba zhesabya bayin/ /sngags gang zhi ba'i las byed pa/ /de yis tshe ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /tshe ni 'phel bar 'gyur ba na—/ /des ni 'chi ba blu bar 'gyur/ /sngags rnams kyi ni mthu la yang / /sngags 'dis 'chi blus sam mi blu snyam pa'i the tshom bya bar rigs ma yin/ /gang phyir sngags kyi mthu dag ni/ /bsam mi khyab par rgyudasdekun las 'dod/ /'jig rten na ni dngos gzhan gang / /sngags kyis mi 'grub de yod min/ /yang dag dad dang mngon brtson las/ /sngags rnams yid bzhin nor bu mtshungs te dgos 'dod 'byung //rtogs pa las bshad cho ga 'am/ /ci 'dod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bkres chas skams pa che che ba'i sa phyogs su/ /sle tres drichudang sman gyi rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sle tres 46—1080

gcig dang yang na gzhan yosabu gsum pa yi/ /sman dang lhan cig rtag tu spyad/ /de nas lus ni khams rgyas skra dkar gnyer ma med brtan gyur na/ /gshin rje'i sgo ni mthong mi 'gyur yang/ /grub pa'i sman ram nye ba ston ka'i dpyid ka brkos ①te gdus pa'i khu ba bsgor bza' sko du 'o ma khyad par chang dang bud med bcad ni gzhan dag kyang / /nges par sten klapar 'gyur ba yis/ /khubabyung bas na snetshe 'phel nad dang rgas pa ni/ /zad pas 'chi bas mi mthong ste/ /yangadangul dang gser sogs ldan pa yis/ /yangadangul chu cho ga bzhin zos na/ /bcud kyi len gyi rang bzhin gye/ /'chi ba blu ba 'byung ba yin/ /yang tshes gcig yarangozla ba'i sbyor sogs par/ /rang gi khubabaton pa khams ni thog pa na/ /sna sman sbug mal til mar la sogs pa bskus la de'i nang du byang sems blug byes chu dang sbyar la btang btang ba'i cho ga yis/ /'chi ba blu ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kha sbyar la sogs rgyud las sam bu ṭa shin tu sbyangs pa'i thig le'i nang du gser ram lcags sam byu ru mu tig la sogs pa stong blugs kyang cher mi 'grod de byang ba de zos na tshe nyi zla dang mnyam gsungs/ /mi 'chi lnga dang ldan pa ni/ /byin gyis brlab pa yi las rlung la sogs pa oṃ a sri ta hūṃ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas man ngag ji bzhin bstan pa yin—/ /'chi ba blu ba 'byung mi 'gyur/ /yang stengabade rṣa 'khor lo dang 'og dag kha sbyor ba ni/ /gang zhig phan pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sems nyid ar byas la bsgom pa rnal 'byor dag tu byed/ /de la gshin rje'i rgyal po rtag tu ni/ /khros par gyur kyang ci yang byed mi nus/ /la lar thabs kyis de bzhin bsgoms rjopasa'achi ba yang /slar 'tsho ba ni 'gyur ba mthong / /yang dusakhrag 'dzag ldan bu mo mi rangadang ni/ /phan tshun bsrubs las byung ba ni/ /khrag dang lus zungs khubabasres pa ni/ /khams khubani shin tu grang min pas/ /gang zhig 'phral du 'chi nyid las/ /thigs pa bu chung skyes ma thag gi chu dang gong ma rang yang yin yang shi ba nyid la khu khrag byung ba de rang yin/46byed1081

gnyis ni tig par bya/ /mar bskus pa'i sbu gu las/ /dragatude ni bud pas gzhug par grogs kyi sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i rlung dgos bya/ /bdag nyid sna khung las byung gan du ba'i/ /sna khung rim gyis bsgres gyur pa/ /slar yang 'tsho bar 'thong ①'gyur te/ /'dir ni de rnams byas ma thag tu bum pa can bya dgag pa bsngags ①pa yin/ /nus mthu sngon du mthong bas na/ /sbyor ba 'di ni rgyudasdemang pos sngags ①yang / /'bras bu gsum ni spyir bsdus pa 'am/ /so sor khu ba byung ba mnyes de nas spyad 'bras gsum dang / 'bri ga ra tsar bcas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag dpyad na/ /gnyer ma skra dkar rnams dang bral/ /shinatusra ba rdo rje'i lus ni gzugs bzang ldan/ /bskal pa yi ni grangs snyed du/ /'chi ba nges par zlog pa yin/ /dri chu rnams bupagazhan dang 'dra mngazhig ni/ /gural sogs lung las gsungs pa grub pa 'di/ /nang dubaza' rku phyirabs 'phral du ni/ 'chi ba zlog pa du'agyur ba yin/ /dri chu dang 'di dag sbrang rtsi mar ldan pas/ /de rnams bsres pa bsten na rtag tu goms par byas na ni—/ /dus dang dus min las byung ba'i/ /'chi ba zlog par byed pa yin/ /sman rnams kyi ni mthu la yang / /som nyi bya bar rigs min te/ /gang phyir sman gyi nus pa ni/ /bsam mi khyab par kun tu snang bamathong/ /de ltar phyi'i bya bas dadaparagus byas pas/ /ji bzhin stobs kyis 'dir ni 'chi bdag blu nadasel//'chi ba stobs ldan 'jigs pa cher dogs la/ /phyi'i ltas byung ba de yang dang yang du blus kyang ma blus pas bya/ de nas nang gi ltas rtags nas nang gi blu ba byed dgos de ltar de ni nang gi bya yin/ /slob dpon dag gi dbang phyug grags pas sbyar ba las/ /'chi bdag blu ba bstan pa le'u gsum pa'o// //46—1082

phyi'i blu ba bstan nas da ni 'chi ba blu ba la/ /mkhas pa nangagi blu thabs nang gi bdag nyid can/ /rten①gyi gang zag gang gis brtson pas 'chi ba ni/ /nges par blu ba'i thabs bshad par bya/ /rgyal po rkun po bdud chen po/ /'gal rkyen stag la sogs pa'i 'jigs dang bral/ /'du 'dzi dang bral ri bo nagasasogs/ /rangayid 'ong la lar gnas par bya yang na ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i gnas/ /tshad tsam za zhing smra nyung la/ /shin tu 'chag par 〈banyung ba dga' ma yin/ /gnyid chung bsam gtan la yang gnas—/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa la rab brtson/ /rang gi 'dod lha mchod maṇḍal dang skor ba sogs dang / /thunamathams su dam chos klag pa'i bya ba dang / /gtor ma jigan tshatshasogs byams pa tshadamed bzhi yi/ /sems la lus ngag gsum sogasapa na shugs kyi dus gsum dgeb la brtson/ /bsod nams kyis 'chib blus 'dod yang dag 'grub/ /de bas bsod nams la brtson bya/ /dad bzhipas thams cad yang dag 'grub/ /de phyir dad pa rnam 'phel bya/ /grogasabartson 'grus kyis ni brtsams pa 'grub/ /de bas brtson 'grus dang ldan pas pa sngon 'gro bya/ /bsam gtan kyis 'dod 'bras bu thob pa bstan tshe ring bas pa tshogs sogs pas bsam gtan la sems gcig tu 'bad/ /'du 'dzi spangs nashugs kyi pas nyams len 'gyur/ /de bas 'du 'dzi rnam spangs dubya—/ /yang dag pa'i shes ldan narab dang thams cad 'grub/ /de bas shes rab dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang kun ldan bya/ /tshogs sog ①par shi nas ngan song du song bas 'chi ba las ni sdug bsngal mthong / /'tsho ba las ni chos 'gyur mthong / /de bas na som nyi ma lus dang bral bas/ /'chi ba blu ba kun tu spyad/ /de la dang por bdud rtsi 'pha par mos pas bsam gtan bcas/ /bgegs gshinarjedagra'i gsang sngags 'bum nyid ni/ /legs bzlas :/na sreg khri byu/sa sngags kyi zhabs su pusna ku ru ye zhes btags la pas/ /46byed1083

bgegs ni thams cad bzlog par byed/ /na mā sa manta ①kā ya/ /de nas bāpi tta'i tshig /badzra rna na mo badzra/ kro dha ya zhes tshig brjod la/ /ma hā dang stong de'i rjes/ /bi ra ba ya a se brjod/ /mu sa la pa ra shu pa/ /gri hi ta ha sta ya yin/ /oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa sdeli/ /kha kha khā hi khā hi'i tshig /tiṣṭha tiṣṭha'i tshig de nas/ /brnya gnyis dang ha na gnyis/ /da ha gnyis dang gardzo dzeeganyis/ /de nas bi sgo ṭa ya gnyis/ /sarba badzra'i tshig dang ni/ /bigha bi na ya ka brjod/ /ma hā gha na pa ta'i tshig /dzi bi danta ka ra ya/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā'i/ /sngags 'di bgegs rnams zlog byed yin/ /yang na 'di'i snying po 'dem pa ste mthu 'drayis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad zlog par byed/ /sngon bzhin 'bum bzlas dang sbyin sreg khrigis/ /'di'i mthu yang de 'dra yin/ /oṃ sngar hu lu hu lu dang / /de 'og tiṣṭha tiṣṭha'i tshig /ha na gnyis dang da ha gnyis/ /gardza gardza de 'og tu/ /bi sgo ta ya lan gnyis brjod/ /sarba bikyā ba ni ya ka na/ /oṃ a mṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ /'di gnyen pa mi dgos phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ma ma rakṣa ku ru swā hā/gzhan gyi bsrung ba'am yang na nyid kyis blu de ltar bdud dang bgegs rnams ni/ /ma lus rnam bsal de rnams kyis bdag la 'khrug med pas/ /ji ltar mngon 'dod rnal 'byor ni—/ /gcig gcig nyin mtshan bsgom par bya/ /stug po bkod pa'i gnas bzhugs te/ /mtshon pa ste gnas dbeen par maṇḍal thang sku mchod pa rnam dag bya tshad med bzhi kun la bya de nas stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gdan pad zla cho ga gsum las zhi ba sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /padma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyar ldan/ /ye shes spyor lo ma drang 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro ba/ /rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo'i lte bar yi ge la sems btad bsgoms nas ni/ /'khor ba srid 46—1084

du mching 'os min/ /mi bskyod la sogs gongadang 'dra de bzhin gshegs/ /rang mdog phyag rgya cha lugs ldan/ /nga rgyal brtan pas bsgoms nas ni/ /rdo rje'i lus su nges par 'gyuraka/ /snying garazla gakha sbyar nang na ye shesasems dpa' bzhugs/ /gnas khang la sogs pa 'dre 'jig kharten dbang phyug mi 'jigs pa'isku / /zhizhing sku mdog dkar ba zla ba dang 'dra la/ /rgyan rnams nor bu sna tshogs pa kun gyis rnam par brgyan g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon padma bsnams pa/ /dbu la 'od dpag med ni sku mdog dmar/ /rdzogs sangs kyis mtshan dzin ras gzigs kyi ral pa pa'igaseb can/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas pa yis/ /zhabs kyis padma gnyis kyi steng / /phyag gnyis dag ni ma 'chol ②bar—/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya mnyam gzhag gi legs gnas pa/ /sems can kun don kun rdzogs mdzad/ /snang ba mtha' yas las bdud rtsi'i rgyun sku las thugs rje'i rgyun 'dzag pa—/ /bsams la 'jig rten dang ①dbang phyug de'i thugs kar ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gzhan de bzhin/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ slar yang de'i thugs ka ru/ /nying nge 'dzin sems dpa' debazhin sumartseg tu rtse gcig yid kyis ni/ /ji srid grangs ni bye bar 'gyur/ /cha.a ga ha/ la bzlas pa'i grangs de srid bsam gtan 'di dran bya/ /de nas 'phra zhing gsum brtsegs pa'i thugs kar zla ba chung ba'i dbus su a spus jis pa tsam rab 'phra'i mthar 'od dpag med kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs la a la gtad de nas khrus gsol/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la gtad sems/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bsams na/ /'chi bdag rang nyid 'chi bar 'gyur/ /phung po las skyes nad gzhan yang / /rang nyid 'jig par 'gyur ba yin/ /gnas khang la sogs 'dre padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyis dhigadan stengs su/ /rdo rje skyil krung tamadang 0la bcas nas su / /g.yas mchog sbyin pa dang g.yona.utpal bsnams/ /sku mdog dkar ba ston ka'i 46—1085

zla ba'i mdangs 'dra ba'i/ /zla ba la ni rgyabayol rgyab rten ①ma/ /rgyan rnams rin po che sna tshogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /gzhon nu ma bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan—/ /sdogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras/ /dus sum gyi sangs rgyas kyi yum 'dod bzhin dgos 'dod ster ba'i skuni 'chang ba'i yumayang na sku mdog dmar po la sogs mos/ /'phags ma sgol ma snying gar bsgom mdor/ /rgyas de'i 'khor lo 'od zer dkar/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge ni/ /brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba la/ /lte bar oṃ che ge mo ha o hā'i yi ge yi/ /dbus gnas bsgrub bya'i ming dang ldan/ /zla drug nges pas ni brtan zhing / /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis bsgom/ /yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni/ /skyo bar ma gyur sems kyis bzla/ dang por oṃ ni bzhag nus su / /de 'og tā re rab tu sbyar/ /de 'og tuṭwā re tu re/ /swā hā'i mtha' can las kun byed/ /de ltar bsgom zhing bzlas na tshangs dbang phyugachenapo khyab 'jug nyi ma zlabadang / /dbangaldan drag po'i phyogs kyang 'dod lhas pa'i lha thod pa can kyang / /spu rtse tsam yang nyamasapar mi 'gyur ma nyams par/ /'chi bdag lta bu'i 'chi las rgyal/ /skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan dang / /nad snatshogs pa dang dbul ba kun zad mi 'byung byed/ /seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad/ /snyug bsngal tshogs ni 'jigs par byed/ /ma bslangs par ni zas skom sogs/ /khang bzangs gos la sogs pa rnyed/ /thun mongs brgyad ral gri mig sman rkang byug pa/ /bum pa bzang dgos 'dod ster sogs dngos grub rnams/ /snyan ngag smra mkhas yid gzhungs zer nyid kyi blo/ /shes rab chebalagacig tu dri ma med/ /'dod pa'i ci 'dod thams cad dngos grub gzhan dag kyang / /'khor lo 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /des mtshon nas sbyo/nadakar mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon 'khor lo bsdam pa'o/ /dang oṃ 'khor lo rin po che tram̐ ②skul 46—1086

dre/pa/ ma ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon rin po che mā ma ki sngon mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon rdo rje gos dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon padma bsnams pa'o/ /de rnams kyang phyag mtshan dang yig 'bru las byed thugs kar phyag mtshan la sa bon bsam snyir po oṃ tram̐ hūṃ la sogs bzlas so/ /hūṃ rdo rje na/ ma mi// /tripadma shāsti sna 2)kazab ces gos dkar mo chen mo ni/ /rang 'dog cha lugs phyag rgya yis/ /bsgoms shing sa bon bzas na 'chi bas mi tshugs so/ /rang gi 'dod lha'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /nga rgyal bstan pa dang ldan pa/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i/ /'dod pa'i don ci bsam pa 'grub ni rab sgrub byed/ /dung rdorjesems dpa' dang kun da zla ba 'dra gnas khang la sogs 'dre/ / hūṃ las bskyes pa ①bsdu ba'i rim kyis yang dag gnas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bslabs sku ma nachabadzra sutwa hūṃ bzlas na des/ /'chi ba blu bar gdan bzhi nas bshad 'gyur ba yinaske/ /'khor lo bde mchog rgyud las gsungs/ /stongapa'i ngang las he ru ka'i rnam par bsgom/ /byas na de yongs gyur pa las/ /nyal khar thod pa skam po gcig tu bsam kā pa la'i rnam par bsgom/ /kang ka li'i gzugs kengarus bsam pa'am/ /yang na kha ṭī gar rtsegasum pa ni rnam par bsgom/ /gsad par 'os pa ma yin phyir/ /'chi ba 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /stan bde ba la 'dug la lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas spyi bo ru ni zla ba'i gzugs las/ /bdud rtsi dkar ba bde ba gsal ba thigs pa 'dzag pa yis/ /lus thams cad gang nas ba spu'i bu ga kun nas ni/ /yan lag thams cad tshim par bde ba rma byed/ /'du 'dzi sgomapathams cad rnams spangs pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yis zla badrug tubasgom pan/ /nad kun las ni rnam rgyal nas/ /'chi bdag lta bu'irangaltara'achi las rgyal/ /yang na mgo bor byang sems kyi rang bzhin padma 'dab ma stong / /dkar po kha ni thur du bltas/ /padasteng du zla ba'i rim pabasams nabaskal sogs par—/ /'chi ba 'jigs par byed pa yin/ /yangade nyidabyangasems nag po'i 46byed1087

gzugs nyid la/ /nag po'i gzugs kyi 'od rnams kyis/ /kun tu lusakhyab par bsams nas ni/ /skra dkar la sogs 'jig par byed/ /lce ni rkan la gzhar rkan la paṃ las padma lce rtse la hūṃ las rdo rje de la rig byas pas byu/ ཿ/nga / /so ni so 'ang ma reg par—/ /lcertsergyu'i nus pa bsam mi khyab byang sems phebs nas bde ba spyod/ /dad par byas la 'di bsam bya/ /yangan sgogama'i bu ga'i lcechung dang skyed ①dang sbyar/ /don la lce rtse bkug nas lce'u chung dang sprad pa bde ba skyes par bsgom mo lce'u chung thur du bltas pa ni/ /lce'i rtse mor kun reg pa/ /bdud rtsi'i ro ni stsong bar byed/ /des ni 'phral du 'chi ba sel/ /skra dkar la sogs pa yang 'jig /de byas nas ni rgud pa dang / /'jigs pa kun las bsrung ①bar 'gyur/ /spyir rlung la bzhi bgrang ba la brlab brgya yan lag brlab pa kha dog dang dbyibs dang bum pa can la brlab pa 'di bgrang ba'i tshul du blu dbugs phyir 'byung nangadurngub pa dran pa yang / /rnam pa gzhan pa byang sems kyi man ngag las brtsam par bya/ /grangs 'phel nangadu ⑫ khe ḍa na de las nges par ni/ /rga dang 'chi ba med par 'gro/ /sems can spyirarnams kyi nyin mtshan phrugs re la du/ /dbugs ni nyi khri chig stong dang / /drug brgya dag ni lhag pa ru/ /grangs ni yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /gang yin bdud rtsi nangadu gtig pa bsags yin pa/ /rlung ni 'jug pa sngags ①pa yin/ /bdud rtsi nangadu 'jug pa gson pa'i thabs yin te/ /de yis 'chi bas mi tshugs so/ /'jug pa'i rlung ni 'byung ba zhu bgrang bya zhing / /rim gyis bum sogs kyi ni/ /rtse gcig sems kyi cho ga bzhin/ /sgra med pa'i yi ge gsum bzlas par bshad/ /sgra ngagatu mi 'don yang med bzlas pa 'bum du ni/ /cho ga 'gro hūṃ a oṃ gnas bzhin du rdzogs gyur na/ /mi ni tshe nyams gyur pa yang lo lnga'i bar du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /nyis 'bum la sogs zlos bupa nyid/ /lo bcur 46—1088

ring du tshe 'phel bar ni bsgre bar bya/ /rlung bgrang ba la sogs pa'i thabs la mkhas par gyur pa gang / /rlung gi bzlas la brtson par bya/ /nang par langs nam skya bo la nas te stong phrag gcig /rtag tu legs par oṃ.uhūṃbagrangs nas ni/ /nad kun las ni rnam grol zhing / /nyi zla gnas kyi bar du 'tsho/ /rlungalababeeb pal mi dga' bar rlung la mi mos par mi bya mi gnas shing / /yud tsam yang ni gnyid ma log /'badabartson 'grus dang bcas pa de gnyid las rgyal bya zhing / /ranapar bza' ba bza' dang btung dang kha zas sogs spyod lam dal par bya/ /rlung lugasasu kha zas ran par za ba la sogs pa desa'abyung ba'idang rgyu byas pas/ /rlung rgyu ba delabarlab la brtson par bya/ /lugs mthun nang du 'jug pa la 'bad rnal 'byor pa/ /nges par 'chi ba las rgyal gyur①—/ /rmongs pa longs spyod la gcig gzhol/ /phyira'abyung ba lugs mi mthun rlung ma bkag pa dang rlung mi bsgom par pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bo lugs mthun 'gegs pa dang bsgom pas 'gyur/ /de las bzlo bas lugs mi mthun/ /stan bde ba'i steng du seng ge rnam grol phyag rgya ni/ /bcings pa yis ni rlung dag gnyid du byas na tshe 'phel| /kyangang na lus bcos pa ②la sogs byas la 2)gag palnga/ spyo/zab bas rgya'ab/ /dgag pa 'chi ba blu byed yin/ /rkang mthil gyi ni mthar thug par/ /rlung gis rim bye/ dgang bzab byu// /dang por dbyung ba gzhug pa de nas dgang de nas zhi ba bya gnyid dang bya gzhag la sogs padagag pa kun pa ka bumapa can zhes bya/ /de shes rig pa brjod bya ste/ /rlung rab rjes kyi cho ga steng gi dgag pa sbyor bas ni/ /dgag par byed pa 'chi ba dag las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa drug chung dang bdunacu rtsa gnyis 'bring sogs brgyartsa brgyad dbye ba yis—/ /steng dgag rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /steng dgag ces ni bya ba 'di//'og nas bshad pa don ston byed/ /chung ba tshad ni sum cu drug /'bring ni 46byed1089

de bzhin nyis 'gyur yin/ /chen po sum 'gyur yin zhes bya/ /dgag pa des ni 'chi bdag las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /dgag pa yi ni tshad byas la/ /phyi nas rang gi pus lha ngar/ /'dir ni lag pas myug byas la/ /de nas se gol drug brdab bo—/ /'di ni mkhas pas yongs chad pa'i/ /dus kyi tshad ni yin par bshad//ji srid sum cu drug tshad 'gyur/ /de srid dgag pa'i bya ba yin/ /steng dgag 'di ni chung ba 'di 'dzing dang rsā po las dman pa ste/ /de nas bar ma nyis 'gyur yin/ /steng dgag chen po sum 'gyur te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis tshad yin no/ /'chi ba slu ①bar 'dod pa yin/ /'bad pas de nyid las rgyal bya/ /steng dgag chen po'i mtshan nyid ni/ /ji srid dgag pa rab 'jug pa'i/ /rgyun du de la goms na cher bkag par gyur pa yang / /de tshe legs par gnas pa yin/ /nyi ma de la 'chi sogs nyid/ /rlung nang du logs na 'chi ba med dper na nor sbas na rkun mas rku rgyu med dang 'dra dgag pa la ni sum brgya drug cu khegs na lo gcig tshe bsring dpe 'dre gang gnas pa/ /de ni bskal pa stong du yang / /'chi bdag nye bar mi 'gyur karo/ /spyibanam mkha'i ba kumapani bzhos pa rlung gi skor ④ba lan gsum byas nas las/ /bdud rtsi byangasems gsher ba dag gi tshogs—/ /stan bde ba'i steng du 'dug pa rang gi spyi bor khabum pas dkar po'am nag po byang sems kyi gang ba gcig bsam ma'abyen pa chu byangasems zhes bya'i/ /dkyil 'khor pa'i rgyu ba la sogs pa'i rlung las yar gzhug las ni 'od zer 'phro/ /sna rtser byung ba'i rlung gyen la sogs pa gi ni/ /rlangs bkugapa la yang brtag par bya/ /shing rtags byung tsam na snying rtsa bskam snyingagirtsaskams padmar shing rnyid pa thimapa yis rtsa de 'ang rlan par byas ar byas la byang sems kyis khrus gsol bas dkar lhag lhag bsam sems kyis bung ba'i phru gu gso/ /nam mkha' bzho ba'i bsam gtan dag /'di ni rtag tu rgyunatu bsgom na spyad par bya/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'chi bdag 46byed1090

las—/ /mthong bas mthong ba ma yin no/ /yang na rlung ni yongs spangs la/ /de bzhin nyid la stongapa'idon sgom rtag tu spyad/ /de bzhin nyid kyis de nyams su blangs la 'chi dang bdud/ /dgra rnams gzhan bar chad kyi bgegs las rgyal byed cing / /nyes pa sdug bsngal dang nad thams cad ma lus rab tu zhi/ /ganga'adod yon tan ma lus 'byung bzab mi 'chi ba dang rgas pa la sogs med 'a sdomazab/ /stong nyid rnal 'byor gyis bdag gzhan don grub rje)sa dra/ bzhinade nyid kyis 'chibalas rgyal cing / /mngon par 'dod pa 'jig rten gyi gang zag dbang thob pa bla ma dang ba shes rab che ba brtson 'grus dang ldan pa rtsa/ma sa spu)sa/ sha sdo/nga / /'o na de gsal bya na nge/ bzhin nyid ni stong nyid bshad/ /ngag dbang gi lta ba sems tsam rnam bdun yin rnam pas gzugs nas rnam pa mkhyen pa'i bar gang stong zhe na pa ni snang ba 'di sems yin kun mchog nyid bral can/ /de kho na nyid rtag bslabs na nyid kyi mtshan nyid yan lag bdun du nyams su blangs na'o/ /'chi ba blu bar 'gyur ba yin/ /chos gaṭās med de la mtshan dang dpe byad du snang bas longs sku de gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi stong pas chos sku de la ci yang sprul pas sprul sku'o dper na sems ①nyid dbyer med pa la gsum du'o/ /2)par 'o/ngas rje/nga) (1 sa/gas nga/nga / /lam gyi dus rgyu sbyin pa la sogs pa bsod nams kyi tshogs dang shes rab kyi tshogs de nyid kyang rang bzhin dbyer med du gnas la de'i gnad kyis 'bras bu sku gsum yang dbyer med do/ /'o na 'chi blu min pa stong nyid des gzhan mi 'byung ngam na/ sbyin dang lam rmi khyad par ji lta bu zhe na med sngo la khrims sa/gas dbye/rab cesang shes rab las gud na ma grub pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad ro gcig par snang ba rnams so dmigs pa kun kyi spyor ba ni/ /dmigs pa sems nyid du gnas thams cad rnam pa spangs kyang lus gang yang grub pa med do/ /de spyod kyi rang min nam zhe na rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa yis—/ /gzugs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar ro/ /stong pa yin par rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnam sa pra1 nas gzugs stong pa'i stong pa nyid gzugs stong pa nyid la sogs dang yang gzugs mi lam lta bu nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du mi lam lta bur gsungs so gsang 'dus dang gud nas skyeb med pa'i chos 'di la skyob 'di — rab 46byed1091

tu bsgrags kyis gas/ngas pa te/ /'o na de nyams su ji ltar len na nyams su len thabs kyi sgo nas rgyas par 'chad bsam bya bsam par mi bya zhing / /bsam pa stongapaphyang chad min pa'ang mi bsam mo/ /yul dang yul can de kho na la 'jog pa dang bral ba'i bsam gtan sgom pa bsam/ dang bsam min ma bsams ①stong nyid byang tshad na/ /de mthar thob pas de nas stong nyid chosaskumathong bar 'gyur/ /'di man go 'jug sdud mkhas pas dngos po mi bsam zhing / /dngos po med pa'ang mi bsam zhing / /dngos dang dngos med rnams ②spangs pa/ /bsgom pa de ni bsgom dang bral/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /stong nyid 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa'i/ /stong pa nyid ni rtag bsgoms na/ /'chi bdag gis ni mthong mi 'gyur don dam par 'chi ba med/ /kun rtog tsam kun rdzob tu dus ma yin par 'chi ba sogs las byung ba yi① 'chi ba de yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bdud ni mang po dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yang ni mi mthong ngo / /de yang lusa'achi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di/ /dngos po kun la yod min gyi/ /so so'i skye bo rnam 'phrul gyi/ /rnam par rtog pas bcom pa yin—/ /rnam rtog sdug bsngal thams cad de/ /rnam par rtog pa bdud ces bshad/ /de bas rnam par rtog gzhom zhing / /rnam par rtog med nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gus pa la sogs gzhi dad pa dang ldan pas khyad par gyis/ /rgyun tu bsgoms pa gang dngagang yin pade/ /de dang de rnams kyi thabs des goms pas bsam par nus sam zhe na nus la de ni gsal 'gyur te/ /dper na 'dodachagasadang myangan bu gcig po shi ba dang 'dra blo dang mtshungs/ /bstan bcos 'chi ba blu ba'i gzhung rnams ni rnyed sla yi/ /de la nyes pa'i de'i sbyor ba rnyed par dka'/ /man ngag gam sgom pa sbyor ba shes pa'i man ngag yod pas 'jig rten la/ /sbyor ba 'bras bu 'byin pas tshegs med rnyed par dka' ma yin/ /sbyor ba rnams 'chi ba blu ba'i la mkhas shing dang / /bzod dang brtson 'grus la rab gnas/ /46—1092

bsgrub la brtson pa'i shes rab can/ /'chi ba blu ba'i snod yin no/ /lusadal dang smin dang btung kha zas btung ba zhu zhus pa sogs kyi/ /'pho ①ba'i me ni 'bar gyur pa/ /me ni rab tu 'bar gyur zad/ /yongs zhu bar yang nus pa yin/ /yongs zhu ba lasadangs sogs byed pas lus rgyas shing / /rgyas pas stobs ni rnam par 'phel /stobs las tshe ni rnam par 'phel/ /de 'phel ba las ring du 'tsho/ /kun byi dngos sogs ma byed na nang du 〈 ba mngon sum nyid du 'grub/ /'di la som nyi ji ltar yod/ /de bzhin man ngag yodanabaskal pa sogs/ /medan 'tshe bar yang ni the tshom med/ /mar me'i dpes gdams mar dang snying po zad sdongabusogs kyis/ /mar me la sogs 'jig phyogs pas/ /slar yang 'bru mar sogs 'phrad las/ /bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa yin/ /de bzhin du ni lus nirang gi 'di yang / /rgas sogs kyis ni 'chi bzhin pa—/ /grub pa'i man ngag legs snyed na/ /bskal pa'i mthar yang ci mi gnas/ /dper na khang pa snying pa'idapesagadams dag /bcos pa yis ni yun ring bganas/ /de bzhin dusnying pa'i lus dag kyang / /bcos pa'i ①gnas par cis mi 'gyur/ /'bad pa yi byasanani dka' ba ci yang med/ /de bas bsgrims te 'bad rtsol 'dor mi bya/ /rgyadape'i gdams rtag tu 'bad na chu rgyun 'jam pos kyang / /dus su rdo leb dag kyang rnam par 'bigs/ /bsrubs na shing las me ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / /brkos ①par gyur na sa las chu 'byung 'gyur/ /debs na minirtsol bar brtson 'grus bcas la mi 'grub med/ /'bad par rig pas brtsams nas bsgrubs na/ kun 'bras bcas 'gyur/ /'di ni 'chi ba blu ba rnams/ /shin tu 'chi blu mi 'dra ba'i bye brag mang po shes na yang / /nyams ma blangs na mal du ni/ /bshang bas gos te khyo 'chi 'gyur//gang zhig sbyor ba la phyi'ibyabal dga' ba mkhas shing / /bstan bcos la byang mkhas pa 46—1093

rnams—/ /nyams ma blangs pa'i nyes pa yis/ /so rtsegagis ni ston cing 'chi ba yin//rnal 'byor gyi ni bstan bcos dang / /sbyor ba du ma shes na yang / /deng ngam sang ni bya'o zhes/ /de ltar sems zhing 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de ring 'di'ajig rten gyi bya ba bya nang par slar yang 'di bya de nas gzhan yang 'di bya zhes de la zad pa med/ /srid pa g.yo ba'i rang bzhin ma shes paradon med yid rton mi'agrub par 'tshol bar byed/ /skye dgu 'chi bdag khar ni chu srin kha ru gru bzhin zhugs pa ltar/ /bya ba mthar ma phyin par yul byi chu'i rba klong nang du lhung ste 'gro bas bsgrub ①ces bya'o/ /de ltar 'chi bdag dgra bo ni/ /blu ba'i thabs 'di bshad pa yin/ /rang sangs rgyas zer gzhan mu stegs gzhung las grub pa yi/ /bsam gtan las ni rab bsgrubs bya/ /snying brtse bamed 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las/ /thar ba'i thabs ni 'bad de bya/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na ④gang phyir 'di na yid 'ong ba/ /srogs las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gdan bzhi dang / /sangs rgyas bla gab la sogs dang / /mu stegs kyi yin zer dus kyi phyi ma bla maslad kyi ming dus 'phreng ba/ /dus kyi lnga bcu pa dag ni//sman yig 'tsho ba lnga bcu pa la sogs/ /bstan bcos 'bad de brtags nas ni/ /'chi ba rnam par blu ba 'di brtsams①/ /'gro del rjes su brtse bas bshad/ /nam mkha' yongs dag ston ka'i zla ba du'adra bar/ /dag cing nam mkha' yang ni mi shong ba'i/ /dge ba 'di las mi 'chi gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba 'chi bdag las thar shog /nyon mongs yi ge pa rnams ni/ /brtsi ba yis ni ngal gyur na/ /gzhung 'di'i tshad du gyur pa ni/ /sum brgya lnga bcur bcas pa yin//slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i 'chi ba blu ba bstan pa las le'u bzhi pa'o// //46—1094
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (26༷7)

bar chad srung phyir dang po de las thar ①bar byed pa'ibasgrub thabs bshad/ /phyi 'chi bdag lus kyi bdud nang phungagasang stonamongs ba don gyi bdud/ /lta ba'i phyogs lhung skye lugs gsum/phyi nang gsang de kho na de las thar byed gshed po lhun gsum bzhi/ / brtsams pa'i dgos ched ①me rigasang ba'i rgyud las 'ongs pa nyid/ /rgyudan rgyas pa 'dirabasdus ①te dkrugs pa 'dir bsdebs—/ /rdo rje'i gdan nas lho phyogs kyidapag tshad brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong 'das pa'i 'og na lcags khang dgu' rim na/ /sgo med do zla)bzhi 'grob rigs drug 0thams cad skyeshi la gnas pas gshin por gyur pa'i/ /srog dngadabugasathamasacad dbang du bsdud cing④ za bar byed pa'irje'o/ /'chi' bdag las kyi gshin rje mgo rgu ④pa de'i 'khor ging po dang / /bdud mo nag mo ging karamo sde brgyad yongs kyi rje de/ /de'iganyen po bde' gshegs sku'i 'jam dpal sku'i rigs 'dzin pas byen brlabs las/ /'jam dpal de'i sprul pa'i khye chung sngon po sdon 'byung ye shes gshin rje des/ /las kyi gshin rje'i skye 'gro khro bo'i gzugs dang mthun par bstan nas las ci byed na/ /'chi' bdag srog dbugs za bar byed pa ④btul te dam la btags nas zas skaladzee/ /'o na nyid ci za zer ba la za res zhing bcu' bsgrubapa'i chos la b.rachad byed pa'o//dang / /semasacan kun gyi dus las 'chiba'izhag bdun bskos kyi snga bar srog las so /sngags kyis btab pa'i byin gyis brlabs ⑨pa'idam rdzas byin pas/ /desa'achi bdag kyang rang gisrog snyingamadongs srol duphul nas/ /bstan pa srung bar dam bcas ste/ /gsang sngags che bas 'ingargyal gyi dbang bskur nas/ /'dzin pa drag po'i sache⑩bang rgyal nibatre/da/ /khye/ shi gnyis kyi sa las sgral/ /'das shakya thub kyi bstan pa 'dis nas sngo/'ab 'jig rten las bzab tha/nga sgyu ga pas/ /gnyis kyi mtshalas su gzhag ⑪go/ /phyi'am galnga/na rje de'i yangagashedapor rgyudalasagragasapa yin/ /gshedapo de'i rjes su 'jug cing bsgrub par byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor srung ba'i yan lag ni/ /dngapobasnyen cing b.radubasgrubs 46byed1103

te mthar lasal sbyar/ /don lhunagrub gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub rgyud la sbyar/ /dang po ye shes lha nyebarabasnyen na/ /bar chad bsal thabs phyi nang gsang ba de kho na cha gsum legasaske/ /phyi'i 'gron dgye' phyogasaskyongabacu'argyalachenabazhi la/ /rten ①mthongagazugs mtho cho ga ltar mchod cing las la bgo'/ /sngamorabyas la dam sri bskrad dmar gtor la gro phye dang lcags phye can byin/ thugs ka nas de las rlung gi rnga mo gdeng ser por bskyed de la phyag rgya dam sri bstem 'jug rlung gi chos kyi rgyal po'i khang par 'phang phyir mi 'chor bar gnyer gtad gnan bgegs rgyal pos btang gnan bye// / gzhal las khang dusres/bas suzhu/gas de'i:/ nang sa/nga ba sgo la ga2)ba/sa / /lta ba de kho na nyag cig don la rtags gnas pas/ /phyi nang stongapar rgyas btab bar chod bral/ /nang sprul pa sgyu mas tshar bcad pas/ /'on kyang blo bur gyirtog bgegs zhi/ /dgos pa ④dngos grub dam pa'i snod kyi dri ma sbyang ba/ /kunagazhi la rten pa'izhen pa'ibag chags stug pos yang dag pa'i dngos grub sgrib parabyed parade/ /dbang po dmigs te gdung ba'i sems dngabacas pas/ /snod tshig 'gyod pa'i gdungabashugs bcas dbyung / /gang nyes padran pas ra bya la yulala'ajug ngag du bton la bshags/ /rnam rtog gyod shing yeshesachen po'i mes bsregs shing / /rig pas btags rjopas rtog pa rangabazhin med par shes pa de ldog /rang snang 'od kyis ma rig bag chags sel/ /sgo gsum lhar gsal ba'i spyo da 'a ma rmi chu sbyo/na bye/sa bag chags kyi dri ma rjodagabyu/sa la lus ngag yid gsum ltar rjogasa' / /dam chig gi bdud rtsi brlab zla steng dzas lngabakod yig 'bru lngas 'i 'phro 'dus bdud ci sbyang / /srin mtheb bar du hri dmigs te de las bdud rtsi bab la dang gong ma/ hūṃ dkar ser gsang chen ye shes kyi bdud ci rang bzhin med par shes pa ste ④nyag cig 'bru dgus drang zhing/ /rta'i yeshes kyi hri 'bru bsdus dam dang gnyis sumed parabasre'/ /nyes pa ces pas bdag slob ma dag tha shudhas bsalalabasang gtor bya yag ṣas bzag chod bsrung / /nyi ma ma las rang gi thugs ka nas paṃ las chuspre/sa.a las zla 46byed1104

gdan la/ /hūṃ mthing thugs a dmar gsung chadakar sku'i snying bos bskul/ /hūṃ hūṃ sa ma ya ste hūṃ ya ra na phaṭa hūṃ sang ha ra na hūṃ des 'dre'o/ /sbyang dkyil ye shes lha mos drugagis dgang / /de nas ma badzra masathi ta hūṃ mthing / a dmar/ ma bi shu ta/ de nas badzra yag sha kro tas bgegs bskrad 'dus pas khro bo'i gur du gyur/ yi/lasaka pa la ces ban dha gzhal yas su ram sbyangs gyisarag ta sregs/ /ra 'a sa zabag ta phyi rag ta'i rgya mtsho nang lha mo dmar mo ban dha dmar gyis bkang ba/ gsang ba padma yum gyi/ snya ga'i rakta/ bde bskyed pa tshar gsum bskyed/ /ming giyig gedang po dulhamosurang sngags a gzhan dang phyag rgyas/ /bya/lnga/ tham sna so sozag sgra'i lha mo snyan la thim sogs ཿ/zag/ /rjo/'a pa logs na yod dam zhe na soms kyi mchod pa'i cho 'phrul yin/ /hūṃ gang ltar yang mi rtog stong nyid spros rangabazhin rang dang bral bdebade nyid/ /rang snang rig pa masdzanyid mkha' ltar yangs deganyis/ /dbyer med thugs rnams kyi rang rtags hūṃ de/ /brtan par bya bas 'phro 'du gnas pa 'phro 'du la sogs dal kun gyi gzhi/ /①mkha' lnga yumalnga'idabyengs sdus pa nyid drug rang rig kyi mkha'/ /'byung balnga rnam par dag pasangang la gnas/ /gos med thabs zlabadang shes rab nyilas/ /gshin rje pho mo gdul bya zil gnan 'phrin las dus su srin po ru tra pho mo las la ya ma bsnyen bsgrub dus su skul②/ /rnam rtog srin bu ru tra dbang sdus rig par byangasems su gsal/ /yama'iskabs kyi lho phyogs kyis ya ma nyon mongs pa'i nga rgyal zhi ba ma te/ /che ba bde' gshegs rig pa rang snang du kun byi pho brang rdzogs/ /yab sku dang yumagasung thugs thugasaphyinang gsang bdagusprugs/ /yab yum rigasku'i khyen du rdzogs/ /khams gsum srid gsum lus ngag yid gsum nang gi 'jam dpal nyid dunang gi 'jam dpal rnam par dag pa ni/ /'dir bsdus pas rtsa lha'iba'i ma 'dal la/ /gshed po bzhi yeshesarang snang lha thugs ye shes labaspyod chog mi dgos par rdzogs/ /sras mchog yon tan ma mo gsum 'phrin las gshed po ni/ /cha las grags pa 'gron gyi phyogs skyong dur khrod sgo 46—1105

ma'o lnga/'o/ /lha srin che/sgom phyogs skyong ye shes kyi ngasasbyo/2) mon pho mon mo bal mo gsum du nga sa sa pa 'a sa/ la sbyar/ /bskul ba'i hūṃ 'odade'i sbyor ba'i thugs rjes ①las gnas lngar byung ba/ /bode'i rten la phyogasaskyong don gyis bskul ba'i rtags/ /thod pa'ikhang rigs ④zhi balnga'i bud dha'iye shes lngardzogs paste/ /tshogs brgyad yeshesalnga rang grol bde chen dbang thob/ /rang thugasayeshes snang ba'i 'od yi gegasum nyid las sku oṃgasung sathugs kshi/ /lus ngag yid gsum kapag tsir byin brlabs mchog /gsang ba sngags kyi sgo bzhi ni sgron ma gsal byed don dam mchog gi sgo thugs dam bskul tshig byed gsang bsngags kyi sgo mtshan ma brda' rtags phyag rgya gar gyi sgo dmigs pa rtse gcig nying 'dzin sgom pa'i sgo skul tshig sngags rgya ting 'dzin gyis/ /skur bzhengs drang zhing brtan byas te/ /gnas sa ma mo gsum bsnyen bzla gam skabs kyis las sbyor 'khyam so sor sbyar/ /dedagarang rang stan dang lag char bcas/ /lungagisgo bzhisasna la phyag 'tshalaphyag btsal phyi'i su tsa lnga dbul/ /denasalha mo thim dag pa'i rdzas lnga dug gtor mar rakta gnyis gsum dang / /'byor pa'i tshogs dag drung bzhag dusabazhirabastab/ /he ru kas dgongs su gsol nas mchod bshags dngos grub la bskul/ /las bsgo 'dod pas gsol ba gdab/ / gtumachen gyis bstodacingabaskul laye shes lha'i bsnyen padrang / /rig pa nyidayiga'abru bcu bdun lhar de nyid lha bcu bdun gyi ngo bo drangs te/ /lha du bzlas phar spros dam bskulalas bdag gzhan gyis rdzogasapa nidang po'o/ /shesapaskyelugs rang grol don du drangs pas lhun gsum rnam pa lha dang sngags su dag /sgo gsum rang snang gnyis par bskyad rdo rje'i nang du 'gal me ltar/ /nang gi gsung sngags su bzlas lasku ye shes kyi gshin rje thugs rdo rje gsung sngags/ gzhan du mi dmigs par gsal bar du dmigs pas nus pa bskyed 'khor lor bskor/ /nus pathonapas drag sngags gang bsreg 'phang sogs las rnams 'grub/ /the tsom med blos gong gi lha don sngags don gsum lha don sngags 'grub/ /'jugasdud zhal mthong gi bstod pas 46—1106

rnam gsum don lha don sngags su yid kyi mos par bstod la sbyar/ /las grub ging po dngaging lcama'akhor bcas la/ /lhag ma kha chus 'dod pa sbyin/ /gtor len bskang zhing las bcol bya/ /grubagator tsho gsum dang po zhiba'ime lha mchod/ /bar ma mi bzad gter chen dal 'og tu ste/ /tha ma gtan ma bdud mgasum gyis mos zor kha 'phang bskang zer/ /tram̐ las rin chen tre 'dan tre log spar na phaṭa ces pas mchod sdong du dmigs la 'gron khyab parabyasapas/ /tshogs chen po gnyis ka po gnyis res 'jog med par zung la tshig chod du gnas—/ /nang gi snying po'i hūṃgi'od zer gyis/ /dpekhab len byis ni lcags sdud ltar/ /mtha' dbus nas spyod la nasarang rig par bsdus te snying por hūṃbaskyal/ /dad las rangagasal lhar gsal lus bsrungs ①la/ /'gro' nyal 'dug sdod tshe/ /gsal ba'i don las ma nyams rgyun bye/sa de baḥ/na ཿ/rab hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ /rtags yig brgya bcu pa ltar mtshan ma bzang ngan brtag ①cing ngananabarachod bsal/ /bsnyen lha'i rtags bzang ba tshad la phebs nas tshulabazang ba'i dngos grub bsdu'/ /sgrubapa'ibar chod bsal phyir rangagi don bsgrub pa/ /'khor nyen che gsung lo sogs gsad pa dang drag sngags kyis gsad pa sde brgyad 41gas/ /'dil bca' lnga gang la mos pa lalas 'phro' yodapayinache/ /drag po'i gnas su brtson 'grus bskyed pas bgrub①/ /phurapa gdab sa drag po'i sbyin bsregabya ba zor 'phang ba'i las bya zhing / /klusogs gdug pa'i canagyisatshogs la gtad dam gdon de'i lus la gzer du mnan yang na gnan pa bya/ /grub nas klusabadag gso'azhing gnan pa dbyung ba dang btang rags btang ba gces/ /rtsi sman gyi gter tshab dug zhags gdon gnodapa la'ang gong gi de bzhin las brtsams namachog du shis/ /'gro ba'inang lus 'byung ba bzhis la bsgrubs rjopas/ /'dus byas yin des na 'brasabu'ajig pa'i gshin po ste/ /dus skad cig ma'i snga phyir kyis 'gyur ba'i lo sum cu yar 'gyur de nas mar 'byur go 'byed rje/ /de bsgral ba'i 46byed1107

thabs de'igashed por lus skye 'jigs med par rdorjer bsgrub/ /spyimagrin lte snying 'khor lo lnga nyid me rlung rkyen gyi 'khor lo rim nas rim mas rlung yar 'bar rigs lnga 'am rdo rje sems dpa' yas 'dzag pas so—/ /bskul ba'i ting 'dzin drag bo bsgom/ /dam rdzasamu zi la sogs pa lnga skyobs bcas sman rtsa ba lnga'i nang nas nye shing ba'i bcud blang / /lhunagasum snying pornalamangesapar rnyed nas rig pa gsal bas rnam par ma g.yos par 'grub/ /brda' dang yul dge slong zong zad zong med ma ning ①bzhir gsang ba'i las/ /rangaka med na nas zhen spyod 'dod pas ngan song gsum gshin por skye bar byed/ /thig le'u nus pas skam chags zhen pas rang kha'i rang dbang med pa sred pa rje 'o/ /de'i thabasagashed po bde stong bsgrub/ /thabasani gsang ba'i yab rdo rje'i yum padma'i sras bde stong phrad pas khams gsum ma spangs rol/ /thig le'inus pas ①stong nyid kyi bde' ba skye'o/ /rtsa gnas nas jing du dbab gzung rdo rje'i rtsa bar dkyil zlog spyod pa nas rlung srog lusabazungs bcud bsre'/ /snying por lhunagasum don gsal 'dus ma byas rdo rjer 'grub/ /bden par donaganas pa ma mthong bas/ /yin par de ma yin la bzung ba nor pas bslus/ /gshin po skye rga na 'chir smin/ /rje bo sgo lnga nyon yid rnam skyelugs gsum nyid du mtshungs/ /de'i gshed po lhunagasum bden paraganasapalha//mthong lhun gnas bde don thugs phrad rtogs so ma lhug pa rang tang 'dris pas gshin rje bsgral/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin 'jam dpal rnamapagazhon nu gshin rje mtshan nyid gshed/ /shesapa gsum lhun gsum du btso ma bdud bzhilas rgyal ba'i dpa' bochen po 'grub pa'o/ /sdod lugs 'khor 'das thams cad e ma'o thams cad 'jam dpal gzhon nu yin pa las/ /gzhan gyis ma phrogs byedapa pos ma sbas rang gi rnamartog mthus bral/ /don gyi bdud bzhis 'gro ba gaparadu bsgrub po brnyas/ /phyi nang gsang don bar chad bsal phyir mthong ba 'dir bsdus/ /'gal ba 'gyuranayang sprul dpa' bos don bar chod bzhi po don rtogs pas 46byed1108

nang phyi bar lding ba'i bar du gcod pa'i rang la gnas pa gzhan nas snang bar spyi gzhi brtsams tshul bar/gas sgribapa sbyangs—/ /dka' bas byas pa'i dge bas bar chod bzhi po kun srungs lhun gnas grub/ /thig le nyag cig rang sar gnas 'grob 'dren pa'i 'jam dpal dushog /thigale nyag gcig ①sar gnas 'gro ba'i 'drenapa'ajam dpal dushog /gdams pa nges pa'i don ldan lta sgomaspyod pa la the tsom spongs la bsgrubs// //chos thams cad 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed por bsgrub pa'i thabs/ slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //slob dpon chen po dpal seng ge'i 'od can shrisingahadang / dge slong bee ro tsa nas yul dha he na'i 'du' khang du zhus shing bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o—/ / //46byed1109

༄ga /gshin rje gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/①༄/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya manta ka rakta dre wa pañtsa bhi sa ma yā ṅgad dhi mañdza ②ri nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la re shig dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ yid dang 'thun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ bdud rtsi ril bu lce la bzhag te/bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsum ①thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi 46byed1111

mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yid dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o//dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bgyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas pha rgyud ltar byas la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste—/ /dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad 'thol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib ①nyes rtsang gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu rang nyid la thim pas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar por gsal ba'i snying khar a yig dmar po/de las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas dbu rgyan pa spyan drangs la/ na mo ghu ru bhyaḥbla ma dang / na maḥya mā ri rakta maṇḍal bhyaḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo tsar tsi ka la sogs pas mchod par bsams la oṃ ya mā 46—1112

ri rakta maṇḍal sa pa ri wa ra/ zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i arge/ pa tram̐ pu྾ dhu pe a lo ke gadhe ①ṣpebyu te oṃ badzra shaste sogs kyis mchod la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rje ④yid rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par barmi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi ①'gron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par babyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /zhes rgyun bshags byas nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub du ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa ding nas bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug du/ /46—1113

sbyin pa rnam bzhi brtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi—/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas—/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma 'byin pa dbyugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la bkod//zhes pas sdom pa bzung / sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /sna tshogs stong par rnam par bsam/ /rgyu yis kyang ni mtshan ma med/ /rnam par rtog dang bral nyid phyir/ /smon pa rnam par yangs pa'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya snyo na badzra swa bha wa adma ①ko haṃ/ chos thams cad rang gi sems nyid la zim sems nyid na de'i rang bzhin 'od gsal nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor—/ ram̐ las rnge'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de rnams 'gres ②pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de la 'od 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyogs 'tshams rdo rje'i rang bzhin kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ /de'i dbus su baṃ dang rdo rje las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas 46—1114
