yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rgyu las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/sgo'i thad so bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang bya pho mos mdzes pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po las/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i ba gam las thur du 'chang ba'i rin chen shar bu'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba/ phyi rol byi stegs bu 'dod yon byi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo du mas mchod rdzas thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa—/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ gzhan yang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / dril bu dang / me long dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang phyi nang kun tu 'od zer gyi snang ba 'khrigs pa/dngas shing sgrib pa med pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus sngo/ shar dkar/ lho ser nub dmar byang ljang ①bar gyur pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ e yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su/ hūṃ las byung ba'i dbyug pa dkar po mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi lte bar hūṃ yig dmar po mtshungs pa med pa de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/46—1115

tshur 'dus/ dbyug pa mtshan ma dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od las lhag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yon rkyang gi stabs kyis ma te dmar po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dang / sma ra dmar ser gyen la 'bar ba dang / spyan gsum skal ba'i nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ shangs kyi khongs nas drag po'i rlung ldang ba/ rkan sgra brdabs pas sa thams cad 'dar ba/khams gsum za ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba brtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing drag du bzhad pa/ mgrin pa hūṃ gis gang ba/ brang zheng dang / bsus khyim dang rla sha shin tu rgyas pa/ yan lag dang nying lag rags shing gtum pa/srin po khros pa mi'u thung gel ba'i rnam pa can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang ldan pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / stag gi pags ①pa'i sham thabs 'phyang ba phyag g.yas pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gye dbyug pa nam mkhar bskor zhing bsnun pas bdud dpung thams cad kyi yan lag 'dam bu ltar brugs par byed pa 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs khar 'dzin pas yum la khyud ④pa/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa ①'dzin pas yab la mkhyud pa/gnyis ④ka 'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i dbyug pa dkar po sna tshogs 46—1116

rdo rje'i rtse mo can/ mi mgo rlon pas shin tu mtshan pa shin tu dngas pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dmar po 'tshungs pa med pa/yum gyi lte 'og tu padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du hriḥyig dmar po mchog tu 'bar ba rtse mo re kha dkar po gyen du langs pa/ rang gi gsang bar hūṃ las rdo rje dmar po byang sems kyis rab tu gang ba/ /yum gyi gsang ba ā las padma dkar dmar ①'od zer sna lngas khyab par gyur/ /de nas/ sarba ta thā ga tā a nu rā ga na badzra swa bha wa adma ①ko haṃ/ zhes brjod cing / snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ gis sangs rgyas yab yum thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs te snying khar zhu ba rdo rje lam nas yum gyi pad mar babs te/ hūṃ mo paṃ re e/ ches pa'i sa bon las lha lnga po'i thugs khar sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan par skegyur nas/ yum gyi dku ④nas phyung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa spyi dang khyad par thams cad mdzad nas/tshur 'dus te 'dab ma shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mdog dkar po/tsar tsi ka nag mos mkhyud pa/ lho ser sna gshin rje gshed sku mdog ser po/phag mo ser mos mkhyud pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ dbyangs can ma dkar mos mkhyud pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed sku mdog ljang khu/ go ⑤rī ljang khus mkhyud pa/ dpa' bo rnams gtso bo dang cha lugs 'thun zhing / dpa' mo rnams gtso mo dang cha lugs 'tshungs par gyur/ shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ lho nub tu gser gyi bum pa bla rtsis gang ba/ nub byang du byi ru'i bum pa se las gang ba/ byang shar du dngul gyi bum pa ga pur kyis gang ba/ thams cad thod 46—1117

pas kha bcad pa/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs khar hūṃ sngon po/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros sku gsung thugs kyi lha thams cad spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim/ beer yang hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ mchod pa lngas mchod/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣiñtsa tu mam/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de ba thams cad kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes pas bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku thams cad gang dbang bzhi thob/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ①ma yar lud pas gtso bo yab yum la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / gzhan rnams la mi bskyod ④pas dbu rgyan par gyur nas lha'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ba'i skyed rim la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag ste①/ de'i 'og tu/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad lha dang lha mo la snyim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor dang bcas pa gtso bo yab yum la thim yab yum hūṃ la/ de yang zhabs kyu u ha la thim—/ ha zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā dā la thim/nā dā stong pa nyid nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsgoms te/ mthar yid la byed pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par gzhag dupar bya'o/ /de nas 'od gsal las langs nas/ rten dang rten pa'i dkyil 'khor zung 'jug gi rnam pa can skad gcig dugis gsal btab ste rjothugs kha'i hūṃ gi mtha' skor du/oṃ triḥji yī kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa mgo gyen du bstan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan bsdus te bzlas pa'am/yum gyi steng 'og gi zhal gnyis nas 'khor bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ⑦yon 46—1118

tan yum la bsdu zhing / de rang nyid la bsdud pa'i sgo nas zlas ①pa la sogs pa man ngag bzhin bya'o/ /'khor rnams la nga rgyal 'pho ba'i tshul kyis de bzhin du bzlas pa'am/ yang na snying po bskul ba'i tshul kyis spro bsdu'i bzlas pa snga ma de nyid bya ste/ de la rang gi yum gyi sngags ni/ oṃ dwo sha ra ti nu ṭa nu ṭa/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ hūṃ dza swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /dpa' bo bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ mo han ta krid hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ba shu nan ta krita hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra gan ta krita hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ i ra ṣa na ta krita hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'o/ /dpa' mo bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ mo hā ra tī hūṃ dzaḥ.oṃ pi shu na ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ.oṃ ra ga ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ.oṃ i ra ṣa na ra ti hūṃ dzaḥzhes pa'o/ /bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang / bdag gis tshe 'di nyid la gshin rje gshed 'grub par gyur cig /zhes smon lam btab po/ /oṃ a beeghān ta kri ta hūṃ gis bsad/ oṃ swa bha wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs nas/ ā las padma'i snod la sogs par/ oṃ agaḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzang zhing dge ba/ 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs 1kyi bar du 'jug par gyur/ de nas rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad bkug ste/ zhal nas zhugs snying khar zhu/ de nas pad mar babs te mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs su gyur nas mchod par bya ste/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / /shel la tshon ni ji lta bur/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor chos la spyod par shog /a la la ho rol tu gsol/ /mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /gar gyi dges par rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol du gsol/ /chags pa med par chags par mdzod/ /oṃ 46—1119

sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ad ma ko haṃ/ de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gshin rje gshed/ dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti zhabs/ dza ma ri pa a tsarya / bla ma lo tstsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa/ lo tstsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ rin po che bu ston pa/ lo chen pa/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha re re nas brjod de/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis dbul/ de nas lce la reg ste lus kyi rnams la dbul—/ de nas chos skyong la sogs pa nas/ rigs drug gi bar du rgyas par dbul—/ de nas sngar ltar snyoms 'jug byas nas/ a nu ra ga'i sngags brjod de gsang mchod dbul nas/ nam mkha' gang ba'i khams gsum rmi lha thams cad snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i bde ba'i sgras rgyal zhing rtog pa 'gags pa'i mthar bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag ①ste/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa mngon du mdzad nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi gtso bo la bstod pa/ kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po gzugs rang bzhin/ /khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin yongs—/ /khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa'i khro bo'i yid/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku ni dmar zhing thung ba ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /byāḥji'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel/ /rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba rnams la gzigs④/ /zhes pa dang / sgra 46—1120

snyan gyi tshul byi ①tshul du gtso bos 'khor rnams la bstod pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshen po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod / /gshin rje gshed po kun tu 'jigs/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab gsal ba//rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /khyab bdag chags pa'i chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog② /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / slar yang de rnams kyis gtso bo la bstod pa/sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus snepa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal / /zhes pa'o/ /de nas phra dudog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal du 'phos te / gtor ma dang po mchod pa ltar bsang sbyang byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad ma ra ga 'dab brgyad pa ze 'bru dang bcas pa/ de'i ze 'bru la yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngo skya g.yo ba ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du re las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i pad ma'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ mi mgo gsum gyi sgyid bu la gnas pa/ de'i shar la sogs par/ rgyu saṃ badzre khaṃ hūṃ las byung ba'i sha lnga—/ bi ra shu ma mu las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lnga/ de steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rjes kha bcad pa/ de na sgyed bu la 'bru gsum bzlas pas/ rlung las me g.yos te/ rdzas thams cad khol zhing rdo rje yang 'od du zhu bas/ ro 46—1121

gcig tu 'byes nas/ shin tu rnam par dag pa nyi ma 'char kha'i mdog lta bur gyur te/ beer yang hūṃ las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas/ sngags kyis thim pas mchog tu gyur pa'i bdud rtsir bltas te rim pa bzhin/ lag pa g.yon dang g.yas dang / gnyi ka bstan nas/ oṃ byedahūṃ zhes pas sbyang ba dang / rtog pa dang / 'bar bar gyur/ de nas lha thams cad kyis srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad bkug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du chud pa tsam gyi sa lha so sor gyur nas/ rang rigs kyi lha rnams kyi snying khar thim ste/ 'khor 'das rnams dbyer med pa'i rtogs pa brtan po skyed/de nas lha rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'od kyi ①sbug gu'i rnam pa can gyis bdud rtsi rnams rang bzhin gyis drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ya mā ri bhyaḥ/ sarba bisna na sha hūṃ ma ra ya i rda bā lin kha kha/ khā tī khā tī/zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pas dbul zhing / mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod nas—/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin byed/zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / gti mug rdo rje zhes pa nas/ /phyag na ral gri khrod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod de/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /zhes pa'i bar gyis 'phrin las gzhol zhing / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis pa bsgos kyi chos skyong la sogs pa la cho ga de nyid kyis dbul nas/ chos thams cad pa nyid kyi ngang nas yi ge brgya pa brjod te/ ma 'byor pa dang zhes bya ba la sogs pas bzod par gsol nas/46—1122

kha zas dang ma 'brel na/ bsngo ba nas bsrung bar byas te/ thun 'tshams kyi rnal 'byor ci rigs pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas kha zas gtor ma ltar byen gyis brlabs nas/ khyad par dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la sogs par bltas te/lto ba'i me 'bar ba'i khrod du/ lus kyi lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgoms la/ lag pa gnyis bgang blugs/ kha ho khung / bza' btung rnams sbyin bsreg gi tshul du phul la/ lhag ma rnams u khyuṣṭa ba līnta bhakṣa se swā hā/ 'byung po 'chol ba la sbyin nas/ sbar yang mchod bstod dang / gsol gdab dang / bzod gsol dang ci rigs par/ brtan bzhugs dang / gshegs gsol dang / bkra shis dang / bsrung ba rnams byas te/ bsrung ba ni/ bsdus na/ gnas gsum du oṃ uhūṃ bsgom zhing bzlos pa yin no/ /de nas thun 'tshams kyi rnal 'byor bya ba'i phyir/ phung po lnga la sogs pa rnam par dag pa ni dpa' bo ①lnga/khams lnga la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa ni dpa' mo lnga'o/ /nub kyi phyogs la sogs pa rnam par dag pa ni/ gzhal yas khang ngo / /zhes rnam dag dran par byas te/ snang ba lha dang / grag pa sngags dang / 'gyu ba thugs kyi cho 'phrul tsam du shes pa'i sgo nas/ rjes su chags pa'i yan lag la sogs pas/'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad ci 'dod pas bsten zhing lam du bya ste/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi spyod pa brlabs po che rgya mtsho lta bu la 'jug par bya'o/ /ko nas nyal ba'i tshe/ sngar gyi 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi de nyid kyi sgo nas chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya zhing / ldang ba na lha mo rnams kyi grus bskul nas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po mngon sum du byas nas zung 'jug gi skur langs te/ dbang 46—1123

bskur ba'i cho ga de nyid kyis khrus kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya ste/ de ltar thun bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo nas bar chad med par nyams su blangs na phal cher tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub thob cing / tha ma bskye ①ba bcu drug la sogs pa'i sgo nas mchog gi dngos grub the tshom med do/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyas par bsgom pa bstan zin to// //'bring du bsgom par 'dod na gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi dbyug pa mtshan ma dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor lnga dus gcig du bskyed par bya ste/ lhag ma rnams ni phal cher 'dra la/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor yang / yam̐ las rlung / re las me/ mi mgo gsum gyi sgyed bu'i steng du ye shes kyis ①ka pa la yangs par/ bye saṃ dzi khaṃ hūṃ bi ra shu ma mu las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ lag pa rnams sngar ①ltar bstan nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs pa ⑦dang / rtogs pa dang / 'bar bar gyur/ de nas 'gron bskyed pa dang 'bul ba 'dra zhing / sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑤rang bzhin khyod/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad bzhis bstod de/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor dang bcas//zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las 'chol ba sogs bya'o // //rjobasdus te bsgom par 'dod na tshogs bsags yan chad byas nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mos dad chen po byas pas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis lus gzhal yas khang bsrung 'khor dang bcas par/ lus dkyil gyi cho ga gzhan dang 'thun par gsal btab ste/ snying pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang 'dab 46—1124

mar—/ lha lnga bum pa dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab te/ sku gsung thugs byen gyis brlab pa la sogs pa bya zhing / gzhan ni 'bring po bzhin no/ /mngon par rtogs pa 'di ni rgyud kyi lugs la ji lta ba'i nges pa ste/ 'khor mngal 'byin gyi tshul 'di dag /dngos grub bsnyes pa ma ti zhabs kyang bzhed pa yin te/'on kyang kho bo ni rgyud nas 'byung ba nyid gtso bor byed la/ bla ma rnams ni snga ma gnyis ka la gtso bor byed pa yin no/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa dngos grub kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i slob dpon gsang bas byin gyi zhal mnga' nas mdzad pa dge'o// //bsdur mchan/1111 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉74/ ①〈〈pe 〉rasung /1112 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgribs/1113 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagadadhe/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rjes/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉gis/1114 ①〈〈pe 〉ma / ④〈〈pe 〉〉ngagrel/1115 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 khu/1116 ①〈〈pe 〉phags/ ②〈〈pe 〉ra / ①〈〈pe 〉7thod pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ra/nyi/1117 ①〈〈pe 〉zor/ ④〈〈pe 〉mo / la〈〈pe 〉sir/ du〈〈pe 〉ngos/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉yon/1118 ①〈〈pe 〉sto/ ②〈〈pe〉stasgrod/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉te/ du〈〈pe 〉thazhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉theg rjo〈〈pe 〉〉te/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/1119 sde〈〈pe 〉thazlas/ ①〈〈pe 〉rag ①〈〈pe 〉misdongs/112 ①〈〈pe 〉thazhag khru〈〈pe 〉razugs/1121 ①〈〈pe 〉7)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉7gi mchog ①〈〈pe 〉thasdud/ du〈〈pe 〉sbag1122 ①〈〈pe 〉7)sa/46byed1125
1123 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dpa'o/1124 ①〈〈pe 〉〉par skye/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sngar/ du〈〈pe 〉〉sbyang ba/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉7)sa/ du〈〈pe 〉ska/ //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (26༷9)46wa 1126

༄ga /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi de nyid bshad pa zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs/①ra gshen rje gshed dmar po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༄4ske/ /rgya gar skad du/ raka ta yā mā ri yan tra tā ni rata sha ka na ma sa dha 8/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi de nyid bshad pa zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bud med rnams bsrung ba'i don du ghi baṃ gis par ⑤dkar po'am gro ga'am bsnyug ma'i shun pa'am/ ras legs par bkrus la/ ming gi yi ge na ma dang spel ba'i 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris la/ nag po dang rtsa ba la sogs pa dang bral ba'i kham phor kha dog gcig pa kha sbyar du yang dag par bzhag ste—/ nang du mar dang sbrang rtsi bcug nas/ skud pa dkar pos bkris la kha shar du bltas te/ thun gsum du gshin rje mthar byed sku mdog dkar por bsgoms nas/ me tog dkar pos mchod de/ mdun du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 46—1127

gyi steng du bsgrub bya'i mdog dkar por gnas par bltas la bum pa dkar po zla ba'i bdud rtsis chus gang bas dbang bskur zhing / sngags bzlas so/ /oṃ ①triḥṣṭiḥ bi kri ②ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa na ma/ lha sbyin shan ti ku ru na ma/ zhi ba'i cho ga'o/ /skyes pa rnams ni zhi ba la gur gum gyes so/ /rgyas pa la yang 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te/ yi ge swā hā/ ming gi yi ge/ spel bar mar dang /sbrang rtsi nang du bcug nas kham por kha sbyor du bzhag ste/ skud pa ser pos bkris te thun gsum du me tog ser pos mchod cing / kha lhor bltas te/ gshin rje mthar byed sku mdog ser por bltas te/ zla ba la sogs la sgrub bya mdog ser po gnas par bltas te/ bum pa ser po zla ba'i bdud rtsi ser pos gang bas dbang bskur cing bzlas pa byas te/ oṃ hriḥṣṭiḥbi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hūṃ/ che ge mo la pus ti ku ru swā hā/ ces so/ /āoṃ hriḥṣṭiḥbi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hūṃ①/ ṣa ḍa che ge mo la pus 1 ku ru na shags/ rgyas pa'i cho ga'o/ /gro ga'am ras sam rgya skyegs kyi khu ba'am tsan dan dmar po ming med kyi khrag dang bsres pas 'khor lo gnyis mngon par zis te/ yi ge ho dang ming yig spel bas so/ /mi gnag cing rtsa ba la sogs pa dang kha dog ngan pa dang bcos pa dang / bral ba'i kham phor kha sbyar du bzhag ste/ mar dang sbrang rtsis yang dag par bkang la skud pa dmar pos bkris nas/ me tog dmar pos mchod cing kha nub tu bltas te/ gshin rje mthar byed sku mdog dmar po 46—1128

bsgoms ①te/ zla ba'i dal dmar po la bsgrub bya dmar po gnas pa bsams la/rang gi lus las thon pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu nas bkang bas stsos par 'gyur ba rkang ④dag tu 'gyel bar bsam zhing / sngags bzlas so/ /gang gi tshe dbang du ma gyur pa de'i tshe mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bral ba'i 'khrul 'khor kho na seng ldeng du ba med pa la spro bar bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa byas te/ oṃ hriḥjiḥ①bi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ho/ che ge mo'i mo'o che ge mo'i/ ba shi ku ru ho/oṃ hriḥjiḥdhibi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ṣa ḍa/ che ge mo bdag gi/ ba sha ma na ya ba sha ḍa/ dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /dur khrod kyi ras sam rang byung gi khrag gis spags pa'i ras la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas/ 'khor lo gnyis kun nas bris te yi ge dza' yi ge hri/ ming gi yi ge dang spel nas so/ /kham phor kha sbyar gnyis/ bud med kyi thod pa kha sbyar du bzhag la gos dmar pos bkris te/ me tog dmar pos mchod cing gshin rje mthar byed thun 'tshams kyi nyi ma lta bur sku mdog dmar ba lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa bsgoms nas bsgrub bya'i snying lcags kyus phug ste/ skye ba zhags pas bcings nas/ khrid par bsam mo/ /gang gi tshe mi yong ba de'i tshe seng ldeng gi mes gdug ⑤par bya'o/ /oṃ triḥṣṭiḥbi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥche ge mo a kar sha ya dzaḥ/ rkang pas dgug pa'i cho ga'o/ /dur khrod kyi ras la ba bla'am yung bas 'khor lo mngon par bris te/ yi ge lam dang bsgrub bya'i spel nas so/ /khaṃ phor ser po/ kha sbyar du bzhag ste 46—1129

kham phor ser po la ri mo gru bzhi pa mngon par bris te/ de'i steng du ri rab mchog ①brgyad pa yi ge hūṃ dang spel ba'i cho ga'i steng du dbang chen gyi dal yi ge lo gis mtshan pa sna tshogs rdo rjes bskor ba la skud pa ser pos bkris pa bdag nyid gshin rje mthar byed sku mdog ser po bsgoms nas kha lhor bltas te bsgrub bya'i gzugs ser po dbang chen gyi dal gyi steng du gnas par bsams la rigs brgyad kyi ri dang ri rab kyis mnan ste dbang chen gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan la bzlas par bya'o/ /āoṃ hriḥṣṭiḥbi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa lo lha sbyin sa ①ha ṣpe sta pa ya lo/ nges pa'i sngags so/ /ngag mnan par 'dod pas de kho na bzhin du ming dang spel ba'i 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris la/ lo lha sbyin kyi ya thā a ra bha bha ka ra ya kri dhe ni bā ra ya sto/ bī ru pa ka pa ta che ge mo'i bā ga ste ba rna ku ru lo/ zhes bya ba'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /ngag mnan pa'i cho ga'o/ /lkugs pa bya bar 'dod na dur khrod kyi ras la 'khor lo gnyis sam lha sbyin ①gyi mu kha ban dha ya baṃ/ zhes pas spel ba mngon par bris la/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyis bsgrub bya ma te'i snying khar bcug la/ dbang chen gyi dal bzhi yis za ma tog gzhan du kha sbyar bar bya ste/ res pa'i sbyor ba'i cho ga bri ba dang / bsgom pa'i rim pa bya zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /āoṃ triḥṣṭiḥbi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa baṃ lha sbyin gyi mu kha baṃ dha mu khaṃ ku ru swā hā/ tha snyad la sogs pa rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi ra bal skye tshe dang tsha ba'i mar nag dang / ni bha'i lo ma dang /46—1130

da du ra'i 'o ma'i khu ba dang / ro bsregs pa'i sol ba dang / rang gi 'dzub mo'i khrag gi snag tsha byas/ bya rog chen po'i sgo'i snyu gus 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris te yi ge hūṃ dang bsgrub bya'i ming spel lo/ /kha lhor bltas te bdag nyid gshin rje mthar byed khro bo'i gzugs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis nyi ma'i dal la bzhugs pa zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba gcigs pa/ btum ①pa ljags glog ltar 'gyu ba bskal pa'i me ltar 'od 'bar ba/ phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa/ char sprin dang mtshungs pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ dbu skra gyen du 'greng ba/ sma ra ser po 'bar ba/ chu 'dzin gyi klog lta bu yi ge hūṃ gis mgrin pa'i bu ga gang bar rnam par bsams la/ mdun du bsgrub bya gos dri ma can hrul po gon pa/ lus thams cad thal bas byugs pa nyi ma'i dal la gnas pa spyi rtsug dang mgo bo dang / snying kha dang / lag pa'i rtsa ba'i bar du/pus mo rnams su sngags kyi cho ga byas pa'i go cha'i bsrung ba'i bsrung ba rnams phral nas—/ de'i lus la gnas pa'i lha rnams spyan drangs la/ nye bar bsdus te rang gi lus la bcug nas de khang pa stong pa lta bu bltas la khro bo rnams sna tshogs pas phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa rnams sprul te/ bsnun cing dum bu brgya stong du byas nas sha dang pags pa dang tshil rnams za zhing khrag 'thung la rus pa yang bsreg byung thal bar byed pa dang / mdun du gshin rje char sprin gyi mdog lta bu ma he la gnas pa dbyug pa dang / zhags pa dang 'dzin pa lto ba yangs pa zhal mche ba rnam par brtsigs pa'i gzugs su rnam par bsams la/ de'i snying khar gnas nas za bar bsams nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /cho ga de nyid kyis yi ge hūṃ dang yi ge phaṭa dang ming yig spel ba'i 'khor lo gnyis bris la de kho 46—1131

na bzhin du bsam gtan gyi cho gas gnas pas bsgrub bya lha med par byas la gdong grag pa can me'i dal la gnas pa ni gzugs mi sdug pa'i khro bo rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ phyag na ral gri dang / dbyug pa dang / rtun shing dang / dgra sta dang mda' gzhu dang / 'khor lo dang / rtse gsum dang / tho ba dang /mtshon rtse gcig pa la sogs pa'i mtshon cha thogs pas bsnun cing dum bu brgyar rtub pa dang / bya rog dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / lce spyang dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas za bar bsam zhing sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ hriḥṣṭiḥbi kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ/ lha sbyin ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hri kri bi kri tā na na hūṃ/ lha byin ①ma ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/gsod pa'i cho ga'o/ /de kho na bzhin du yi ge phaṭa dang bsgrub bya'i ming gi yi ge spel ba'i 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bris la thod pa kha sbyor du bzhag ste/ skud pa sngon pos bkris nas gung thun gyi dus su dur khrod du dong bkos par bcug la gshin rje mthar byed kyi rnal 'byor gyis gnas pas/ bsgrub bya gnyis rta dang ma he la zhon pa'i lag na mtshon cha thogs pa/ sprul pa'i rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs phyogs gnyis na gnas pa 'thab mo srod pa bsam zhing sngags bzlas so/ /oṃ triḥṣṭiḥbee kri ta na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha sbyin dang mchod sbyin dag /bi te sha ya phaṭa/rnam par dbye ba'i cho ga'o/ /cho ga de nyid kyis hūṃ yig dang phaṭa yig dang spel ba'i 'khor lo gnyis bris 46—1132

la thod pa kha sbyar du bcug la/ skud pa nag pos bkris te dur khrod du sbas nas gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyis yi ge yi gyur pa las rlung gi dal bsgoms la—/ de'i steng du rnga mo sngon mo ste/ de'i steng du bsgrub bya dgra'i rnam pa lho phyogs su khrid cing rdo rje khro bo'i rtag bzhin par bsgom zhing bzlas pas bskrad ①par bya'o/ /oṃ hriḥṣṭiḥbi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa lha sbyin u tsa ta ya phaṭa phaṭa/bkrod pa'i cho ga'o/ /drag po gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pas gshin rje phyogs te de de bsregs pa'i thal ba dang / khrag dang dug dang lan tsha dang skye tshe dang / tsha ba'i chus dur khrod kyi ras la 'khor lo gnyis mngon par bri'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga gang gsungs pa/ /zla ba bcu bzhi la sha lngas ni byug par bya / /②bdud rtsi lnga yis yang dag ldan/ /bzlas pas yid du 'ong byed mchog /brgya phrag cig gis 'byung po rnams/ /stong gis mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / /yi dwags tshogs ni bsad par bya/ /gshin rje gshed bslabs sbyor bas so/ /bzlas pa 'bum gyis rnal 'byor pas①/ /'di yis las rnams thams cad byed/ /bzlas pa bya rjobs dngos grub 'gyur/ /bye ba lnga yis smos ci dgos/ /slongs mo zla ⑤zhing mi bzlas te/ /ma sbangs pa la chags mi bya/ /rnal 'byor chen pos gsang sngags bzlas/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor rig pa yis/ /sems can kun la byams sems bya/ /nyin re bzhin dang zla re bzhin/ /de bzhin lo ni re re zhing / /dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi mkhas—/ /gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi dbul/ /bgegs kun rnam par bsod 46—1133

nams lhag par spel ba'i phyir/ /de la 'byung po thams cad pa'i/ /gtor ma'i cho ga 'di yin te/ /dri chen dri chu bsres pas/ /maṇa ḍal gru gsum byas nas ni/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gnas/ /phyogs skyong rnams ni yang dgug bya/ /sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya/ /sngags ni/ āoṃ in tra ya hriḥ/yā ma yā ṣṭiḥ ba ru na yā bī ku ba re ya kri/ i sha na ya ti/ ag ṣpe ye a/ ṣpe rita ye na/ bā ya bā na/ tsan dra yā hūṃ/ arka ①ya hūṃ/ prahma ṇi phaṭa/ ba sun dha ra ye phaṭa—/ bee ma tsi tra ni swa/ sarba bu bee sgo ha/ ha ha ha/ tī tī tī/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phe phe phe—/ swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis gang zhig cung zad rgyun du 'thung / gzhan yang bza' ba thams cad kyi phud ni gshin rje gshed la dbul/ zhes bya ba 'dis/de rnams mnyes par byas nas/ bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol to②/ /ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /gang zhig 'dir ni bsod nams cung zhig bsags de yis ni/ /'jig rten mtha' dag mya ngan rnams ①bcom byang chub snod gyur cing / /bdag dang 'gro ba rnams su byang chub lam la nges sbyar te/ /don dam dga' ba yang dag ldan pa'i skur gyur cig /gnas brtan byang chub snying po yis sems can kun la phan gshin pa/ /grub pa'i bsgrub thabs nges par ni/ /ston ka'i zla ba lta bus byas/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khrul 'khor kyi de nyid nges par bshad pa zhes bya'i sgrub rjothabs/ gnas brtan mkhas pa chen po/ byang chub snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs storjo// // rgya gar rjomakhan po bla ma rje btsun/ nyi ma'i snying po'i 'od zer kyi zhal snga nas—/ chag lo tsha ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la 46—1134

phab pa ①bsdur mchan/1127 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉rar/1128 ①〈〈pe 〉stag ②〈〈pe 〉〉kye bi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉tā/1129 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉nepa/ nidu〈〈pe 〉〉waḥ/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bdug113 ①〈〈pe 〉〉chog ②〈〈pe 〉〉snga/ ①〈〈pe 〉stanan/1131 ①〈〈pe 〉stanatum/1132 ①〈〈pe 〉nyagin/1133 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skud/ ②〈〈pe 〉po/ // ③〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉bye/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉za/1134 ①〈〈pe 〉snamarga/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉yo/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/ du〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉so du〈〈pe 〉〉〉gyi/1132 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 bkra shis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2610)46wa 1135

༄ga /gshin gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/①༄/ gshed dmar gyi gshin chog ②bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/smri tī bi bye na ma/ bod skad du/ gshin gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rim pa gnyis ni ldan pa yis/ /bdag gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis/ /rigs drug dug sbyong tshe 'das kyi/ /rnam shes a'i rnam pa dgug /nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ /las kyi dbang gis 'khor bar yun rings 'khyams/ /'khrul pa'i dbang gis mi dge sna tshogs spyad—/ /sdug bsngal 'dam du bying khyod snying re rje/ /dad dang mos pa'i sems kyis 'dir shog la/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma spyi bos mchod/ /'khor 'das gnyis med don la mnyam par zhog /lam mchog 'di la bu khyod 'jug par mdzod/ /oṃ hriḥṣṭiḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ che ge mo a karsha ya dzaḥ/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /46byed1136

stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ /di ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi/ /de'i thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi①/ /sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal ⑤du gsol/ /nyon cig bgegs chen khyod nyon cig /che ge zhes bya'i tshe 'das 'di/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song bas/ /da lta nyid du btang bar gyis/ /khro bo 'bar ba'i bka' byung gis/ /gal te bka' las 'das na ni/ /rdo rje dbyug pa 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas so/ /oṃ triḥṣṭiḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ che ge dang che ge bi de shwa ya phaṭa/ tshe 'das 'di la gnod pa'i bgegs—/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /nam mkha' lding dang sha za'i tshogasaske/ /'byung po mang po thams cad dag /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /gnas 'dir ma gnas myur du deng / /rgyal ba'i bka' la gang 'da' ba/ /gsad cing mnan pa'i las mthar byed/ /oṃ hriḥṣṭi wi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ che ge mo tstsha ṭa ya phaṭa/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /las kyi gshin rje gshin rje'i 'khor dang bcas/ /phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde brgyad bran g.yog bcas/ /ma mo kying chen pho nya'i tshogs rnams nyon/ /che ge zhes bya'i gnod byed chen po 'di/ /sems can yongs la 'tshe byed 'di yin kyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig byed 'di yin gyi/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang dmod byed 'di yin gyi/ /bla ma rnams kyi sku dgra 'di yin kyi/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad 'dis byas kyi/ /'di 'dra nam yang 46—1137

bzhag par ma gsungs pas/ /da lta nyid du gsad cing sgol bar bskul/ /'di la mgon dang bsrung skyob ma mdzad par/ /bdag gis ma nyes bzu dang dbang po mdzod/ /bka' nyan dam can srung ma 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan drang stigadan dbul sngon gyi dam tshig bsgrag /gtor ma mchod stod ②drag po'i las la bskul/ /beegs phye dug khrag mda' phur rdo ral dbal/ /rdo rje la sogs thun brab mtshon gyis bsnun/ /oṃ hriḥṣṭi wi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ che ge mā ra ya phaṭa/ bdud dpung ma lus 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /ya man ta ka yab yum dka' ①byung gi/ /las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yis—/ /gdug dhipa'i dgra bgegs mnan cing bzung bar gyisabu/ /phyogs bzhi phrin las bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan khro bo bzhi'i bka' byung gi//las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mnan cing bzung bar gyis/ /sgo bzhi bdud bzhi dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /las byed sgo ba bzhi'i bka' byung gi/ /las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yis—/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mnan cing bzung bar gyis/ /mtshams bzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /tshad med lha mo bzhi'i bka' byung gi//las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mnan cing bzung bar gyis/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor nas//las byed me ltar 'bar ba'i bka' byung gi/ /las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mnan cing bzung bar gyis/ /oṃ triḥji wi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa che ge stam pa ya lo/ bgegs sbyang sdig pa zhi ba'i don/ /sbyang brab khrus dang sta gon no/ /yongs rdzogs pa'i dbang byin la/ /46—1138

rdo rje can de mchod dang bstod/ /snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa lnga/ /stong pa 'od gsal chen po'i dang / /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku/ /rang bzhin gnas su gshegs par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta swa pā ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ badzra sum̐ḥ—/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /'byung ba bzhi las gyur pa yi/ /rnam smin las grub phung po 'di/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su thim gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūṃ dzha na tsakra dzwa la dzwa la ram̐ ho/ thal ba bsdus la mchod rten bsgrub/ /dbeen pa'i gnas su mchod pa bya/ /yang na ye shes 'khor lo dang / /bcas pa brtag tu 'bad pas mchod/ /rus bu lha 'am bdud rtsir bya/ /sdig pa zhi ba'i cho gas sbyang / /thal ba bsdus la chos skur bya/ /ngan song 'jigs bral mtho ris thob/ /gang de sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur gsung / /gshin po rjes su gzung ①ba'i cho ga 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i paṇḍi ta grub thob chen po ḍo bhi he ru ka pas mdzad pa/ rdzogs sto// //rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dikṣu mang ga la dang / lo tstsha ba zla ba 'od zer gyis rgyang ro rkyang sdepo'i rtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //bla ma rdo rje bzang po'i phyag dpe la bshus/ gzhan gcig yod pa de 'di'i 'brel ①pa yin par gda'/ dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/④ //46—1139

༄ga /gshin rje gshed mthar byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga①kho gshin rje gshed mthar byed kyi cho ga bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du—/ ya mān tā ②ka yan tra bi dhi/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed mthar byed kyi 'khrul 'khor kyi cho ga /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /gshin rje gshed mthar byed kyi 'khrul 'khor brjod par bya ste/ rtsibs brgyad pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /'dir ni gro ga'i 'dab ma la sogs pa la 'khrul 'khor bri bar bya ste/ dang po zlum por bskor ba rtsibs brgyad pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'o/ /gsum pa'i rtsibs bcu drug pa'o/ /de la rtsibs brgyad du phyogs dang 'tshams su gnas pa ces phyogs su lam la sogs pa'i yi ge gnas pa'i 'tshalas kyi 'dab mar bsgrub bya'i ming gi yi ge gnas pa'o//rtsibs bcu drug tu yang bar gyi brgyad du'o/ /de ltar bsgrub bya 'tshams rnams su'o—/ /dang por rlum skor gyi dbus su lte bar ya 'byung ngo / /shar du ma/46byed1141

rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i shar du ra/ gnyis par dzaḥgasum par sa/ bzhi par do / dang por rtsibs brgyad pa'i lhor me/ yang rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lnga par che/ drug par ṇa/ bdun par yo/ yang rtsibs brgyad pa'i nub tu da/beer rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i brgyad par ni/ dgu par ra/ bcu par yā/slar yang rtsibs brgyad pa'i byang du kṣe/ slar rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i bcu gcig par tsa/ bcu gnyis par ni/ de ltar yang / ya ma ra dzā sa do me ya/ ya me ①do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya do yo ni ra ya kṣe ya/ yakṣe ya tstsha ni rā ma yā/ zhes bya ba ni rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsungs so/ /gcig gtso bor byas nas yi ge bcu drug drug ni 'dab ma bcu drug la ste/ 'di ltar dbus su ya ma ra dza sa do me ya ru ṇa nas yo rab 'gyur/ de la dbus kyi ra'i dbus su de nas ra ya kṣe tstsha de nas tha mar ni/ zhes pa ni rtsibs brgyad pa dang / rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i nges pa'o//de nas rtsibs bcu drug pa'i bsgrub bya'i ming gis bar bar gyi 'dab ma la sngags 'di rnams bri bar bya'o/ /āoṃ hriḥṣṭiḥbi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ re mig nas ni re mig bar du mi'i bdag po bsgrub bya'i ming sngags 'di dag 'byung /dbye dang bsad pa dbang du bya bar ces pa 'dir rnam par dbye ba la dbus su gtso bo la ya'o/ /gsad pa la mā/ dbang du bya ba la ra/ de bzhin du kṣe da med sa tsa sogs 'byung / zhes pa ni 'dir rengs pa la kṣe/ dgug pa la da/rmongs pa la me/ stobs byed pa la do/ zhi ba la so/ bskrad pa la tstsha/rims byed pa la ṇa/ sems mnan pa la ru/ rgyal ba la dza/ rab tu bdung ba la yo/ dgra bzlog pa la ni/ rgyas pa la ra zhes pa'o/ /dbus nas de'i yi ge ya ni 'gyur ba'i dbang ces pa ni/ 'dir las kyi dbang gis yi ge gang 46—1142

dbus kyi gtso bor 'gyur ba de'i gnas su yi ge ya bri bar bya'o/ /phyi rol thams cad snga ma bzhin du'o ces pa ni gshin rje mthar byed kyi 'khor lo'i nges pa'o—/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'o/ /da ni zhi ba la sogs pa'i las la 'chad par 'gyur ba'i 'khrul 'khor n+ya gro dha'i lo ma 'jag ma rlan dang ma bral ba la bri'o gzhan la mi 'grub gsung / /shir sha dang gnyis 'bras sa lu btags pa'i khu bas dur ba'i snyug ①gus tsan dan nam dur ba'i snyug gu so/ /rgyas pa la 'jag ma dkar po la sogs pas bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du gsad pa dang / bskrad pa la dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang khrag dang sol bas mi rus kyi snyug gus so/ /bskrad pa la bya rog gi sgo rkang gis snyug gus so/ /dbang du bya ba dang dgug pa la gro ga la gur gum dang / ghi wang gis gser gyi snyug gus so/ /dgug pa la seng sdeng gi snyug gus tsan dan dmar po dang 'bras btags pa'i khu ba rang so phag gis so/ /rengs pa dang rmongs pa la shing ar ka'i lo mas yongs su smin pa kha dog ser po la 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba dang bcas pa'i yung ba blangs shing bil ba'i snyug gus so/ /shing arka'i snyug gus rmongs pa la /zhes pa ni nges pa'o/ /da ni 'khrul 'khor gyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga brjod de/ 'dir zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i 'khrul 'khor bris pa'i 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa/ skud pa dkar pos ji ltar 'khrul 'khor mi mthong bar nyi rim du bkri bar bya'o/ /de ltar las kyi rnam pa'i skud pa nag po dang skud pa ser po la sogs pas bkri bar bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba dang rgyas pa mar dang sbrang rtsi dang zhos bkang ba'i kham por kha sbyor du bzhag par bya'o/ /bsad pa dang bskrad pa la thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bzhag 46—1143

par bya'o/ /dbang dang dgug pa la mes spros pa'i ras kha sbyor du sbra tshil kyis g.yogs par bya'o/ /rengs pa dang rmongs pa la ba bla'i chus bkang ba'i so phag gi dbus su bzhag go/ /zhi ba dang rgyas pa la gnas gtsang ①zhing rlan dang bcas pa'i sa phyogs su steng du bzhag par bya'o/ /bsad pa dang bskrad pa la mar dang zho'i dong gi 'og tu sba bar bya'o/ /dbang du bya ba la dgug pa la thab kyi 'og tu'o/ /rengs pa dang rmongs pa las skam pa la sogs pa/ sngags pas de dag dge ba dang mi dge ba rig par bya ste/ 'di ni nges pa'o/ /da ni bris pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu nges par brjod par bya ste/ 'dir zhi ba la 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis bskor bar bya ste/ steng du re khas so/ /rgyas pa la glang po ches bskor te ji ltar glang po lus la 'khor lo 'byung bar ro/ /gsad pa la yi dwags kyi lus la'o/ /bskrad pa la rnga mo'i lus la'o/ /dgug pa la rta'i lus la'o/ /rmongs pa la ra'i lus sam lug gi lus la'o/ /rengs pa la rus sbal gyi lus la ji ltar 'khrul 'khor gyi tsakra 'gyur zhing de bzhin du phyi rol du gzugs bya'o/ /de nas gong du bshad pa'i skud pas bkyig par bya'o/ /de ltar rig pa rnams la yang nges pa'o/ /thun dang po phyed la g.yon pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor la byang du phyogs pas zhi ba'o —/ /duthun phyed pa gnyis pa la bden bral du kha ltas te rgyas pa'o/ /thun gnyis pa'i thun phyed la kha shar du kha ltas te/ g.yas pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gsad pa'o/ /thun phyed pa gnyis pa me'i dkyil 'khor bskrad pa'o/ /thun gsum pa'i phyed la lhor phyogs te g.yon me'i dkyil 'khor la dbang du bya ba'o—/ /thun gsum byed ma la bden bral du bltas te dgug pa'o/ /thun bzhi 46—1144

pa'i phyed ma la kha nub phyogs su g.yas pa'i dkyil 'khor la rengs pa'o/ /thun bzhi pa'i phyed phyi ma la rlung du ltas te rmongs pa'o/ /gshin rje mthar byed go 'phang la/ /gnas nas sngags kyi sa sbyang bya/ /grong gi lho'i phyogs kyi char/ /sa gzhi nag pa sbyang byas nas/ /dur khrod dben pa'i sa phyogs 'di/ /bskyed tshal sa zhi ba'i gnas/ /phub ma 'dra sogs kyis gdab/ /mngon spyod las 'di brtsam par bya/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin du ya bcu bzhi'i nyin/ /gza' ni spen pa mig dmar la/ /rgyu skar yang ni rgyal yod la/ /me bzhi nag pa tha skar bran/ /gre dang sbo dang de bzhin du/ /nam so dang ni bra nye ste/ /rgyu skar 'di dag drag po'o/ /sngags pas 'di dag gzhan dag la/ /drag po la sogs mnyam por spyad/ /gshin rje mthar byed kyi ①'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga rdzogs sto// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas—/ chag lo tsha ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //46—1145

'khyil pa'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i gwa thabs zhes bya ba/①rag gnod sbyin mo kun nas 'khyel pa mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༄4—/ /rgya gar skad du/ pa sha tsa ma kṣi ta ki ni kal pa u ta kun ta li sa dha na maḥ/ bod skad du/ sha za gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro kun nas 'khyil pa'i rtogs pa las byung ba'i gwa thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal nas gzhan lo/ /de nas 'jigarten pa'i sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnod sbyin rang rig pa 'dzin pa kun nas 'khyil pa yi/ /ga ba'i thabs nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di lta ste—/ /gnas dben dang po gnas rten pa ni nags tshal shingagil sogs par/ /'brasabu sangs rgyas 'dod pa'idad ldan skyes bu dbul 'dor bas/ /maṇḍal gnas der bla ma'i maṇḍal wī bu byi dor rdzas rnams bsham⑤/ /dngapo rten bri ba ras chen shing shun gzhi dag la/ /kun nas 'khyil pa'i gzugs brnyan gcig gam gsum mazing ka ljang dang dmar ba bri/ /dam rdzas phyi rten nang rten dgos pa tshang bar bsag /ci bder spyodalaman+ya'i rnal 'byor 46byed1147

gyis—/ /dang po rang yidam gang yin du lha sgom de mdun du/ /kun gnod sbyin mo nas 'khyil pa gcan 'aṭa ra sku gsung thugs gsum/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa bya lhag pa'i cho ga song bas bsgom/ /mthing ka ljang dang dmar ba'i mdog /gsum ka 'angazhal cig phyag gnyis gzhon nu'i sgu/ /brkyang skum sha rgyas nu ma 'bur/ /rin chen dang rus pa'i rgyan yid du 'ong bas rgyan ldan mdzes pa zhi ba'i tshul/ /mgo skyes skra li bum pa dang / /nor bu phyag g.yas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pas thugs khar sbyar ba 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /ud pal gye gdan sna tshogs padma'i gdan la legs gnas pa/ /yang na zhi ba'i sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma gsum bskyed/ /rim pas yeshesapadagug gzhug byas pas tsa ka li dngos nyid lha/ /de la mdun gyi dmigs ste sngags bzlas pas/ /dang por zas gnyis pa gos gsum pa nor zas gos nor mchog rim pa ste/ /dang por zas gter oṃ ili ki pi kyi ki li ki swā hā/ gnyisapa la gos gter oṃ a na le ku ta li gi ṇa pi ṇa ḍa li pa sha tsa na swā hā/ gsum pa la nor gter oṃ na ma shukṣa mu khi ma hā pi sha tsa na ma swā hā/'di la zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig las sbyor dus su chang bu re re la lan bdun bdun bdun zas la sngags nas bsgrub—/ /grubapa'i rtags ni bud med tshul 'chang zas gter dang / /rtags bzangs yid dang mthun pa'i mthong nas las la sbyar/ /rten phyi rten tsa ka li sku'i rten thogs bla rdo srog gi ngag gi tshul/ /mchan khung g.yon par mi 'thong gnas sba mchod par bgyi/ /dgrangs gtso bo'i sngon du ci 'dod bsnyen pa byas la gsol ba gdab/ /snyen pa'i dus su shing zog sha la sogs pa gtozab ma/ 'a nga zan rgyan bye/sa brgyan/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ a ka ros pa li ma ha kha nyi la sogs te byin gyis brlabs la sham bu bsgyur/ /las la sbyar ba snyen pa them nas rang kha zas nam za ba'i dus rgyun du ni/ /kha zas phud dang ldan pa yis/ /lngayodapa'i chang rjes zas la mngon sngags nas/ /mdun du bsgyur bas ci 'dod 'byung / /dam tshig ma 46byed1148

rjed rgyun du bsgrang / /gnodasbyin mo mdun du bkug ①pa de la sbyin/ /sgrub thabs 'di nyid the tshom spangs nas su/ /zhag ②nyi shu rtsa gcig de nas rgyun tu snyen grangs tshul bzhin byas gyur na/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che dang 'dra yid la ci 'dod nor bu ltar/ /ji ltar rang gang 'dod pa dmigs pa tsam gyis 'dod pa rdzogs par 'gyur/ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub kyis/ /sha za rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyud nas phyung nas mdzad pa lnga(ba/ba/ cas// //bsdur mchan/1147 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉poshams/1149 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bskug ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhagabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2613)46wa 1149

༄ga /gnod sbyin ma kun nas 'khyil pa'i gwa thabs kyi don bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/sti༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya kṣi ni kun dha li sa dha na ma/ bod skad du / gnod sbyin ma kun nas 'khyel pa'i gwa thabs kyi don bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i gwa thabs 'di la don rnam pa lngas bstan ste/ dang po brten bca' ba dang gcig /lha sgom zhing bsnyen ②pa byed pa dang gnyis/ bla rdo bzung ba dang gsum/ thun 'tshams su gtor ma gtang ①zhing gsol ba gtab pa dang bzhi/ las la sbyar ba dang rgyun tu nyams su blang ba dang lnga'o/ /dang por brten bcwa' ba ni/ ro ras sam/ shing shun la gur gum gyis chus byugs la/ de la gnod sbyin ma kun nas 'khyil pa dpon g.yog gsum bri/de la gtso mo sku mdog mthing nag /g.yas ljang khu/ g.yon dmar po/ thams cad zhal cig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa thams cad dgra sta/ g.yon pa na ka 46byed1150

pa la mtshan dang ldan pa bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon rkyang ba/pad ma dang ud pa la'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /sku la rus pa'i brgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyan zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa/ dbu ①skra lcang lor 'khyel ba/rin po che'i rgyan du mas/ brgyan pa/ nu ma 'bur ba/ sku gzhon pa'i cha lugs su bri'o/ /skya rengs kyi dus su thugs khar snying po dang rgyab du mtshan bri'o//mtshon gseb du/ rang byung rakta/ sen dhu ra/ gur gum/ tsan dan dmar po dang / yang yangan/ bu mo gson gshin gtsang ma gang yang rung ba'i khrag dang bsres thal rṣa yang bsre'o labri'o/ /rten rin po che ga'u'i nang du de mis ma 'thong bar sba'o/ /brten la gdams pa gces so/ /gnyis pa lha sgom zhing bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ dang por mdun du maṇḍal mda' gang ba gcig la me tog gi tshom bu skram/ gong gi rten de der bzhugs la/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ khyad par du bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub gwa pa la/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyis ⑤dbul zhing 'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ga snyam du bsams la/ de nas yid dam gyi lha gang yin bsgoms pa'i mdun du—/ tsa ka li gsum las/ gnod sbyin ma gsum bsgoms ①pa ni/ dbus kyi gtso mo sku mdog mthing nag /g.yas ljang khu g.yon dmar po/ zhal cig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas thams cad dgra sta/ g.yon thams cad na mtshan ldan ka pa la/ spyan zhal 'dzum pa/ dbu skra li ba la rin po che dang rus pa'i brgyan ④gyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum pa/ g.yon brkyang ba/ rin po che 46—1151

dang padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa bskyed la/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer kyis/lho nub nas lha mo gsum spyan drangs la/ mdun bskyed la stem la gnyis su med par bya'o/ /de nas rten gsum pos bdag gi bka' nyan par bsams la/sngags bzlas so/ /dang po gsung gi lha mos zas gwa pa ni/ oṃ i ling ki/pi ling ki/ ki ling shī swā hā/ de la zhag bdun snyen pa bya'o/ /de nas sku'i lha mos gos gwa pa ni/ oṃ a na le/ kun dha li 1 na/ nyin dha/ pi sha tsi ni ye swā hā/ de'ang zhag bdun no/ /de nas thugs kyi lha mos nor gwa pa ni/oṃ na mo/ shu kra mu khri ma ha pi sha tsi ni ye swā hā/ 'di'ang zhag bdun gwa po/de'i bla rdo bzung ba ni/ kar sha pa ni sbrum ma gsum/ byi ru gsum/mu men/ mu tig gsum/ dar dmar pos dril la rten tsakalidang bcas pa/'chan khung g.yon du bcang ngo / /de ni bla rdo bzung ba'o/ /thun 'tshams su gtor ma btang ba ni/ shing thog dang / sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma gsum bshams la/ lha mo gsum mdun du mngon sum bsams la/ gtor ma de yi ge gsum kyis bdud rtsir byen byis brlabs la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ i ling ki/ pi ling ki/ ki ling ki/ a na le kun dhe li/gi na sin dha pi sha tsi ni ye/ na ma shu kra mu khri/ ma hā pi sha tsi ni ye/ i rda bha leng ta/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces lan gsum gyis 'bul lo/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnod sbyin sha za mkha' 'gro khyed gsum gyis/ bdag gi mchod pa dang gtor ma ni bzhes la/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don du byang chub 46—1152

ga pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bsod nams yongs su rdzogs pa'i slad du/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa snang bar mdzad du gsol/ces lan gsum gsol ba gtab bo/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ dur khrod chen po shing drung nags tshal chen po ru/ /lhag pa'i gnas bcas sha za mkha' 'gro gsum—/ /sgyu ma'i skur ston 'phrin las mdzad pa'i lha/ /sna tshogs ston mdzad yid bzhin nor 'dra'i dpal/ /dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba bskong / /mi zad gter las grub pa'i bum pa 'dzin/ /dgos 'dod ci 'dod 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod do/ /las sbyor rgyun du nyams su len pa ni/ rang zas za ba'i dus su/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas/ dkon mchog la mchod pa phul la/ de'i rjes su—/ mdun du lha mo gsum bsgom pa ni/ de yang sku mdog mthing nag /g.yas ljang khu/ g.yon dmar mo/ zhal cig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas nor bu'i bum pa rin po ches bkang ba thugs khar bsnams pa/ g.yon yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /zhi ba'i zhal cung zad dmar ba/zhabs g.yas skum g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed dkyil gyis padma dang rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gwa pa po la dgyes pa'i tshul du zhal gzigs te/ ji ltar bsams pa'i dngos grub gter ba cig tu bskyed la/ zan gyi chang bu la bsngags la/ sa la skyur ro/ /chang bu dang po la/ oṃ i ling ki/ pi ling ki/ ki ling ki swā hā/ ces lan bdun no/ /gnyis pa la oṃ na ma shu kra mu khri ma ha pi sha tsi ni ye swā hā/ ces 46—1153

lan bdun no/ /gsum pa la/ oṃ a na le kun dha le/ gyi na sin dha/ pi sha tsi na ye swā hā/ ces pa'i sngags 'di gsum/ chang bu re re la lan bdun bdun gtab pa sa la dor ro/ /rjes la/ chos kyi grogs su 'gro bar gsol ba gdab po/ /gnod sbyin ma kun nas 'khyil pa'i gwa thabs/ slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad nas/ de'i 'grel pa bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ lotstsha ba rin chen grags pas bsgyur nas rim par rgyud pa'o/ /'di la the tshom bya mi dgos so/ /'di'i sgrub rtags ni bud med dang skye bo mang pos bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / lo tog rtsas ma rnga ①ba dang / 'bru'i char 'bab pa dang / rin po che'i gter rnyed pa dang / 'di rnams dngos sam rmi lam du 'byung gsung /'di'i dam tshig du/ bud med la mi smod/ bud med la brnyas par mi bya/mo mtshan la ched du mi lta'o①/ /dus rgyun du yi dam du bya ba ni/ tad ya thā/oṃ tsha me/ u la ni/ du kha na swā hā/ ces pa'i sngags 'di/ srod la bzhi brgya tsam re bzlas so/ /des ni dngos grub myur du 'grub par gsungs so/ /gnod sbyin ma kun nas 'khyil pa'i gwa thabs/ slob dpon klu grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ①//slob dpon klu grub/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa/ mkhas pa ba ri lotstsha ba/bu ston rin chen grub/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ dgas po glo sgo ba—/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs shākya seng ge/ gon 'gyo bu dha pha rjol/ de la bdag mi skyod rdo rjes zhus so/ /de ltar rims pas rgyud pa'i gdam ngag 'di ni/ phyogs kri yar rtogs/46—1154

rgyud sha za rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyud nas bsdus/ don mched/ gang zag dad pa dang ldan pa dbul ba sel ba'i don du mdzad/ bla ma ba ri lo tstsha ba rgya gar na chos gsan pa la/ yo byad kyi dngos po ci yang med pas/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal nas/ khyod longs spyod kyis nyon mongs par 'dug pas/ khyod la zas kyis mi 'phongs par tshegs med par 'ong ba'i gdam ngag cig sbyin gyis gsung nas gnang ngo / /'di dang po bsnyen pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig byas na/zas dang gos dang / nor la tshegs med par 'ong gsung / 'di sku gsung thugs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gsum yin gsung / gnas ni/ rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub 'tshams na/ dur khrod shing drung nags tshal la brten byas nas gnas/'jig rten khams kyi nor byi bdag mo yin/ 'di la the tshom dang yid gnyis bya mi dgos gsung ngo // byed //zhal gdams cig la/ nang par skya rengs shar ba'i dus su tsa ka li gzhengs rgyu skya ris gtab tshar ba de'i thugs khar snying po dang / rgyab du rten 'brel snying po bri zer ba yang snang ngo // //yang rigs gcig ①la/ dbang du bya ba'i 'khor lo ni/ rtsibs bzhi pa la—/ oṃ a bha shi bha a/ oṃ ma pi/ a du pa shi swā hā/ zhes g.yon bskor bri—/ lte ba la/ dmigs bya'i ming rus dang / dbang du sdus cig bri/ de nyid mdun du bzhag la/ zhag gsum sngags kyi bsnyen pa/ khri tsho byug bzlas la/rang gi the bong g.yas pa la rtse mo/ des ni dbang du 'dus nas/ sbyin bdag du 'gyur ro/ /dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //46byed1155

bsdur mchan/115༷ stimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stananod sbyin ma kun nas 'khyil pa'i ga thabs kyi don bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sten/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉btang /1151 ①〈〈pe 〉stanabus/ ②〈〈pe 〉7)/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/ rjo〈〈pe 〉skaman/1154 ①〈〈pe 〉〉snga/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉blta'o/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉haṃ/ du〈〈pe 〉ngo: dha pa/1155 ①〈〈pe 〉〉cigabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2614)46wa 1156

༄ga /gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang ri rab mchog ma rin po che bzang po'i bsgrub thabs/①ga gnod sbyin yid 'phrog gi bsgrub thabs bzhugs so// rag /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ra tsi ta me ru snyo dang ka ra rad na bha la sa dha dzwa/ bod skad du/gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / ri rab mchog ma rin po che bzang po'i bsgrub thabs/rdo rje 'ji na pa la phyag 'cha la lo/ /'phrul gyi gdams pa dang 'dra ste gung mo rtse sprad pa rin po che'i sgyu bur sems pa yin bsgrub mchog brten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /tshegs med rin chen thunamong gi nor 'byung ba'i/ /aparatsi te'abyung po'i bdag po rigs kyis yab yum gyi/ /bsgrub pa 'di la chos la dmigs te thun mong bsgrub pa'i'abad par rigs—/ /dang po sngags pa smon lam dang snying rjer ldan pa/ gso sbyong dang rigs sngags bsgrub pa'i dam tshig dang ldan pas/ dbeen pa'i gnas su man 'dral dang mchod pa bshams te/ stan bde ba la gnas gnas shing / rang :/ shāstilnga/ lag na rdo rje 'am yi dam gang byed do/ /phyag dang mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams tshogs bsags bya/'ab 46—1157

'byor rdzogs par byas la/ rdo rje dam par bsgol la gung mo rin po che'i myu gu 'dzin dam jugag gi phyag rgya byas te/ dri spos kyi ri lu bsreg cing / 'dzab bshub gling bu 'bud pa yin cing brjod do/ /man 'dral steng du skad cig mas rdzas skyes su bsgom ste/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhir bdag mos pa bya de nas 'byung po'i bdag po sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pab ti'i stodagayogs tshongeg gu bsnams pa te gos khra bo / byu/ga g.yas dang po na ba dan dang g.yon dang po na ra ta na phreng ba ste/ ri rab mo la 'khyud yab sku mdog sngo bsangs phyag na rad na'i myu gu 'dzin pas 'dzin/ /phyaga'og ma gnyis kyi rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'itshuladu par bsam par bya'o/ /su pi ti'i tsi tar las kyi 'khor lo kha sbyar la bcug la rang gi phreng ba'i sna la btags pa dang maṇḍal steng du bzhag pa dang gtor ma'i nang du bcug pa gang rung gi cho ga rgyasargya sman dang 'bru dang rad na dang bha li rgyas par bshams la mis mi mthong bar sba'o/ /palnga/ gto rab ma/ bas/ma sa chaphywahūṃ gsum gyis bdud rtsir bsam pa'i nang du bcug cing / 'bu ta tri nas si te dza'i bar du gsum 'am bdun gter bsgrub pa'i dam tshig gi sngags brjod la sbyin yum gyi gsol bar bsam te/ 'khor lo lus la bsrungab 'am gos la bcang bar bya'o/ /snying po ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ hri dza a pa ra tsi ta dza dza/ ma hā shri 'bu ta la ku la su dha ri hūṃ/ ces 'bum la sogs pa te ma byon bar du 'am rtags ma byon bar du dang po bsham de nas byin brlabs byas bsnyen pa ma thon bar du rta bur bya thon pa dang btang ngo / /'byung po'i bdag po mdun na yod pa la dmigs la 'byung mo ri rab mchog skyes ma/rang lhar gnas pa dang / yab yum mdun na yod pa la dmigs pa bsnyen pa bya/ rtags gsum 'ong te/ byon pa'i rtags/ gter grub pa'i rtags/ bar du gcod pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du bsnyen pa bya ste/de nas las la sbyar ba ni/ chu sna gnyis lung gsum 'dus pa'i mdo dag la chu med kyang kha brag gam 'gor/ lung pa gnyis zer yang lung pa gnyis 'dus pa'i mgo'i sa blangs pas chog sprosang pa 'a ma//46byed1158

lung pa gnyis kyi 'gor man 'dral bris/ lag pa gnyis sdigs 'dzub bya ste/lag mthil nam mkha' la bsten nas 'the chung gnyis bsnol te/ 'dzub mo gnyis bkum/ maṇḍal yang byug me tog sil ma bkram la ril gu bsreg /rad na dang sman dang 'bru sna tshogs spos dang tsan dan dang dri sna tshogs sbyar ba dang / phun sum tshogs pa'i man dal yang byug /me tog sel ma bkram/ ril bu bsreg /rad na dang sman dang 'bru sna tshogs kyi gtor ma bshams la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs bya'o/ /las bsgrub pa'i snying po brjod par bya ste/ 'dis ni las myur du 'grub pa yin/'bu ta tri pa sarba rad ṣpe tri saṃ bha te swā hā de nas rang lhar yod pa dang / mdun gyi yab yum la dmigs te skabs skabs su dha ri hūṃ 'bru ta tri zhes snying po dang las sngags mbil ste bslo'o/ /gtso bor las sngar rang nus tshad du zla'o/ /zhag lnga'i bar du bya'o/ /a pa ra tsi ta'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/rad na pha la si ti dza zhes bzlas pas/ rin po che la sogs pa'i 'dod pa thams cad sbyin par bsams la/ rang ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod la sogs pa'i rdzas thams cad nam mkha' la char du babs par bsams te de la dmigs pa 'di byas pas/ 'phral tshogs rdzogs pa dang 'grub pa'i dus yin gsung / de yang blos cha gsum du bgos te/ dang por bla ma/ de nas dkon mchog gsum/gnyis pa ni rang gis ci rigs par longs spyad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni sems can dbul 'phongs ①pa rnams la sbyin par dmigs dmigs pa ni 'di kho na bzhin byas rdzas kyang sbyar rang la dgos pa byas nas 'phro bcad na bar chad du 'gro nyen yod gsungs la bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad 'dus pa'i rgyud nas 'byung ba yin/ thams cad dam tshig las mi 'da' ba'i sngags yin/ 'das na mgo 'gas so/ /dam rang yi dam phyag rdor du bsams te bar chad kyi rtags byung na bsnyen pa dang las sbyor gyi dus yin yang bzlas so/ /ci bya zer yang lan mi sbyin par 'di bzlas 46—1159

so/ /brgya rtsa brgyad dam stong rsha ci nus so bzla'o/ /tshig bsre ba'i snying po brjod par bya ste/oṃ du na du na/ bi du na bee du na/ tsa la tsa la/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ pra bi sha ya pra bi sha ya/ sa ma ya ma nu pa la ya bhyo bhyo/ sa man sa na pra bi sha kyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po yab yum gyi dam tshig bsre ba'i sngags te/ 'di brjod na 'byung po thams cad dam tshig las mi 'da'o/ /bar chad sel ba yang 'dis bya'o/ /dngos grub ni phyogs grubapa'i dus su mtha' dag nas 'ong ste/ shes rab che ba dang / chos mkhas pa dang / mi byams pa dang / rdzas dang longs spyod 'du ba dang / pha rol mi'i yid 'phrogs pa ste/ thams cad dbang du 'du zhing mos par 'dun pa dang / nor ster bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin yid 'phrog gi bsgrub thabs slob dpon chen po in tra bo des mdzad pa rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po kha che paṇa chen dang / bod kyi lotstsha ba tshul khrims gzhon nus bsgyur ba'o// maṅga lo//46—1160

deb zhe drug pa/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus/krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkrams/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/krung go'i glog brnyan dpe sgrun khang par khang gis dpar btab/spyi lo 999pa'i 7par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/spyi lo 999lo'i 7par par beengs dang po btab/dpar grangs/ byed ༷ ci2ma7—80057—3 —7snu 203
